blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉推理上取得了迅速的进展,然而许多任务需要的证据单靠内部推理是难以获得的:我们对22个基准的控制研究显示,仅仅增加基础模型的推论预算只能产生微小的收益. 这种任务需要有根据的认知、外部知识和通过各种工具获得的数字测量,其产出必须能够对模型作出解释,并保留各种推理步骤。 我们介绍了OpenVLHarness,这是一个围绕能力层和持久的多模式记忆组织的多模式推理工具。 能力层将任务级工具界面与证据渲染相结合,提供一致的获取多端后端,并将其输出转化为可被模型读取的观测. 持续的多模式内存保留了相应的图像,结构化数据和网络引用,作为每个查询的可地址文物. 一个编码接口在存储数据上执行生成的程序,使计算能够结合多个工具的结果. 这些机制共同支持获得、检查和整理多式联运证据的迭接过程。 对22个有8个开放和专有骨干的基准进行评估后,OpenVLHarness的平均分数比匹配的无工具基线提高9.7-12.6分,包括+11.2分与Qune3-VL-8B分,+9.7分与Kimi K3分,+9.9分与GPT-6 Astra分. 随着GPT-6 Luna在中度推理上的努力,OpenVLHarness以最大努力7.7-8.5分的成绩超过了基准模型"Codex"和"Visual Sketchpad",而其模型-token成本最高为37%.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Performance of OpenVLHarness across models and settings. (a) Average score over 22 challenging multimodal benchmarks with and without OpenVLHarness, across the Qwen, Kimi, and GPT model families. (b) Benchmark scores for GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6 Astra at medium reasoning effort, each with and without OpenVLHarness; radii are rescaled per benchmark, and numbers give the raw scores of GPT-6 Astra (medium) with OpenVLHarness. (c) Average score versus model-token cost (average for 1,000 query rollouts) on 22 benchmarks for GPT-6 Luna alone and with Codex, Visual Sketchpad, or OpenVLHarness, across all five reasoning-effort settings.
blocks.zh: 图1:OpenVLHarness跨模型和设置的性能. (a) 在Quen、Kimi和GPT示范家庭,无论有无OpenVLHarness,平均得分超过22个挑战性多式联运基准。 (b) GPT-6 Luna和GPT-6 Astra在中度推理努力下的基准分数,每个分数有OpenVLHarness和没有OpenVLHarness;radi按基准重新定级,数字给出了GPT-6 Astra(中度)与OpenVLHarness的原始分数. (c) 在GPT-6 Luna的22个基准上,以及在所有5个推理-努力设置中,仅与Codex、Visual Sketchpad或OpenVLHarness相比,平均得分与模型驱动成本(平均1 000个查询启动数)相比。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as reasoning engines over images, documents, webpages, and videos. However, many real-world visual tasks require information that the model cannot reliably infer from the input alone. Answering a question may require localizing numerous tiny objects in dense scenes, retrieving external knowledge about a long-tail entity, or computing quantities from intermediate measurements. Such tasks require additional multimodal evidence acquired through perception, search, and computation. Our inference-time scaling study (Fig. 1 c) reveals diminishing returns at higher reasoning budgets: moving the base model from xhigh to max effort multiplies its model-token spending by 2.7 but improves its average score by only 0.7 points. This raises the question of whether further progress requires better access to task-relevant multimodal evidence, beyond additional reasoning over the initial input.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)越来越多地被用作对图像、文件、网页和视频的推理引擎。 然而,许多现实世界的视觉任务需要信息,而该模型单靠输入是无法可靠推断出来的. 回答一个问题可能需要在密集场景中将许多微小物体定位,检索关于长尾实体的外部知识,或者从中间测量中计算数量. 这些工作需要通过感知、搜索和计算获得更多的多式联运证据。 我们的推论时间缩放研究(图1c)揭示了高推理预算的回报率下降:将基数模型从x高移到最大努力,将模型脚本支出乘以2.7,但平均分数只提高0.7分。 这就提出了这样一个问题:除了对初步投入作更多的推理之外,进一步的进展是否还需要更好地获得与任务有关的多式联运证据。

blocks.en: Visual tool-use agents address this need by connecting MLLMs to perception models, search engines, and code execution ( Hong et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2025a ; Narayan et al., 2025 ; Geng et al., 2026 ; Su et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Surís et al., 2023 ; Gupta and Kembhavi, 2023 ) . Building a general harness around these tools presents two connected challenges. First, heterogeneous backends expose different calling conventions and return outputs such as segmentation masks, depth maps, and retrieved webpages that need to be presented in a form the model can interpret. Second, subsequent reasoning steps may still need access to the underlying artifacts: a rendered depth map supports visual inspection, but a precise measurement requires its numerical values. Effective multimodal tool use therefore requires both consistent tool interfaces with evidence rendering and a mechanism for retaining and reusing the resulting artifacts.
blocks.zh: 视觉工具使用代理人通过将MLLMs与感知模型、搜索引擎和代码执行连接起来来满足这种需要(Hong等人,2026a; Wu等人,2025a;Narayan等人,2025;Geng等人,2026;Su等人,2025;Wu等人,2025b;Surís等人,2023;Gupta和Kembhavi,2023). 围绕这些工具建立总体利用机制是两个相互关联的挑战。 首先,各式各样的后端暴露出不同的调用惯例,并返回输出,如分区面具、深度地图和检索的网页,这些网页需要以模型能够解释的形式展示。 其次,随后的推理步骤可能仍然需要访问基本文物:一个渲染的深度图支持视觉检查,但精确的测量需要其数值. 因此,有效使用多式联运工具既需要与提供证据保持一致的工具接口,也需要保留和重新使用由此产生的文物的机制。

blocks.en: We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory . The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with model-facing evidence rendering . Task-level interfaces define operations independently of a particular backend, allowing tools to be replaced without changing the orchestrator’s task vocabulary. Evidence rendering converts heterogeneous outputs into observations that combine visualizations, concise descriptions, and compact structured information. For example, visual grounding accepts an image and a textual query, then presents the detected regions through an annotated image and coordinates. Together, these mechanisms let the orchestrator invoke tools consistently and inspect their results in a form suited to multimodal reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了OpenVLHarness,这是一个围绕能力层和持续的多式联运记忆组织的多式联运推理工具。 能力层将任务级工具界面与模型化证据渲染结合. 任务级接口独立于特定后端定义操作,可以不改变管弦乐手的任务词汇而替换工具. 提供的证据将各种产出转化为观察,将可视化、简明描述和结构紧凑的信息结合起来。 例如,视觉地面接受一个图像和一个文字查询,然后通过附加注释的图像和坐标来呈现检测到的区域. 这些机制共同使乐团能够一致地使用各种工具,并以适合多式联运推理的形式检查其成果。

blocks.en: Persistent multimodal memory makes the corresponding artifacts available across turns within a query. Images, structured data, and web references are registered under reusable handles, allowing later calls to operate on earlier evidence. In the grounding example, the orchestrator can inspect the overlay, then reuse the retained masks and a subsequently acquired depth array to measure depth within each region. A Python Coding Agent supports such compositions: the orchestrator specifies a computational objective in natural language, and a code-generation session backed by the same backbone model writes a program that executes over the stored data. The capability layer makes tool results interpretable; memory makes their underlying artifacts addressable and reusable. Together, they support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and computing over multimodal evidence.
blocks.zh: 持续的多式联运内存使相应的文物在查询中可以跨转而得到。 图像,结构化的数据,和网络引用都登记在可重复使用的手柄下,允许以后的调用在更早的证据上操作. 在搁浅的例子中,管弦乐团可以检查覆盖物,然后重新使用所保留的面具和随后获得的深度阵列,以测量每个区域内的深度。 一个Python编码代理支持这样的组成:管弦乐器在自然语言中指定了一个计算目标,一个由同一个主干模型支持的代码生成会话会写一个程序,在存储的数据上执行. 能力层使工具结果可以解释;内存使其基本文物可以处理和再利用。 它们共同支持通过多式联运证据获取、检查和计算的一个迭代过程。

blocks.en:
We evaluate OpenVLHarness on 22 benchmarks spanning grounded perception, visual search and deep research, general VQA and hallucination, and spatial reasoning, using eight open and proprietary MLLM backbones of different scales (Fig. 1 a). Across these settings, OpenVLHarness consistently improves average performance over the base MLLMs by 9.7–12.6 percentage points and outperforms existing visual tool-use baselines (Fig. 1 c). Scaling experiments on 22 benchmarks further show that OpenVLHarness also benefits from greater reasoning effort (Fig. 1 c), suggesting that evidence acquisition and inference-time scaling are complementary.
We conduct ablation studies to examine the incremental effects of the capability layer and memory, showing the value of both usable tool outputs and retained multimodal artifacts. Lastly, for users who would like to adapt our harness to a custom domain, we further showcase two coding-agent-driven workflows for specialization: harness search edits prompts, tool descriptions, and output templates, while tool generation composes existing capabilities into new tools. Both operate without updating the underlying MLLM weights.
blocks.zh:
我们对OpenVLHarness的评价以22个基准为基础,包括基于感知、视觉搜索和深入研究、一般VQA和幻觉以及空间推理,使用八个不同尺度的开放和专有的MLLM主干线(图1a)。 在整个这些设置中,OpenVLHarness不断提高比基础MLLM的平均性能,提高了9.7至12.6个百分点,并且超过了现有的视觉工具使用基线(图1c)。 关于22项基准的扩大试验进一步表明,OpenVLHarness还得益于更大的推理努力(图1c),这表明证据获取和推断时间的扩大是相辅相成的。
我们进行减产研究,审查能力层和内存的增量效应,显示可用工具输出值和所保留的多式联运文物值。 最后,对于想要将我们的利用调整为自定义域的用户,我们进一步展示两个用于专业化的编码代理驱动工作流程:利用搜索编辑提示、工具描述和输出模板,而工具生成将现有能力编织成新的工具。 两者的运作都不更新基本的MLLM权重.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are: (1) a capability layer that combines task-level tool interfaces with model-facing evidence rendering for heterogeneous perception, search, and computation tools; (2) persistent multimodal memory that retains addressable artifacts across turns and enables their reuse in subsequent tool calls and memory-grounded computation;
and (3) an evaluation across 22 benchmarks and eight backbones, with component ablations and domain-specialization studies, accompanied by an open-source release of the harness, tools, evaluation protocols, and two optimization workflows.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献是:(1) 将任务级工具接口与提供不同感知、搜索和计算工具的模型证据结合起来的能力层;(2) 持续的多式联运内存,在转弯之间保留可地址的文物,使其能在随后的工具呼叫和基于内存的计算中重新使用;
和(3)一项涉及22个基准和8个主干线的评价,并进行组件编组和域域专门化研究,同时开放源码发布利用,工具,评价协议,以及两个优化工作流程.

blocks.en: 2 Harness Design
blocks.zh: 2 机理设计

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of OpenVLHarness. The MLLM orchestrator invokes capabilities through typed interfaces. The capability layer connects these interfaces to underlying models and services and renders their outputs into model-facing evidence: here, a labeled mask overlay accompanied by a textual description and normalized bounding boxes. Persistent multimodal memory retains image artifacts, structured data, and web references under reusable handles. An Environment Update advertises the available artifacts to the orchestrator, allowing subsequent calls to reuse earlier evidence, including through memory-grounded computation.
blocks.zh: 图2:OpenVLHarness概览. MLLM管弦乐器通过键入接口来引用能力. 能力层将这些接口与基本模型和服务连接起来,并将它们的输出制成模型化的证据:在这里,一个带有标签的面具覆盖,并附有文字描述和规范化的边框. 持续的多式联运内存保留了图像文物,结构化数据和可重复使用的手柄下的网络引用. 《环境最新消息》向管弦乐手宣传现有的文物,允许随后的呼叫重新使用先前的证据,包括通过基于内存的计算。

blocks.en: OpenVLHarness augments an MLLM orchestrator with two complementary mechanisms (Figure 2 ). The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with model-facing evidence rendering, providing consistent access to tools and observations the orchestrator can inspect (Sec. 2.1 ). Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding artifacts and exposes them by reference for reuse across turns within a query (Sec. 2.2 ). At each step, the orchestrator uses the observations and available memory references to select a tool call or produce an answer. A Python Coding Agent supports computation over stored artifacts, connecting outputs from different capabilities into multi-step procedures. The modular interfaces and renderers also support harness specialization through text edits and tool composition (Sec. 3.6 ).
blocks.zh: OpenVLHarness用两个互补机制(图2)增加了一个MLLM管弦乐器. 能力层将任务级工具界面与模型化证据渲染相结合,提供连贯的获取工具的途径和指挥员可以检查的观察(第2.1条)。 持续的多式联运内存保留了相应的文物,并参考这些文物在查询中反复重复使用(第2.2条)。 在每一步,管弦乐团都会利用观测结果和可用的内存引用来选择一个工具调用或生成一个答案. 一个Python编码代理支持对存储的文物进行计算,将不同能力的输出连接到多步骤程序. 模块化的界面和渲染器也通过文本编辑和工具组成支持调用专业化(第3.6条)。

blocks.en: 2.1 Capability Layer
blocks.zh: 2.1 能力层

blocks.en: We design the capability layer with two goals: defining how the orchestrator invokes a capability and rendering the resulting evidence for inspection. The first accommodates different backends behind a consistent interface; the second addresses the heterogeneous formats of their outputs.
blocks.zh: 我们以两个目标设计能力层:确定管弦乐手如何援引能力,并将由此产生的证据提交检查。 第一部分包含一致界面下的不同后端;第二部分涉及其产出的不同格式。

blocks.en: We define a capability by the operation it provides, its typed inputs, and the evidence and reusable data it exposes. For example, visual grounding accepts an image reference and a textual query and exposes object locations, associated metadata, and a visualization; a supporting backend may additionally provide segmentation masks. Each backend is wrapped to implement this task-level interface. Visual Grounding can thus use SAM 3 or Grounding DINO, and OCR can use PaddleOCR-VL or DeepSeek-OCR, while preserving the orchestrator’s calling convention (Appendix C ). Backend selection can reflect accuracy, cost, and latency requirements. Our base instantiation includes nine capabilities: five for perception—Zoom-in, Visual Grounding, OCR, Depth Estimation, and Camera Trajectory; three for information seeking—Text Search, Image Search, and Webpage Visit; and a Python Coding Agent for computation over intermediate results. Please refer to Appendix C and Table 18 for their implementation details.
blocks.zh: 我们通过它所提供的操作、其输入输入、以及它所暴露的证据和可重复使用的数据来界定一种能力。 例如,可视化地面接受一个图像参考和一个文字查询,并暴露对象位置,关联元数据,以及可视化;支持的后端可能额外提供分区遮罩. 每个后端被包裹来实施这个任务级接口. 视觉 地面因此可以使用SAM 3或Grounding DINO,OCR可以使用PaddleOCR-VL或DeepSeek-OCR,同时保留乐团的调用会议(附录C). 后端选择可以反映准确性,成本和耐久性要求. 我们的基本即时处理包括9种能力:5种能力用于感知——Zoom-in、视觉地面、OCR、深度估计和相机轨迹;3种能力用于寻找信息——图文搜索、图像搜索和网页访问;1种Python编码代理,用于计算中间结果。 详细执行情况请参见附录C和表18。

blocks.en: Raw tool outputs often require additional processing to become useful observations. An RLE mask encodes a region precisely, but serializing that encoding into the context does not show the orchestrator which object was segmented. Dense numerical arrays can likewise consume substantial context without providing useful, interpretable evidence.
blocks.zh: 原始工具输出往往需要额外的处理才能成为有用的观察. RLE 掩码精确地将一个区域编码,但将编码序列化到上下文并不能显示哪个对象被分割的管弦乐器. 激值数组同样可以消耗大量上下文而不提供有用和可解释的证据。

blocks.en: Each capability therefore includes an output processor that renders its result into a model-facing observation. Depending on the capability, this observation combines visual attachments, concise natural-language descriptions, compact structured information, and references to reusable artifacts. Grounding can return a labeled mask overlay with the number of detected objects and normalized bounding boxes; depth estimation can return a colorized map; and Camera Trajectory can return a visualization of the recovered trajectory. The underlying masks, arrays, and camera parameters are passed to memory for later reuse. Figure 2 illustrates grounding for “cabinet” in input_image_3 . The capability returns a mask overlay with a description of the five grounded objects and their bounding boxes, allowing the orchestrator to inspect the detections. If a subsequent step requires a depth measurement for each cabinet, this rendered observation supplies the visual context, while the retained masks and a depth array supply the data for computation. The memory mechanism below connects these steps.
blocks.zh: 因此,每种能力都包括一个输出处理器,使其结果成为模型化的观测结果。 根据能力的不同,这种观察结合了视觉附件,简洁的自然语言描述,紧凑的结构化信息,以及对可重复使用的文物的参考. 搁浅可以返回带有标签的面具覆盖,并带有检测对象的数量和规范的边框;深度估计可以返回彩色地图;相机轨迹可以返回回收轨迹的可视化. 背后的面具,阵列,和相机参数被传递给内存,以便日后再使用. 图2说明了输入图3中“内阁”的基础。 能力返回一个带有5个被禁足物体及其捆绑箱描述的遮罩,使管弦乐手能够检查探测. 如果随后的一步需要每个柜的深度测量,这使得观察提供了视觉上下文,而保留起来的口罩和一个深度阵列则提供了用于计算的数据. 下面的内存机制连接了这些步骤.

blocks.en: 2.2 Persistent Multimodal Memory
blocks.zh: 2.2 持续的多式联运内存

blocks.en: The capability layer makes tool results interpretable; persistent multimodal memory makes their underlying artifacts addressable and reusable. A later tool call must be able to identify a particular image, mask, or array and access its contents. Repeating a description of a previous result does not provide this access.
blocks.zh: 能力层使工具结果可以解释;持续的多式联运内存使其基本文物可以处理和再利用。 后期的工具呼叫必须能够识别特定图像,面具,或阵列并访问其内容. 重复描述之前的结果并不能提供这种访问.

blocks.en: We maintain an explicit artifact registry for each query, with entries retained across its reasoning trajectory. The registry separates an artifact’s payload from the handle used to reference it. The orchestrator sees available names and compact descriptors, while the harness retains the underlying values and resolves references when needed. The registry contains three categories:
blocks.zh: 我们为每个查询都有一个明确的文物登记册,在其推理轨迹上保留条目。 登记册将文物的有效载荷与用来参照的手柄分开。 管弦乐团看到现有的名称和紧凑的描述符,而管弦乐则保留基本价值,并在必要时解决参考问题。 登记册包括三类:

blocks.en: • Image artifacts: input, tool-generated, and retrieved images, exposed through handles such as input_image_3 and tool_generated_image_6 . Duplicate images reuse an existing registry entry. • Structured data bindings: named values containing boxes, scores, masks, depth arrays, camera parameters, OCR results, and other tool outputs. Each binding has a descriptor identifying its fields and types, including array shapes where applicable. • Web references: retrieved URLs exposed through handles such as webpage_url_1 , allowing later navigation without requiring the model to reproduce the original URL.
blocks.zh: • 支助 图像文物:输入,工具生成,以及检索的图像,通过输入_图像_3和工具_生成_图像_6等手柄曝光. 复制图像重新使用现有登记册条目。 • 结构化数据捆绑:包含盒、分数、口罩、深度阵列、相机参数、OCR结果和其他工具输出的命名值。 每个装订物都有一个描述符,说明其字段和类型,包括适用的阵列形状。 • 支助 网页参考:通过网页_url_1等手柄检索了曝光的URL,允许以后的导航而无需模型复制原URL.

blocks.en: Image artifacts: input, tool-generated, and retrieved images, exposed through handles such as input_image_3 and tool_generated_image_6 . Duplicate images reuse an existing registry entry.
blocks.zh: 图像文物:输入,工具生成,以及检索的图像,通过输入_图像_3和工具_生成_图像_6等手柄曝光. 复制图像重新使用现有登记册条目。

blocks.en: Structured data bindings: named values containing boxes, scores, masks, depth arrays, camera parameters, OCR results, and other tool outputs. Each binding has a descriptor identifying its fields and types, including array shapes where applicable.
blocks.zh: 结构化数据绑定:包含盒,分数,口罩,深度阵列,相机参数,OCR结果等工具输出的命名值. 每个装订物都有一个描述符,说明其字段和类型,包括适用的阵列形状。

blocks.en: Web references: retrieved URLs exposed through handles such as webpage_url_1 , allowing later navigation without requiring the model to reproduce the original URL.
blocks.zh: 网页参考:通过网页_url_1等手柄检索了曝光的URL,允许以后的导航而无需模型复制原URL.

blocks.en: After a successful tool call, the harness registers supported artifacts and associates their handles with the capability’s rendered observation. Images are delivered as visual attachments with named references; structured payloads remain accessible through data bindings. An Environment Update advertises the available image handles, data bindings, and web references after each tool turn, exposing the current namespace without repeating every artifact’s full payload. In the cabinet example, the grounding call adds an overlay image and bindings for the detection data, including bounding boxes and RLE masks.
blocks.zh: 经过一次成功的工具呼叫后,吊带登记册为文物提供了支持,并将其手柄与能力观察联系起来。 图像作为带有命名参考物的可视附件交付;结构有效载荷仍可通过数据绑定方式获取。 Anvironment Update 在每一个工具转弯后, 广告宣传可用的图像手柄、数据绑定和网络引用, 在柜内的例子中,地面呼叫增加了一个覆盖图像和检测数据的约束,包括边框和RLE口罩.

blocks.en: When a subsequent call refers to an artifact, the harness resolves its handle to the input required by the receiving tool. An image handle supplies the image for a later visual operation, a web reference supplies a URL for Webpage Visit, and a data binding supplies values for code execution. The orchestrator can thus reuse the grounding and depth results without reconstructing their contents from earlier descriptions. References connect retained evidence across tools and turns. The detailed representation and handles can be found in Appendix C.4 and Table 19 .
blocks.zh: 当后续的呼叫中提及一件文物时,吊带会将其柄解决为接收工具所需的输入. 一个图像手柄为后来的视觉操作提供图像,一个网络参考物为Webpage访问提供URL,以及一个数据绑定的代码执行提供值. 因此,管弦乐手可以重新利用地面和深度结果,而无需从早先的描述中重新整理其内容。 参考资料将保留的证据连接到各种工具和转弯处。 详细陈述和手柄见附录C.4和表19。

blocks.en: To compute depth within the detected cabinets, the orchestrator delegates a natural-language objective to the Python Coding Agent, such as “compute the average depth within each detected region.” The harness supplies descriptors of the available memory bindings to a fresh code-generation context of the same backbone model. The generated program executes with the actual binding values available as named variables, allowing it to combine the grounding masks with the depth array. Execution results and feedback return in language, with supported output artifacts registered for subsequent reuse. The orchestrator can then use the result or revise the objective in a later call.
blocks.zh: 为了计算检测到的柜子里的深度,管弦乐师向Python编码剂代表一个自然语言的目标,如“计算每个检测到的区域的平均深度”。 吊带为同一主干模型的新的代码生成上下文提供了现有内存的描述符。 生成的程序与作为命名变量的实际约束值一起执行,使其能将地面罩与深度阵列相结合. 执行结果和以语言反馈,支持的产出文物登记后再使用。 管弦乐团随后可以使用结果或者在以后调用中修改目标.

blocks.en: This mechanism also supports filtering detections, aggregating OCR values, and other computations over intermediate results without requiring the orchestrator to serialize large arrays into its request. The capability layer supplies reusable operations and interpretable observations; memory and code execution connect their outputs into longer reasoning procedures.
blocks.zh: 这种机制还支持过滤检测,汇总OCR值,以及其它对中间结果的计算,而不要求管弦乐团将大型阵列序列化为请求. 能力层提供可重复使用的操作和可解释的观察;内存和代码执行将其输出连接到更长的推理程序中.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Qualitative examples of OpenVLHarness. (a) Camera poses, depth, and grounding are combined in code to measure a 3D distance (Example F ). (b) Grounded crops are passed to OCR and image search, and the answer is verified on the web (Example F ). (c) Masks from two grounding queries are reconciled in code to reach the exact count (Example F ).
blocks.zh: 图3:OpenVLHarness的定性实例. (a) 将相机的姿势、深度和地面组合成代码,以测量3D距离(例F)。 (b) 将地面作物转给OCR和图像搜索,并在网络上核实答案(例F)。 (c) 对两个地面查询的面具进行编码核对,以达到准确的计数(例F.)

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows three trajectories from our evaluation. In each, the agent chains several capabilities and reuses their outputs through memory: camera poses, depth maps, and grounding masks become bindings for exact 3D computation (a); grounded crops are passed by identifier to zoom-in, OCR, and image search before the answer is verified on the web (b); and masks from two grounding queries are reconciled in code to correct an undercount (c).
blocks.zh: 图3显示我们评价的三个轨迹。 在每种情况下,代理设备都通过内存将几种能力连锁起来并重新使用其输出:相机姿势、深度图和地面口罩成为精确3D计算的约束(a);在网络上核实答案之前,被植入的作物通过标识符传递到放大器、OCR,以及图像搜索(b);两个地面询问的口罩用代码调节,以纠正一个低估(c)。

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Tasks, Models, and Baselines
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务、模式和基线

blocks.en: We evaluate OpenVLHarness across four task domains spanning 22 datasets, as summarized in Table 1 (splits, sizes, and scoring in Appendix D ): • Grounded perception. Five benchmarks targeting object counting and open-vocabulary visual grounding: CountQA ( Tamarapalli et al., 2025 ) , FSC-147 ( Ranjan et al., 2021 ) , OdinW-13-All ( Li et al., 2022 ) , FSCD-147 ( Nguyen et al., 2022 ) , and FSCD-LVIS ( Nguyen et al., 2022 ) . • Visual search and deep research. Six benchmarks drawn from a suite of 11 multimodal information-seeking tasks: FVQA ( Wu et al., 2025a ) , MMSearch ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) , MMSearch-Plus ( Tao et al., 2026 ) , HLE-VL ( Phan et al., 2025 ) , BrowseComp-VL ( Geng et al., 2026 ) , and RealX-Bench ( Hong et al., 2026a ) ; the remaining five are evaluated in Appendix B.5 . • General VQA and hallucination. Six benchmarks covering general visual question answering and hallucination robustness: RealWorldQA ( xAI, 2024 ) , SimpleVQA ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) , HallusionBench ( Guan et al., 2024 ) , FREAK-VQA ( Yin et al., 2026 ) , FREAK-MCQ ( Yin et al., 2026 ) , and V* ( Wu and Xie, 2024 ) . • Spatial reasoning. Five benchmarks targeting spatial and embodied reasoning: MMSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , ERQA ( Team et al., 2025 ) , EmbSpatial-Bench ( Du et al., 2024 ) , SparBench ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , and MindCube ( Wang et al., 2025c ) .

blocks.en: We instantiate OpenVLHarness on four open-source models across different sizes—Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct ( Qwen Team, 2025a ) , Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Qwen Team, 2025b ) , Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct, and Kimi K3 ( Team et al., 2026 ) —and four proprietary models: GPT-5 ( OpenAI, 2025b ) , GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6 Sol, and GPT-6 Astra ( OpenAI, 2026 ) . Per-model sampling parameters can be found in Appendix C.6 . Because the search APIs, the agent’s tool-routing decisions, and the LLM judge are all stochastic, every Qwen3-VL result, for OpenVLHarness and for all baselines, is the mean of three independent runs with different random seeds, while results with proprietary backbones are single runs because of API cost (standard deviations in Appendix H ). In addition to the no-tool baseline (denoted Base ), we compare OpenVLHarness against two groups of baselines: Training-based baselines : AdaReasoner ( Song et al., 2026 ) , PixelReasoner ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and DeepEyesV2 ( Hong et al., 2026a ) —harnesses that require fine-tuning the backbone to adapt it to the tool-use framework—evaluated with their released Qwen2.5-VL-7B checkpoints (Appendix Table 9 ; setup in Appendix G.2 ). Training-free baselines : Visual Sketchpad ( Hu et al., 2024 ) and OctoTools ( Lu et al., 2025 ) are visual tool-use harnesses evaluated on the same Qwen3-VL backbones as OpenVLHarness (detailed setup in Appendix G.1 ). We additionally evaluate Visual Sketchpad and Codex on GPT-6 Luna.
blocks.zh: 我们在四种不同大小的开源模型上 即时发布OpenVLHarness—— Quen2.5-VL-7B-指令(Quen Team,2025a), Quen3-VL-8B-指令(Quen Team,2025b), Quen3-VL-32B-指令(Team et al,2026)——以及四个专有型号:GPT-5(OpenAI,2025b),GPT-6 Luna,GPT-6 Sol,和GPT-6 Astra(OpenAI,2026). 每个模型的取样参数见附录C.6。 因为搜索API,代理工具路由决定,以及LLM评委都是有条理的,所以OpenVLHarness和所有基线的每个Quen3-VL结果,都是三次独立运行的平均值,随机种子不同,而专有骨干的结果则是单运行,因为API的成本(附录H的标准偏差). 除了无工具基线(已注意到的基数)之外,我们还将OpenVLHarness与两组基线进行比较: 基于培训的基线:AdaReasoner(Song等人,2026年),PixelReasoner (Wang等人,2025年a),和DeepEyesV2(Hong等人,2026年a)——需要调整骨干以适应工具使用框架的机体——用他们发布的Quen2.5-VL-7B检查站(附录表9;附录G.2中设置)来评价。 无培训基线: 视觉Sketchpad(Hu等人,2024年)和OctoTools(Lu等人,2025年)是在与OpenVLHarness(详见附录G.1)相同的Quen3-VL骨干上评价的视觉工具使用套. 我们还在GPT-6 Luna上评估了Visual Sketchpad和Codex.

blocks.en: 3.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Across the evaluated backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average performance over the underlying base model and outperforms all existing training-free harnesses (Table 1 ). On Qwen3-VL-8B, it raises the 22-dataset average from 34.2 34.2 to 45.4 45.4 ( + 11.2 +11.2 ), exceeding the strongest training-free baseline, OctoTools ( 31.8 31.8 ), by 13.6 13.6 points; on Qwen3-VL-32B, the average rises from 38.3 38.3 to 50.9 50.9 ( + 12.6 +12.6 ). The gains extend to GPT-5 ( → 55.7 44.4\!\to\!55.7 ), GPT-6 Sol ( → 64.3 52.7\!\to\!64.3 ), and Kimi K3 ( → 66.1 56.4\!\to\!66.1 ) (Appendix Table 7 ). On the Qwen2.5-VL-7B backbone, OpenVLHarness averages 33.45 33.45 across the 22 datasets, surpassing the training-based baselines AdaReasoner ( 25.29 25.29 ), PixelReasoner ( 28.02 28.02 ), and DeepEyesV2 ( 25.02 25.02 ), without updating model weights (Appendix Table 9 ).
blocks.zh: 在整个受评价的骨干网中,OpenVLHarness比基础模型提高了平均性能,并超越了所有现有的无培训带(表1)。 在Qune3-VL-8B上,将22个数据集的平均值从34.2 34.2提高到45.4 45.4 (+ 11.2 + 11.2),超过了最强的无训练基线, OctoTools(31.8 31.8),乘13.6 13.6分;在Quen3-VL-32B上,平均从38.3 38.3升至50.9 50.9 (+ 12.6 + 12.6). 收益扩展到GPT-5(~55.7 44.4\!to\! 55.7),GPT-6 Sol(~64.3 52.7\!to\! 64.3)和Kimi K3(~66.1 56.4\!66.1). (附录表7). 在Quen2.5-VL-7B骨干上,OpenVLHarness在22个数据集中平均为33.45 33.45,超过了基于训练的基线AdaReasoner(25.29 25.29),PixelReasoner(28.02 28.02)和DeepEyesV2(25.02 25.02),没有更新模型权重. (附录表9).

blocks.en: The GPT-6 results highlight that effective multimodal tool use depends on the harness. With GPT-6 Luna, Codex averages 43.8 43.8 , below the no-tool baseline ( 45.8 45.8 ), while OpenVLHarness reaches 56.5 56.5 . This comparison shows that a coding-agent harness does not automatically improve multimodal reasoning. With GPT-6 Astra, OpenVLHarness improves all 22 benchmarks and raises the average from 60.3 60.3 to 70.2 70.2 , the highest of any backbone.
blocks.zh: GPT-6结果强调,有效使用多式联运工具取决于利用方式。 与GPT-6 Luna一起,Codex平均为43.8 43.8,低于无工具基线(45.8 45.8),而OpenVLHarness则达到56.5 56.5. 这种比较表明,编码代理机的牵引不会自动改善多式联运推理. 有了GPT-6 Astra,OpenVLHarness改进了所有22个基准,并将平均值从60.360.3提高到70.270.2,是任何骨干中最高的.

blocks.en: Grounded perception and visual search and deep research benefit substantially from dedicated vision experts and external retrieval, respectively. Gains on general VQA and hallucination and on spatial reasoning depend more on the backbone: Luna and Astra improve on every benchmark in these domains (Luna by less than one point on RealWorldQA, HallusionBench, and EmbSpatial), with average gains of + 6.5 +6.5 / + 7.5 +7.5 on general VQA and hallucination and + 6.5 +6.5 / + 5.2 +5.2 on spatial reasoning, respectively. This pattern is consistent with greater proficiency in using tools and reasoning over their visual evidence. The less consistent gains on Qwen3-VL-8B motivate the failure analysis and domain specialization in Secs. 3.5 and 3.6 .
blocks.zh: 专注的视觉专家和外部检索对基于认识的感知、视觉搜索和深入研究大有助益。 对一般VQA和幻觉和空间推理的增益更多地取决于骨干:月球和Astra在这些域的每个基准上(Luna在RealWorldQA,Hallusion Bench和EmbSpatial上提高不到一分),在一般VQA和幻觉上的平均增益分别为+6.5+6.5 /+ 7.5,在空间推理上分别是+6.5+6.5/+5.2. 这种模式符合更熟练地使用工具和推理,而不是他们的视觉证据。 对Qune3-VL-8B的不一贯收益促使在3.5和3.6中进行故障分析和域专门化。

blocks.en: 3.3 Can More Reasoning Replace the Harness?
blocks.zh: 3.3 更多理由能否取代利用?

blocks.en: Table 2: Reasoning effort versus harness, by domain. GPT-6 Luna alone (Base) and with Codex (CX), Visual Sketchpad (VS), or OpenVLHarness (Ours) on the full evaluation splits of our 22 22 benchmarks. Rows average each domain’s benchmarks: Grounding (grounded perception, 5 5 ), VS & DR (visual search and deep research, 6 6 ), General VQA (general VQA and hallucination, 6 6 ), and Spatial (spatial reasoning, 5 5 ). $ / 1k questions is the model-token cost at Standard-tier prices, including reasoning tokens and excluding tool execution and judging, averaged over the 22 22 benchmarks. At each effort, bold marks the best score, and in the cost row the cheapest method, with the second cheapest underlined. Low effort is in Appendix Table 13 .
blocks.zh: 表2:按领域分列的合理努力与利用情况。 光是GPT-6 Luna(Base),与Codex(CX),Visual Sketchpad(VS),或OpenVLHarness(Ours)在完全评价我们22个基准的分裂上. 每个域的基准平均行数 : 地面(有根据的感知,5 5 ),VS & DR(视觉搜索和深入研究,6 6 ),General VQA(一般VQA和幻觉,6 6 ),和空间(空间推理,5 5 ). $ / 1k问题是指按标准等级价格计算的模型化成本,包括推理符,不包括工具执行和判断,平均为22项基准。 在每一项努力中,粗体标出最好的分数,在成本排中,最便宜的方法,第二便宜的下划线. 附录表13为低努力率。

blocks.en: OpenVLHarness makes several model calls per question, each carrying tool outputs and memory, so it spends more model tokens than prompting the base model directly. To test whether its gains come simply from extra computation, we run Base, Codex, Visual Sketchpad, and OpenVLHarness with GPT-6 Luna at five reasoning-effort settings, from low to max, on the full evaluation splits of all 22 benchmarks ( 26,229 26{,}229 questions per setting). Figure 1 c reports the 22-benchmark averages against model-token cost, and Table 2 breaks them down by domain.
blocks.zh: OpenVLHarness每个问题都会发出多个模型调用,每个都携带工具输出和内存,因此它花费的模型符号比直接提示基模型要多. 为了测试其收益是否只是来自额外计算,我们用GPT-6 Luna的五个推理-努力设置,从低到最大,运行了Base、Codex、Visual Sketchpad和OpenVLHarness,运行在所有22个基准(每设定26 229 26{,}229个问题)的全部评价分数。 图1c显示22个基准的平均数与模型计算成本比较,表2按领域分列。

blocks.en: Additional effort yields limited gains for the other methods: from low to max effort, Base rises from 44.3 to 48.0 and Visual Sketchpad from 44.7 to 48.8, while Codex, the weakest method at low effort, rises from 36.9 to 48.6. The step from xhigh to max effort alone multiplies their model-token cost by 1.5–2.7. At max effort, all three remain well below OpenVLHarness at medium effort (56.5), which spends at most 37% of their model-token cost per question, and OpenVLHarness at low effort (49.9) is already on par with their max-effort averages. The domain breakdown shows where the harness matters most. On grounded perception and on visual search and deep research, every effort setting of OpenVLHarness, including low, scores above every setting of the other methods, and at max effort it leads the best of them by 15.6 and 12.4 points. On general VQA and hallucination and on spatial reasoning, the harness benefits from more reasoning: at low effort, OpenVLHarness trails Base slightly (61.5 vs. 61.6 and 54.5 vs. 56.5), but from medium effort onward it scores above every setting of every other method in every domain, and at max effort it leads by 6.1 and 7.1 points. Raising the effort of OpenVLHarness itself lifts its average from 56.5 to 60.1. Acquiring and composing multimodal evidence therefore complements stronger reasoning: additional computation remains useful, but does not eliminate the benefit of the harness within the tested budgets. Costs cover model tokens, including reasoning tokens, and exclude tool execution and judging; Appendix B.6 gives the setup, per-benchmark scores, token usage, and how often Codex executes code.
blocks.zh: 其他方法的附加努力收益有限:从低努力到最大努力,Base从44.3升至48.0,Visual Sketchpad从44.7升至48.8,而低努力的最弱方法Codex从36.9升至48.6。 单从x高到最大努力的这一步骤就使其模型模型成本乘以1.5-2.7。 在最大努力时,所有三者在中等努力时都远远低于OpenVLHarness(56.5),而OpenVLHarness在每问题中花费最多37%的模型存储成本,低努力时(49.9)已经与最大努力平均值相当。 域的分解显示绳子最要紧的地方. 基于基于感知以及视觉搜索和深入研究,OpenVLHarness的每一项努力设定,包括低,分数高于其他方法的每一项设定,以最大努力领先其中最好的15.6分和12.4分. 在一般的VQA和幻觉和空间推理方面,利用更多推理的好处:在低努力下,OpenVLHarness线索 基数略微(61.5对61.6和54.5对56.5),但从中等努力上看,它得分高于每个领域所有其他方法的每个设置,最大努力率领先6.1和7.1分。 将OpenVLHarness本身的努力提高,平均从56.5提高到60.1。 因此,获取和编制多式联运证据是对更强有力的推理的补充:额外的计算仍然有用,但并不能消除在经过测试的预算中利用这种证据的好处。 成本包括模型符号,包括推理符号,不包括工具执行和判断;附录B.6给出了设置,每个基准分数,符号使用,以及Codex执行代码的频率.

blocks.en: 3.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 3.4 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 3 examines the two mechanisms introduced in Sec. 2 : the capability layer , which combines task-level tool interfaces with model-facing evidence rendering, followed by persistent multimodal memory , which makes the resulting artifacts addressable and reusable across turns. Starting from the no-tool baseline, we add raw tool access, then the capability layer, and finally memory, using a textual-memory variant as an intermediate comparison (details in Appendix B.2 ).
blocks.zh: 表3审查了第2章中引入的两个机制:能力层,将任务级工具界面与模型化证据渲染相结合,然后是持续的多式联运内存,这使得由此产生的文物可以处理,并可以跨弯路重复使用。 从无工具基线开始,我们添加原始工具访问,然后是能力层,最后是内存,使用文字-记忆变体作为中间比较(详见附录B.2.).

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation study of OpenVLHarness across model scales. We progressively add raw tool access, capability layer, textual memory, and multimodal memory to the no-tool baseline. Results are reported across four domains and overall for Qwen3-VL 8B and 32B models, averaged over three runs; standard deviations are provided in Table 27 . Bold marks the best result in each column.
blocks.zh: 表3:OpenVLHarness跨模型尺度的对比研究. 我们逐渐将原始工具访问、能力层、文字内存和多式联运内存添加到无工具基线中。 关于Qune3-VL 8B和32B模型,报告的结果涉及四个领域,总体而言,平均分为三个周期;标准差见表27。 粗体标出每栏最佳成绩.

blocks.en: Raw tool access raises the overall average by + 3.8 +3.8 points at 8B and + 4.3 +4.3 at 32B, with the largest gains in grounded perception. Adding the capability layer restores full tool schemas and renders heterogeneous outputs into concise observations, yielding another + 3.4 +3.4 and + 3.2 +3.2 points. These gains support the joint value of task-level tool interfaces and model-facing evidence rendering; the comparison does not separate their individual contributions.
blocks.zh: 原始工具访问使8B的总平均值提高3.8+3.8分,32B的总平均值提高4.3+4.3分,在有根据的认知中收益最大。 添加能力层可以恢复完整的工具图案,并使各种输出成为简明的观测结果,产生另一个+3.4+3.4和+3.2+3.2分. 这些收益支持任务级工具接口和模型化证据提供的共同价值;比较并不区分各自的贡献。

blocks.en: Adding textual memory enables structured data bindings, web references, and Environment Updates, but represents tool-generated images only through descriptions, without reusable image handles. This adds + 0.7 +0.7 points at 8B and + 0.3 +0.3 at 32B. Completing persistent multimodal memory with visual attachments and reusable image handles adds a further + 3.1 +3.1 and + 4.5 +4.5 , bringing the full harness to 47.1 47.1 and 52.5 52.5 . The largest gains from this final step occur in visual search and deep research ( + 6.2 +6.2 / + 3.5 +3.5 ), with additional gains in spatial reasoning ( + 2.8 +2.8 / + 3.1 +3.1 ). The results support the method’s complementary mechanisms: interpretable tool observations, followed by retained multimodal artifacts that can be revisited and composed across turns.
blocks.zh: 添加文字内存可以实现结构化的数据绑定,网页引用,以及环境更新,但只能通过描述来代表工具生成的图像,没有可重复使用的图像手柄. 这增加了8B的+0.7+0.7分,32B的+0.3+0.3分. 完成具有视觉附件和可重复使用的图像手柄的持久多式内存,又增加了+3.1+3.1和+4.5+4.5,使全机控制器达到47.1 47.1和52.5 52.5.5. 这一最后步骤的最大收益出现在视觉搜索和深入研究(+6.2+6.2 / +3.5+3.5 ) , 空间推理(+2.8+2.8 / + 3.1+3.1 ) 。 结果支持了该方法的补充机制:可解释工具观测,然后是可重新审视和交叉构成的留存的多式联运文物。

blocks.en: 3.5 Failure Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.5 失败分析

blocks.en: We use Kimi K3 to critique 9,893 9{,}893 failed Qwen3-VL-8B trajectories across 22 benchmarks. Given the question, answer, images, trajectory, and toolbox, the critic assesses each tool call and identifies the trajectory’s primary failure cause and proposes a fix. Its labels agree with human annotations on 92 % 92\% of 100 sampled failures. The protocol, coverage, and taxonomy are detailed in Appendix E.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们用Kimi K3来批评 9,893 9{,}893 失败 Quen3-VL-8B 轨迹跨越22个基准. 考虑到问题、答案、图像、轨迹和工具箱,评论家评估每个工具的调用,并找出轨迹的主要故障原因并提出一个固定方案。 它的标签与人类对100个抽样失败中的92%的注释一致. 协议、覆盖范围和分类详见附录E.1。

blocks.en: Surprisingly, we find that failure patterns differ across domains (Fig. 4 a). Despite substantial overall gains, grounded perception remains challenging in crowded images with more than 25 objects, where missed or merged instances limit exhaustive detection. Such perception errors account for the dominant “incorrect tool output” category ( 75 % 75\% of failures in this domain). Failures in visual search and deep research most often involve an omitted tool call ( 49 % 49\% ), while failures in spatial reasoning and in general VQA and hallucination involve both omitted tool calls and reasoning errors, consistent with our hypothesis that the model has limited proficiency in spatial reasoning and tool use. Failures involving unusable or ignored correct tool outputs are uncommon ( 3 3 – 8 % 8\% across domains), suggesting that the capability layer generally presents retrieved evidence in a usable form.
blocks.zh: 令人惊讶的是,我们发现不同领域的失败模式不同(图4a)。 尽管总体取得了显著进展,但是在超过25个物体的拥挤图像中,有据可查的感知仍然具有挑战性,因为缺失或合并的事例限制了详尽无遗的探测。 这种感知错误是主要“不正确的工具输出”类别(该领域75%的失败)。 视觉搜索和深层研究的失败最常涉及省略的工具调用(49%49\%),而空间推理和一般的VQA和幻觉的失败同时涉及省略的工具调用和推理错误,这与我们的假设一致,即模型在空间推理和工具使用方面的熟练程度有限. 涉及无法使用或被忽略的正确工具输出的失败是罕见的(3 3 - 8 % 8 - ) , 这表明能力层一般以可用形式呈现出检索到的证据。

blocks.en: Failure causes alone do not determine how to specialize the harness: an omitted call may require clearer instructions or a new composition of tools. We therefore combine the cause and proposed fix into remedy channels (Fig. 4 b). Constructing new task-specific tools can make evidence interpretation explicit (A), enforce systematic verification, filtering of tool results (B), or supply a missing tool composition (C). In contrast, harness text changes (Y)—edits to the system prompt, tool descriptions, and output messages—guide the model to call existing tools when needed and use their results appropriately. The remaining channel (Z) covers cases without a proposed remedy. These diagnostic recommendations guide optimization rather than predict recoverable accuracy, since the critique covers only failed trajectories. Exact mapping rules and per-dataset shares are in Appendix E.2 .
blocks.zh: 失败原因本身不能决定如何专门利用:省略的调用可能需要更明确的指令或新的工具组成. 因此,我们综合了这一原因,并提议确定补救渠道(图4b)。 构建新的针对特定任务的工具可以使证据解释明确(A),执行系统的核查,过滤工具结果(B),或者提供缺失的工具组成(C). 与此相对照,利用文本变化(Y)——将文本编辑到系统即时、工具描述和输出信息——指导模型在需要时调用现有工具并适当使用其结果。 其余渠道(Z)覆盖案件,但无拟议补救办法。 这些诊断性建议指导优化,而不是预测可收回的准确性,因为批评只涉及失败的轨迹。 精确绘图规则和每套数据份额见附录E.2。

blocks.en: 3.6 Harness Optimization
blocks.zh: 3.6 优化利用

blocks.en: Figure 4: Failure diagnosis and harness specialization with Qwen3-VL-8B. We critique failure trajectories using Kimi K3. (a) Distribution of failure causes across four domains. (b) Proposed remedies: grouped into creating task-specific tools (A–C), updating harness text (Y), and no proposed remedy (Z). (c) Four datasets selected for contrasting remedy profiles: Y (orange) dominates ERQA and RealWorldQA, while A–C (blue) dominates SparBench and FREAK-VQA. (d) Gains from harness search and tool generation over the unoptimized harness. Harness search is more effective on datasets dominated by text-level changes, while tool generation yields larger gains when task-specific tools are preferred.
blocks.zh: 图 4: 与Qune3-VL-8B的失败诊断和利用专业化. 我们用Kimi K3来批评故障轨迹。 (a) 失败原因在四个领域的分布。 (b) 拟议的补救办法:分为创建特定任务工具(A-C),更新利用文本(Y),没有拟议的补救办法(Z)。 (c) 为对比补救剖面选择的4个数据集:Y(橙色)主导ERQA和RealWorldQA,A-C(蓝色)主导Spar Bench和FREAK-VQA。 (d) 利用搜索和工具生成对未优化的利用的收益。 在以文本级别变化为主的数据集上,Harness搜索更加有效,而工具生成则在偏爱特定任务工具时产生更大的收益.

blocks.en: When adapting OpenVLHarness to a custom domain, users can use failures on their own data to identify which parts of the harness need refinement. We provide two coding-agent-driven workflows for specializing the general-purpose harness without updating model weights. Harness search edits system prompts, tool descriptions, and evidence-rendering templates, selecting candidates through repeated evaluation. Tool generation implements and refines task-specific tools by composing existing capabilities (algorithms in Appendix E.3 ). To compare them, we select four datasets with contrasting remedy profiles (Fig. 4 c): harness text changes (Y) dominate ERQA ( 71 % 71\% ) and RealWorldQA ( 56 % 56\% ), whereas task-specific tools (A+B+C) dominate SparBench ( 75 % 75\% ) and FREAK-VQA ( 62 % 62\% ). We run both workflows on all four datasets with Qwen3-VL-8B, testing whether their relative benefits align with these profiles.
blocks.zh: 在将OpenVLHarness修改为自定义域时,用户可以在自己的数据上使用故障来识别哪些部分的拉带需要完善. 我们提供两个编码-代理驱动的工作流程,用于专门使用通用控制,而不更新模型权重。 Harness搜索会编辑系统提示,工具描述,以及证据提交模板,通过重复评价来选择候选人. 工具生成通过整合现有能力(附录E.3中的算法),执行和完善特定任务工具. 为了比较它们,我们选择了四个与对比性补救配置(图4c)相匹配的数据集:控制文本变化(Y)主导ERQA(71% 71\%)和RealWorldQA(56% 56\%),而任务特定工具(A+B+C)主导Spar Bench(75% 75\%)和FREAK-VQA(62% 62\%)。 我们在使用Qune3-VL-8B的所有四个数据集上运行两个工作流程,测试它们的相对效益是否与这些配置一致.

blocks.en: The results follow this distinction (Fig. 4 d). Harness search improves ERQA and RealWorldQA by + 4.1 +4.1 and + 3.7 +3.7 points, compared with + 0.2 +0.2 and + 0.1 +0.1 from tool generation. Conversely, tool generation improves SparBench and FREAK-VQA by + 8.2 +8.2 and + 4.5 +4.5 , while harness search yields − 0.5 -0.5 and − 1.0 -1.0 . The generated tools compute metric 3D relations on SparBench and make visibility decisions explicit on FREAK-VQA, matching the missing-composition and evidence-interpretation needs identified by the critique (Table 24 ). These results suggest a practical approach to adaptation on custom data: diagnose the prevailing failures, then use harness search to improve the use of existing capabilities or tool generation to add the task-specific operations the domain requires.
blocks.zh: 结果遵循这一区别(图4d)。 Harness search使ERQA和RealWorldQA提高了+4.1+4.1和+3.7+3.7的分数,而工具生成时的+0.2+0.2和+0.1+0.1. 反之,工具生成提高了Spar Bench和FREAK-VQA的+8.2+8.2和+4.5+4.5,同时利用搜索结果−0.5-0.5和−1.0-1.0。 生成的工具计算了Spar Bench上的3D关系,并明确了FREAK-VQA的能见度决定,与批评中查明的缺失组合和证据解释需求相匹配(表24)。 这些结果建议了一种实用的方法来适应自定义数据:诊断普遍存在的失败,然后利用“利用”搜索来改进现有能力或工具生成的利用,以添加域所需的特定任务操作。

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: Early visual tool-use work treats the problem as program synthesis, compiling a question into a sequential plan that invokes vision tools in a pipeline to produce an answer ( Surís et al., 2023 ; Gupta and Kembhavi, 2023 ; Kamali and Kordjamshidi, 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2023b ; Gao et al., 2023 ; Castrejon et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Menon et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; You et al., 2023 ) ; because these plans are fixed in place, they cannot be adjusted based on tool execution results. A later line adopts multi-turn frameworks that interleave reasoning with visual feedback, but depends on brittle, task-specific framework designs that require extensive training to work ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025a ; Song et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2026a ; Su et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) , and many domain-specific visual tool-use frameworks fall into the same category ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2025a ; Narayan et al., 2025 ; Geng et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025d ) . Closest to our setting, Visual Sketchpad ( Hu et al., 2024 ) and OctoTools ( Lu et al., 2025 ) are training-free tool-use frameworks built around manually designed tool interfaces and execution strategies. In contrast, we focus on making the harness itself more adaptable, so its evidence processing and tool composition can be specialized as tools, MLLMs, and target tasks evolve.
blocks.zh: 早期的视觉工具使用工作将问题视为程序合成,将一个问题汇编成一个顺序计划,在管道中引用视觉工具生成答案(Surís等人,2023年;Gupta和Kembhavi,2023年;Kamari和Kordjamshidi,2026年;赵等人,2025年;Wu等人,2023年;Yang等人,2023年b;Gao等人,2023年;Castrejon等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2026年b;Zhou等人,2024年;Menon等人,2024年b). 2024; 陈等. 2024b; You et al., 2023 ) ;因为这些计划已经固定到位,因此无法根据工具执行结果进行调整. 后一行采用多回合框架,将推理与视觉反馈相衔接,但取决于需要广泛培训才能发挥作用的具体任务框架设计(马等人,2025年;周等人,2025年a); Song等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025年a;Zheng等人,2025年a;Hong等人,2026年a;Su等人,2025年b;Wu等人,2025年b;Zhao等人,2026年b),许多特定领域的视觉工具使用框架属于同一类别(Chen等人,2025年a; Wu等人,2025a;Narayan等人,2025;Geng等人,2026;Huang等人,2026;Yao等人,2026;Yang等人,2026;Du等人,2026;Wang等人,2025d). 最贴近我们的设定,Visual Sketchpad(Hu等人,2024年)和OctoTools(Lu等人,2025年)是围绕人工设计的工具界面和执行策略构建的无培训工具使用框架. 与此相对照,我们注重使这种利用本身更具适应性,因此随着工具、MLLMs和目标任务的发展,其证据处理和工具组成可以具有专门性。

blocks.en: Language agents maintain intermediate information to support reasoning and action across multiple steps. Context management approaches further separate compact model-visible state from more detailed external information, enabling the agent to selectively recover relevant content when needed ( Packer et al., 2023 ; Lee et al., 2024 ) . Tool-using agents have also introduced explicit mechanisms for passing intermediate results across actions. ReWOO ( Xu et al., 2023 ) represents tool evidence through referenceable variables, while CodeAct ( Wang et al., 2024a ) maintains intermediate results as variables in an executable interpreter. HuggingGPT ( Shen et al., 2023 ) and LLMCompiler ( Kim et al., 2024 ) go further in using symbolic references to intermediate tool outputs that are resolved when executing dependent downstream calls. Building on these ideas, OpenVLHarness extends them to the multimodal setting, maintaining a unified registry of typed artifacts spanning images, structured data, and web evidence. It exposes compact model-facing handles while preserving the underlying artifacts for later inspection, composition, and reuse through modality-appropriate downstream tools.
blocks.zh: 语言代理人维持中间信息,以支持跨多个步骤的推理和行动. 上下文管理方法进一步将紧凑的模型可见状态与更详细的外部信息分开,使代理人能够在需要时有选择地回收相关内容(Packer等人,2023年;Lee等人,2024年)。 使用工具的代理人还引入了明确的机制,将中间结果通过各种行动。 ReWOO(Xu等人,2023年)通过可参考变量代表工具证据,而CodeAct(Wang等人,2024年a)在可执行解释器中将中间结果作为变量保持. HuggingGPT(Shen等人,2023年)和LLMCompiller(Kim等人,2024年)更进一步地使用符号引用中间工具输出,执行依赖下游呼叫时解决. 基于这些想法,OpenVLHarness将其扩展至多式联运设置,维持一个覆盖图像、结构化数据和网络证据的打字文物统一登记册。 它暴露了紧凑的模型造型手柄,同时通过适合模式的下游工具保留了基本的文物,供以后检查、组成和再利用。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented OpenVLHarness, a general harness for real-world visual agentic tool use built around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, enabling the orchestrator to invoke heterogeneous tools and inspect their outputs. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding artifacts for reuse across turns, including computation over stored data through a Python Coding Agent. Together, these mechanisms support reasoning that acquires and composes multimodal evidence. Evaluation across 22 benchmarks and eight backbones demonstrates broad gains, while component ablations show the incremental benefits of the capability layer and multimodal memory. Harness search and tool generation further specialize the system on selected domains without updating the underlying MLLM weights. We release the harness, tools, evaluation protocols, and optimization workflows to support further work on multimodal tool-use agents.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了OpenVLHarness,这是围绕一个能力层和持续的多式联运内存而构建的用于现实世界视觉代理工具的一般工具。 能力层将任务级工具界面与证据渲染相结合,使管弦乐团能够引用多种工具并检查其产出. 持续的多模式内存保留了相应的文物供跨转弯重用,包括通过Python编码代理计算存储的数据. 这些机制共同支持获得和构成多式联运证据的推理。 22个基准和8个主干网的评价显示取得了广泛成果,而组成部分显示能力层和多式联运记忆的增益。 Harness搜索和工具生成使系统在选定的域上进一步专业化,而没有更新基本的MLLM权重. 我们释放各种手段、工具、评价协议和优化工作流程,以支持关于多式联运工具代理人的进一步工作。

Table 1 reports the accuracy of OpenVLHarness. This section characterizes the behavior

blocks.zh:
表1报告OpenVLHarness的准确性. 本节描述行为

blocks.en:
Section A.3 compares OpenVLHarness against the Base columns of
Tables 1 and 7 on a per-question basis: both arms answer the same questions and are
scored with the same dataset metric, and differences are averaged over paired rows. This design supports
statements about individual capabilities, since the rows on which a given tool was invoked can be
isolated and both arms evaluated on that subset. The resulting quantities are correlational rather than
causal: the agent selects the rows on which it invokes a tool, and the remaining capabilities are
available on those rows as well. Each per-tool measurement is therefore reported alongside a control,
namely the same paired difference computed on the rows that did not invoke the tool. A capability whose
two values coincide is not, on its own, responsible for the observed gain. The control is a complement
set, so its composition depends on how often the capability is invoked: for a capability used on a small
fraction of questions the control approximates the model’s overall gain, whereas for one used on the
majority of questions the control is a small and atypical remainder.

blocks.en: This section reports results with additional backbones (GPT-5, GPT-6 Sol, and Kimi K3), gives details of the ablation in Table 3 , compares OpenVLHarness with training-based harnesses, analyzes grounded perception across object counts, extends the visual search and deep research results to 11 11 information-seeking benchmarks, and tests whether additional reasoning can replace the harness.

blocks.en: B.2 Ablation Study Details
blocks.zh: B.2 详细分析

blocks.en: The ablation in Table 3 isolates the contribution of each harness component by building a strict superset ladder: every rung adds exactly one mechanism to the one below it, so the gap between adjacent rungs measures that mechanism’s marginal value.
blocks.zh: 表3的萎缩通过建立一个严格的超定式阶梯来隔离每个牵引部件的贡献:每个牵引装置在它的下方都精确地增加了一个机制,所以相邻的牵引装置测量机制的边际价值之间的间隙.

blocks.en: The five rungs are:
blocks.zh: 这五个组是:

blocks.en: 1. Baseline (no tool). The backbone model prompted directly with the question image and no tool access, establishing the no-harness floor. 2. + Tool. The nine tools are available, but their payloads arrive as raw dumps, their schema is cut to a minimal signature (name, argument names and types, one clause each), and nothing persists between turns: no environment updates, no image labels, no data bindings, no URL references. Tool-generated images are replaced by a short stub. 3. + Capability layer. Adds the capability layer of Sec. 2.1 : each tool’s raw payload is replaced by a per-tool post-processor that condenses it into a concise, model-readable summary (e.g. grounding boxes on a 0–1000 grid, reranked search results with inline citations, depth/zoom captions), and the full tool schema is restored so the model is told when to reach for each tool and how to phrase its arguments. No memory is present—nothing is carried across turns. 4. + Textual memory. Adds every memory mechanism that is addressed by a text handle: per-turn Environment Updates that re-advertise all live state, webpage_url_N references that let the agent revisit a URL, and out-of-context data bindings that the Python Coding Agent can read as typed variables. Tool-generated images are replaced by a VLM-written text description (up to 160 tokens) conditioned on the original question. Image references remain absent: tool-produced images cannot be named, stored, or passed to a later tool call. 5. OpenVLHarness (full). Adds multimodal image memory: every tool-produced image is labeled ( tool_generated_image_N ), deduplicated by content, and kept addressable. The model selects which image to pass to each tool call by its identifier, enabling compositions such as grounding → \to zoom → \to OCR → \to search.

OpenVLHarness(全). 添加多模式图像内存:每个工具制作的图像都贴上标签(工具_生成_image_N),按内容进行复制,并保持可地址. 模型选择哪个图像通过标识符传递给每个工具的调用,允许像地面 →\to 放大 →\to OCR →\to 搜索这样的组成.

blocks.en: All five variants share the same nine-tool toolset, backbone weights, and decoding configuration (temperature 0.7 0.7 , top- p p 0.8 0.8 , top- k k 20 20 , repetition penalty 1.0 1.0 , presence penalty 1.5 1.5 , up to 12,800 12{,}800 generated tokens per turn, 15 15 tool-calling iterations, 168 168 K-token context cap). They differ only in the ablation preset applied to the memory stack: a configuration block that switches individual mechanisms (environment updates, image identifiers, per-tool post-processors, data bindings, URL references) on or off. Each preset is a strict superset of the one below it, validated at initialization so a typo fails the run rather than silently selecting the wrong baseline. Table 8 summarizes the knob settings for each variant.
blocks.zh: 所有五个变体都拥有相同的9个工具箱,骨干重量,以及解码配置(温度0.7 0.7,顶端-p 0.8 0.8,顶端-k k 20 20,重复处罚1.0 1.0,存在处罚1.5 1.5,最高12 800 12{,}800 个每个转弯生成的代币,15 15个工具调迭代,168 168 K-token上下文盖). 它们仅在适用于内存堆栈的预设上有所不同:一个配置块,可以打开或关闭单个机制(环境更新,图像标识符,每个工具的后处理器,数据绑定,URL引用). 每个预设是下面一个的严格超组合,在初始化时验证,所以一个two不能运行,而不是默默地选择错误的基准. 表8汇总了每个变体的旋钮设置.

blocks.en: Table 8: Ablation knob settings for each variant in Table 3 . “Post-proc.” refers to per-tool output processors (custom vs. raw dumps). “Env update” is the per-turn Environment Update message. “Bindings” are out-of-context typed data bindings. “URL refs” and “Image refs” are symbolic identifiers for web pages and tool-generated images, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表8:表3中每个变体的缩放键设置。 “Env更新”是每回合环境更新信息。 “Bindings”是输入格式外的数据约束。 “URL refs”和“Image refs”分别是网页和工具生成的图像的象征性标识符。

blocks.en: Each variant is evaluated on 22 datasets spanning all four domains in Table 1 . For efficiency, datasets with more than 500 samples are subsampled to 500 examples with a fixed random seed ( 42 42 ) shared across all variants, so every rung sees exactly the same instances. All reported numbers are means of three independent runs with different sampling seeds. Domain averages in Table 3 are macro-averages over the datasets in each domain.
blocks.zh: 每个变体在表1涵盖所有四个领域的22个数据集中进行评价。 为了提高效率,有500多个样本的数据集被子取样到500个例子,所有变种共享一个固定的随机种子(42 42 ),所以每个rung都看到完全相同的例子. 所有报告的数字都是用不同取样种子进行三次独立运行的手段。 表3中的域平均数是每个域数据集的宏观平均数。

blocks.en: B.3 Training-Based Baselines
blocks.zh: B.3 基于培训的基线

blocks.en: Table 9: Training-based baselines on the Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct backbone. AdaReasoner, PixelReasoner, and DeepEyesV2 fine-tune the backbone to adapt it to their tool-use harness; OpenVLHarness is training-free and uses the same weights out of the box. Training-based columns are gray; shaded rows are per-domain averages. Bold marks the best result in each row.
blocks.zh: 表9:基于Quen2.5-VL-7B-指令骨干的培训基线。 AdaReasoner,PixelReasoner,和DeepEyesV2对骨干进行了微调,使其适应其工具使用利用率;OpenVLHarness是无训练的,并且使用箱外相同的重量. 基于训练的栏是灰色的;阴影的栏是每个域的平均值. 粗体标出每行最好的成绩.

blocks.en: Table 9 compares OpenVLHarness with the three training-based harnesses on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, the base model all three are fine-tuned from (setup in Appendix G.2 ). Averaged over the 22 22 datasets, OpenVLHarness reaches 33.45 33.45 , ahead of PixelReasoner ( 28.02 28.02 ), AdaReasoner ( 25.29 25.29 ), and DeepEyesV2 ( 25.02 25.02 ), without updating any weights.
blocks.zh: 表9 比较 OpenVLHarness在Quen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct上搭载了三种基于训练的牵引装置,这三种基本模型都从(附录G.2中的设置)进行微调. 平均在22个数据集中,OpenVLHarness达到33.45 33.45,领先于PixelReasoner(28.02 28.02),AdaReasoner(25.29 25.29)和DeepEyesV2(25.02 25.02),但没有更新任何权重.

blocks.en: The margin is largest on grounded perception ( 23.05 23.05 vs. at most 10.41 10.41 ) and on visual search and deep research ( 19.91 19.91 vs. at most 15.59 15.59 ). The training-based harnesses are optimized for a fixed tool set and answer style: they rarely produce the dense, well-formed box lists that FSCD and OdinW require, and none of them retrieves web evidence in our setup, so knowledge-intensive search questions fall back on the 7B model’s parametric knowledge. On general VQA and hallucination and on spatial reasoning, which resemble their training distributions, the gap narrows ( 50.58 50.58 vs. 49.32 49.32 and 39.54 39.54 vs. 39.37 39.37 ), and the trained models are best on a few perception-centric datasets such as RealWorldQA and V*, where PixelReasoner’s learned zoom-in behavior pays off. Training a model into one tool protocol thus helps in-distribution but transfers poorly, whereas a training-free harness can cover all four domains with the same weights.
blocks.zh: 根据有根据的认知(23.05 23.05对最多10.41 10.41)和视觉搜索和深入研究(19.91 19.91对最多15.59 15.59),差值最大。 基于训练的套装被优化为固定的工具集和答题风格:它们很少产生FSCD和OdinW所需要的密集,造型完善的盒式列表,而且它们都没有在我们的设置中检索到网络证据,因此知识密集型的搜索问题回到7B模型的参数化知识上. 关于一般的VQA和幻觉以及空间推理,这与他们的训练分布相似,差距缩小(50.58 50.58对49.32 49.32和39.54 39.54对39.37 39.37),受过训练的模型最好使用一些以感知为中心的数据集,如RealWorldQA和V*,PixelReasoner所学的放大行为在其中得到回报。 因此,将一个模型培训成一个工具协议有助于分配,但转让却很差,而无培训的利用可以涵盖所有四个领域,其权重相同。

blocks.en: Absolute scores with OpenVLHarness on Qwen2.5-VL-7B are well below those on Qwen3-VL (Table 1 ). Because the harness relies on the backbone to plan tool calls and to follow output conventions, a weaker orchestrator limits its benefit; on OdinW-13-All, for example, OpenVLHarness reaches only 7.80 7.80 AP with Qwen2.5-VL-7B versus 50.40 50.40 with Qwen3-VL-8B. The harness therefore benefits directly from stronger backbones, with no retraining when a new backbone is adopted.
blocks.zh: Quen2.5-VL-7B上的OpenVLHarness绝对分数远低于Quen3-VL上的绝对分数(表1). 由于牵引力依赖于主干线来规划工具调用并遵循输出惯例,一个较弱的管弦乐手限制了它的效益;例如,在OdinW-13-All上,OpenVLHarness只达到7.80 7.80 AP用Quen2.5-VL-7B对用Qune3-VL-8B对用 Qune3-VL-8B对用 50.40 50.40. 因此,这种利用直接受益于更强大的骨干,在采用新的骨干时没有再培训。

blocks.en: B.4 Grounded Perception Across Object Counts
blocks.zh: B.4 整个物体计数的底觉

blocks.en: Most counting and grounding benchmarks rarely test models at high object counts, which can make headline scores misleading. To make this concrete, we bin every sample of widely used counting and grounding datasets by its number of target objects (Figures 9 and 10 ). For counting, TallyQA ( Acharya et al., 2019 ) , CountBenchQA ( Paiss et al., 2023 ) , and PixmoCount place essentially all samples at ten or fewer objects; only FSC-147 and FSCD-LVIS contribute meaningful mass above 50 50 objects. Grounding is even more skewed: referring-expression datasets such as RefCOCO/+/g ( Kazemzadeh et al., 2014 ; Yu et al., 2016 ; Mao et al., 2016 ) , Ref-L4 ( Chen et al., 2024a ) , and GroundingME ( Li et al., 2025a ) ground exactly one target per sample, and detection-style benchmarks such as OdinW-13 and LVIS are dominated by a single object per image ( 97 % 97\% and 86 % 86\% of samples in the 0 0 – 1 1 bucket). Dense, many-object grounding appears only in the FSCD variants. This is why our suite includes FSC-147, FSCD-147, and FSCD-LVIS, and why we break their results down by object count below.
blocks.zh: 大多数计数和基准基数都很少在高对象计数时测试模型,这可能会使头条分数产生误导. 为了制作这个混凝土,我们将每个被广泛使用的计数和地面数据集的样本按其目标对象的数量(图9和10)进行嵌入. 为计数,TallyQA(Acharya等人,2019年),BenchQA伯爵(Paiss等人,2023年),PixmoCount将所有样本基本放在10个或更少的物体上;只有FSC-147和FSCD-LVIS贡献了50个以上的有意义的质量. 定位更偏斜:参考表达数据集,如ReRCCO/+/g (Kazemzadeh等人,2014年;Yu等人,2016年;Mao等人,2016年),Ref-L4 (Chen等人,2024a),以及GroundingME(Li等人,2025a) 将每个样本精确地一个目标地面,OdinW-13和LVIS等检测型基准以每个图像一个单一对象为主(0–1桶样本的97%97\%和86%86\%). Dense,许多对象的抛物只出现在FSCD变体中. 这就是为什么我们的套间包括FSC-147,FSCD-147,和FSCD-LVIS,为什么我们用下面的对象计数来细分它们的结果.

blocks.en: Table 10 breaks down FSC-147 and FSCD-LVIS by the number of ground-truth objects, using the bins defined above. On FSC-147, OpenVLHarness improves exact-match accuracy in every bucket, with the largest gains between 11 11 and 50 50 objects (e.g., 5.0 → 32.9 5.0\to 32.9 at 8B for 21 21 – 50 50 ), where the base models’ accuracy collapses. On FSCD-LVIS, where every image has at least 21 21 instances, the base models recover almost none of the instances (F1 ≤ 12.5 \leq 12.5 ), whereas OpenVLHarness reaches F1 above 56 56 up to 100 100 instances and around 41 41 beyond. Accuracy nevertheless falls steeply with count for every configuration: above 100 100 objects exact counting remains essentially unsolved, confirming that the high-count regime is where the most headroom lies.
blocks.zh: 表10使用上文定义的垃圾箱,将FSC-147和FSCD-LVIS按地面真实物体的数目分列。 在FSC-147上,OpenVLHarness提高了每桶精确匹配的精度,在11个11到50个物体(如5.0~32.9 5.0\to 32.9在8B为21 – 50 50)之间获得的最大收益,基础模型的精度在此崩溃. 在FSCD-LVIS上,每个图像至少有21个实例,基本模型几乎没有恢复任何实例(F1 ≤ 12.5\leq 12.5),而OpenVLHarness则达到F1高于56 56至100例,超过41例。 然而,准确性随着每个配置的计数而急剧下降:100多个精确计数的物体基本上仍未解决,这证实高计数制度是头室最多的。

blocks.en: Table 10: Grounded perception performance by number of ground-truth objects. FSCD-LVIS is scored with instance-level F1 (predicted boxes matched to ground truth at IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 ) because AP is not defined per sample.

blocks.en: Table 11 reports complementary counting metrics and an additional grounding benchmark. OpenVLHarness lowers the mean absolute error on FSC-147 and raises CountQA relative accuracy, showing that it also reduces large miscounts rather than only fixing near misses. On LVIS (federated val), which queries both present and absent categories over 1,203 1{,}203 classes, OpenVLHarness more than doubles AP at both scales ( 18.1 → 45.2 18.1\to 45.2 at 8B and 22.9 → 45.5 22.9\to 45.5 at 32B).
blocks.zh: 表11报告补充计算指标和另一个基准。 OpenVLHarness降低了FSC-147上的平均绝对误差,提高了伯爵QA的相对准确性,表明它也减少了大错数,而不是仅仅固定在接近误差的地方. 关于LVIS(联合会Val),它询问了1 203 1{,}203类以上的现有和缺席类别,OpenVLHarness在两个尺度上都比AP多一倍(8B时为18.1 – 45.2 18.1\to 45.2,32B时为22.9 – 45.5 22.9\to 45.5)。

blocks.en: Table 11: Complementary counting metrics and LVIS grounding. MAE is the mean absolute counting error; RA@ k k is the share of predictions within k % k\% of the ground truth.
blocks.zh: 表11:补充计算指标和LVIS定位。 MAE是平均绝对计数错误; RA@ kk是占地面真实度的K% k%的预测比例.

blocks.en: B.5 Extended Visual Search and Deep Research Results
blocks.zh: B.5 扩展视觉搜索和深入研究结果

blocks.en: Table 12 extends the search results to 11 11 information-seeking benchmarks, including five that are not in Table 1 . The agent workflow improves every backbone: the average across the 11 11 benchmarks rises from 13.74 13.74 to 29.05 29.05 for Qwen3-VL-8B, from 19.21 19.21 to 34.61 34.61 for Qwen3-VL-32B, and from 31.58 31.58 to 41.80 41.80 for GPT-5. Gains are largest for the open models, whose parametric knowledge is most limited; GPT-5’s direct-inference accuracy is additionally depressed by refusals on identity queries (Appendix D.2 ). With the harness, Qwen3-VL-32B surpasses direct GPT-5 on average ( 34.61 34.61 vs. 31.58 31.58 ).

blocks.en: B.6 Reasoning-Effort Study: Setup and Full Results
blocks.zh: B.6 理由研究:设置和全面结果

blocks.en: OpenVLHarness answers a question over several model calls, and each call carries tool outputs and memory, so it spends more model tokens per question than prompting the base model directly. This raises the question of whether the harness helps simply by spending more compute: a reasoning model given a larger token budget might recover the gain by reasoning for longer. GPT-6 Luna exposes a reasoning-effort setting, which lets us test this directly by raising the effort of every method, including OpenVLHarness. Section 3.3 and Figure 1 c summarize the results. Table 13 reports domain averages and costs, Table 14 the tokens per question behind the costs, Table 15 how often Codex executes code, and Table 16 the per-benchmark scores.
blocks.zh: OpenVLHarness通过几个模型调用回答一个问题,每个调用都带有工具输出和内存,因此每个调用模型的符号比直接提示基模型要多. 这就提出了这样一个问题,即这种利用是否仅仅通过花费更多的计算有所帮助:一个给一个更大的象征性预算的推理模型可能会通过推理更长的时间来恢复收益。 GPT-6 Luna 暴露了一个推理-努力设置,它让我们通过提高包括OpenVLHarness在内的每一种方法的努力来直接测试这一点. 第3.3节和图1c概述了结果。 表13报告了域平均数和成本,表14是成本背后每个问题的代号,表15是Codex执行代码的频率,表16是每个基准的分数。

blocks.en: We run Base, Codex, Visual Sketchpad, and OpenVLHarness with GPT-6 Luna at five reasoning-effort settings (low, medium, high, xhigh, and max) on the full evaluation splits of all 22 22 benchmarks of Table 1 , that is, 26,229 26{,}229 questions per setting and 524,580 524{,}580 in total. Each method keeps its configuration from Table 1 and Appendix G.1 , and the medium-effort setting is the configuration reported in Table 1 . Apart from the effort, only two settings change. First, Base, Visual Sketchpad, and OpenVLHarness may produce up to 16,000 16{,}000 output tokens per model call, raised to 64,000 64{,}000 at max effort so that reasoning is not truncated; Codex uses its own default limit. Second, GPT-6 Luna accepts max effort only through the Responses API, so Base switches to that API at max effort; OpenVLHarness and Codex use it at every setting, and the Chat Completions requests of Visual Sketchpad are translated to it at every setting. The Python Coding Agent of OpenVLHarness uses the same reasoning effort as the orchestrator. Codex is the Codex CLI agent ( OpenAI, 2025a , see Appendix G.1 ) : every question runs in a fresh session with the image attached and web search disabled to prevent the model from searching the web for the benchmark’s gold answer, and model-written code executes in a read-only sandbox enforced with Landlock and seccomp. All settings were run on the Flex service tier.

OpenVLHarness的Python编码代理使用与管弦乐团相同的推理努力. Codex是 Codex CLI 代理(OpenAI, 2025a, 见附录G.1 ) :每个问题都运行在新会话中,图像附着,网络搜索被禁用,以防止模型搜索到基准的黄金答案,模型写入代码执行在一个只读的沙盒中,由Landlock和seccomp执行. 所有设置都运行在 Flex 服务级别上 。

A question whose requests fail on every retry counts as incorrect; this occurred for 134 134 of the 524,580 524{,}580 questions (marked † in Table 16 ).

blocks.en: Raising the effort increases the 22-benchmark average of every method. OpenVLHarness at medium effort ( 56.52 56.52 at $0.92 per 1,000 1{,}000 questions) exceeds every setting of every other method by at least 7.68 7.68 points; the strongest of those settings is Visual Sketchpad at max effort ( 48.84 48.84 at $5.15). OpenVLHarness at low effort ( 49.92 49.92 at $0.64) already exceeds the average of every other setting. At low effort, OpenVLHarness leads Base on grounded perception and on visual search and deep research but trails it on general VQA and hallucination and on spatial reasoning ( 61.51 61.51 vs. 61.63 61.63 ; 54.45 54.45 vs. 56.54 56.54 ); from medium effort onward, it leads Base in every domain. At max effort, the gap between OpenVLHarness ( 60.12 60.12 at $2.99) and the best other method is largest on grounded perception ( 15.6 15.6 points) and on visual search and deep research ( 12.4 12.4 ), consistent with the harness supplying evidence that the model cannot infer from the image, and smaller on general VQA and hallucination ( 6.1 6.1 ) and on spatial reasoning ( 7.1 7.1 ). Returns per unit of cost diminish for Base: moving from xhigh to max effort multiplies its cost by 2.7 2.7 and raises its average by 0.72 0.72 points. On FSC-147, no other setting exceeds 38.34 38.34 , against 40.59 40.59 for OpenVLHarness at low effort; on the six search benchmarks, OpenVLHarness at max effort exceeds the best other setting by 3.0 3.0 to 19.6 19.6 points, and OpenVLHarness at low effort already exceeds it on 4 4 of them. OpenVLHarness attains the best score of all settings on 20 20 of the 22 22 benchmarks; the exceptions are HallusionBench (Codex at xhigh effort, 69.89 69.89 , against 69.66 69.66 for OpenVLHarness at max effort) and ERQA (Visual Sketchpad at max effort, 64.75 64.75 , against 63.50 63.50 for OpenVLHarness at max effort).
blocks.zh: 提高这一努力提高了每种方法的22个基准平均值。 OpenVL Harness在中等努力(56.522 56.52,每1,000 1{,}000个问题)中至少比所有其他方法的每个设置多7.68 7.68分;其中最强的设置是Visual Sketchpad,最大努力(48.84 48.84,5.15美元)。 OpenVLHarness在低功耗下(49.92 49.92,0.64)已经超过了所有其他设置的平均值. 在低功劳下, OpenVLHarness 领先 基于有根据的认知和视觉搜索和深入研究,但追踪到一般的VQA和幻觉以及空间推理(61.51.51 vs 61.63 61.63 ; 54.45 54.45 vs 56.54 56.54);从中努力开始,它引领方向是: 基础在每个域。 在最大努力中,OpenVLHarness(60.12 60.12 at 2.99)与最佳其他方法之间的差距最大的是基于感知(15.6 15.6 点)和视觉搜索和深入研究(12.4 12.4 ),这与提供证据证明模型无法从图像中推断一致,在一般VQA和幻觉(6.1 6.1)和空间推理(7.1 7.1 )上差距较小。 Base的单位成本回报减少:从x高到最大努力将成本乘以2.7 2.7,平均增长0.72 0.72点。 在FSC-147上,没有其他设置超过38.34 38.34 ,而OpenVLHarness低功率为40.59 40.59;在6个搜索基准上,OpenVLHarness最高功率超过最佳其他设置3.0至19.6 19.6分,OpenVLHarness低功率已经超过其中4个. OpenVLHarness在22个基准中的20个基准上取得了所有设置中的最佳分数;例外是Halusion Bench(Codex at xhigh 努力,69.89 69.89,对OpenVLHarness 最大努力,69.66 69.66)和ERQA(Visual Sketchpad at max 努力,64.75 64.75,对OpenVLHarness 最大努力,63.50 63.50)。

blocks.en: Most input tokens of OpenVLHarness, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad are cache reads and writes of the context carried across their model calls, whereas Base sends a single prompt. For Base, raising the effort leaves the input unchanged at about 1,800 1{,}800 tokens per question and mainly increases reasoning tokens, from 301 301 to 5,852 5{,}852 per question between low and max effort. For the three harnesses, the input also grows between low and max effort: from about 8,000 8{,}000 to 11,800 11{,}800 tokens per question for Codex, from 20,800 20{,}800 to 24,100 24{,}100 for Visual Sketchpad, and from 14,500 14{,}500 to 24,600 24{,}600 for OpenVLHarness.
blocks.zh: OpenVLHarness, Codex, 和Visual Sketchpad 的大多数输入符都是缓存读取和写取其模型调用时所携带的上下文,而Base则发送一个单一的提示. 对Base来说,提高努力使输入值不变,每问题大约为1,800 1{,}800个令牌,主要增加推理令牌,从301 301个到5,852 5{,}每问题在低努力和最大努力之间增加852个. 对于这三支吊带,投入也从低功率到最大功率不等:从约8000 8{,}000到11800 11{,}每题800个信使,从20,800 20{,}800到24,100 24{,}100个Visual Sketchpad,以及从14,500 14{,}500到24,600 24{,}600个OpenVLHarness.

For OpenVLHarness, the calls of the Python Coding Agent are logged per setting rather than per question and are apportioned evenly across questions; they account for 0.4 % 0.4\% of its tokens and 2.5 % 2.5\% of its model-token cost at low effort, rising to 3.6 % 3.6\% and 14.7 % 14.7\% at max effort.

blocks.en: The sandbox permits code execution at every setting, yet GPT-6 Luna rarely uses it: Codex executes at least one command on 0.16 % 0.16\% of questions at low effort and 6.17 % 6.17\% at max effort (Table 15 ). Execution concentrates on grounded perception and on visual search and deep research ( 12.3 % 12.3\% and 9.6 % 9.6\% of their questions at max effort) and is almost absent on general VQA and hallucination and on spatial reasoning. On most questions, Codex therefore reduces to the model answering directly within the Codex agent loop and prompt. Its average is at most 2.0 2.0 points below that of Base from medium to xhigh effort and 0.5 0.5 points above it at max effort, but 7.4 7.4 points below it at low effort; this drop is not caused by failed requests, since every question receives a non-empty answer.
blocks.zh: Sandbox允许在每个场合执行代码, 然而GPT-6 Luna却很少使用: Codex至少执行一个指令, 执行的重点是有根据的感知、视觉搜索和深入研究(在他们的最大努力中,12.3%,9.6%),在一般的VQA和幻觉以及空间推理方面几乎都不存在。 在大多数问题上,Codex因此在Codex代理循环和即时内直接回复到模型. 其平均比Base的中高功率到x高功率的低2.0点,最高功率时高出0.5点,但低功率时低于0.4点7.4点;这一下降并非因请求失败所致,因为每个问题都得到非空答.

blocks.en: B.7 Codex with Open-Source Backbones
blocks.zh: B.7 带开源背骨的代码

blocks.en: Table 1 compares OpenVLHarness with Codex only for GPT-6 Luna. To test whether that comparison depends on the backbone, we run Codex with Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3-VL-32B on all 22 22 benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 表1 比较 OpenVLHarness with Codex 只为GPT-6 Luna服务. 为了检验这种比较是否取决于骨干,我们用Quen3-VL-8B和Quen3-VL-32B在所有22个基准上运行Codex.

blocks.en: Codex is the Codex CLI agent ( OpenAI, 2025a ) in code mode, configured as for GPT-6 Luna (Appendix G.1 ) except that it also appends a short answer-format instruction to each question. Every question runs in a fresh session with the image attached, web search disabled, and medium reasoning effort; the Qwen3-VL Instruct models have no separate reasoning mode, so the effort setting does not change their decoding. Both models are served with vLLM, and each response is capped at 2,048 2{,}048 tokens, the per-turn limit used for OpenVLHarness. Codex runs model-written code in a read-only sandbox; in these runs it used its default sandbox, which cannot start shell processes on our evaluation host, so Codex could evaluate only simple expressions. These results therefore measure the Codex agent loop and prompt without shell-based tools. The grounded perception benchmarks use the validation splits, as in Table 1 . FSC-147 is scored by the last integer in each answer, and an empty answer counts as wrong.
blocks.zh: Codex是代码模式中的Codex CLI代理(OpenAI,2025a),配置为GPT-6 Luna(Appendix G.1 ),只是它也会在每个问题中附加一个简短的答案格式指令. 每个问题都以新会话运行,其中图像附加,网络搜索被禁用,中度推理努力;Quen3-VL指令模型没有单独的推理模式,因此努力设置不会改变它们的解码. 两个型号都服务于vLLM,每个响应的上限为2,048 2{,}048个令牌,是OpenVLHarness使用的每转弯限制. Codex在只读的沙盒中运行模型写法代码;在这些运行中它使用了它的默认沙盒,它不能在我们的评价主机上启动 shell进程,因此Codex只能评价简单的表达式. 因此,这些结果测量了 Codex 代理环路,并且没有基于 shell 的工具的快速. 基础感知基准使用验证分数,如表1. FSC-147在每个答案中以最后一个整数得分,空答案算作错误.

Each Codex cell is a single run.
