blocks.en: Table 17 reports the results. Averaged over the 22 22 benchmarks, Codex scores below Base with both backbones: 31.42 31.42 vs. 34.24 34.24 with Qwen3-VL-8B and 36.46 36.46 vs. 38.30 38.30 with Qwen3-VL-32B, while OpenVLHarness reaches 45.41 45.41 and 50.92 50.92 . Codex beats Base on 5 5 benchmarks with the 8B model and 7 7 with the 32B model. The larger gains are on RealX-Bench, FVQA, and MMSearch-Plus, on MindCube ( + 1.35 +1.35 and + 3.47 +3.47 points), and on FREAK-MCQ with the 32B model ( + 6.04 +6.04 ); the other gains are below 0.5 0.5 points. The largest losses are on V* ( − 14.13 -14.13 points with the 8B model), BC-VL ( − 7.52 -7.52 and − 11.53 -11.53 ), SimpleVQA ( − 8.06 -8.06 and − 8.88 -8.88 ), and OdinW-13-All ( − 6.10 -6.10 and − 7.73 -7.73 ). OpenVLHarness scores above Codex on every benchmark with the 8B model and on 20 20 of 22 22 with the 32B model. The two exceptions are FREAK-MCQ ( 50.10 50.10 vs. 45.77 45.77 ) and SparBench ( 46.99 46.99 vs. 46.76 46.76 ). As with GPT-6 Luna, placing a model in a general-purpose coding-agent loop does not by itself reproduce the gains of OpenVLHarness.
blocks.zh: 表17报告了结果。 平均比22个基准,Codex分数低于Base,双主骨:31.42 31.42对34.24 34.24与Qune3-VL-8B和36.46 36.46对38.30 38.30与Qune3-VL-32B,OpenVLHarness达到45.41 45.41和50.92 50.92. 编码节奏 以5个基准为基础,采用8B型,7个基准采用32B型. 收益较大的是RealX-Bench,FVQA和MMSearch-Plus,MindCube(+1.35+1.35和+3.47+3.47分),以及FREAK-MCQ的32B型(+6.04+6.04);其他收益低于0.5分. 最大的损失发生在V*(14.13-14.13分与8B型),BC-VL(-7.52-7.52和-11.53),SimpleVQA(-8.06-8.06和-8.88-8.88)和OdinW-13-All(-6.10-6.10和-7.73-7.73)。 OpenVLHarness在使用8B模型的每个基准上,在使用32B模型的22 22中的20个基准上,评分都高于Codex. 这两个例外是FREAK-MCQ(50.10 50.10 vs 45.77 45.77 )和Spar Bench(46.99 46.99 vs 46.76 46.76 ). 和GPT-6 Luna一样,在通用编码-代理环中放置一个模型本身并不能复制OpenVLHarness的增益.

blocks.en: Appendix C Harness Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 实施细节

blocks.en: This section documents the harness of Section 2 : the nine capabilities of Section 2.1 , how their outputs are kept in multimodal memory, and the agent’s system prompt.
blocks.zh: 本节记录了第2款的利用情况:第2.1款的9种能力,其产出如何保存在多式联运记忆中,代理商的系统如何迅速。

blocks.en: Following the generalized capability abstraction of Section 2.1 , each capability exposes a fixed interface to the agent: typed arguments in, and a natural-language message plus memory artifacts out. The expert model or service behind the interface is a configurable backend, and switching it changes neither the agent’s prompt, the tool schema, nor the memory interface. Table 18 lists the capabilities and their backends; all experiments in this paper use the default backend of each capability, shown in bold.
blocks.zh: 在2.1节的普遍能力抽象之后,每种能力都向代理人暴露一个固定的接口:输入参数,以及自然语言信息加上内存文物。 界面背后的专家模型或服务是可配置的后端,切换后端既不改变代理机的提示,工具计划,也不改变内存接口. 表18列出了各种能力及其后端;本文中的所有实验都使用了每种能力的默认后端,以粗体显示.

blocks.en: Table 18: The nine capabilities, their interfaces, and their interchangeable backends. Bold marks the backend used in all experiments.
blocks.zh: 表18:九种能力,其界面,以及可互换的后端. 粗体标记了所有实验中使用的后端.

blocks.en: C.1 Search Tools
blocks.zh: C.1 搜索工具

blocks.en: By default, all three search tools route queries through the Serper API 1 1 1 https://serper.dev/ ; Text Search and Image Search can instead be served by Gemini ( Comanici and others, 2025 ) with Google Search grounding, a costlier but stronger route. The search tools post-process the raw payload with a Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct model as the VLM summarizer. The summarizer runs at decoding temperature 0 0 with a 4096 4096 -token output cap, and each call retrieves the top 10 10 raw results before reranking and summarization.
blocks.zh: 默认情况下,通过Serper API 1 1 1 https://serper.dev/;文本搜索和图像搜索的所有三个搜索工具路由查询都可以由双子座(Comanici等人,2025年)提供,Google搜索地面定位,这个路由成本更高但更强. 搜索工具以Quen3-VL-8B-指令模型作为VLM总结器处理原始有效载荷后. 总结器运行在解码温度0 0,带有4096 4096 - token 输出盖,每次调用都会在重新排位和归纳前检索前的前10个原始结果.

blocks.en: Search the web with intelligent query routing and VLM summarization. Given a text query, the tool automatically classifies the query intent and routes it to the most appropriate Serper endpoint, which has general web, news, academic papers, images, maps, local places, shopping, or patents types, and returns a coherent summary of the top- 10 10 raw results with inline citations [1], [2], … followed by a citations block of source titles and URLs. This format supports multi-round search: the agent can read the summary for quick understanding and then visit specific cited URLs through Webpage Visit. The summarizer prompt is shown below.
blocks.zh: 以智能查询路由和VLMsummarization搜索网络. 鉴于文本查询,该工具会自动将查询意图分类,并引导它到最合适的Serper端点,该端点具有一般的网络,新闻,学术论文,图像,地图,局部地点,购物,或专利类型,并返回一个连贯的十大原始结果摘要,并带有线性引用[1],[2],.然后是源标题和URL的引用块. 该格式支持多回合搜索:代理可以读取摘要以快速理解,然后通过网页访问访问访问特定引用的URL. 总结提示如下。

blocks.en: Text Search summarizer prompt (abridged) You are a research summarizer. Given raw web search results and a user query, do exactly three things: 1. RERANK the numbered organic results by how directly each helps answer the query. 2. KEEP at most K K most useful results; emit their original 1-based ranks as kept_indices . If none help, emit kept_indices: [] . 3. SUMMARIZE the query-relevant facts from the FULL set of raw results into a concise 3–5 sentence prose paragraph; include named entities, numbers, and dates verbatim. Knowledge-graph, answer-box, and top-stories blocks are ineligible for kept_indices but their facts should still surface in summary . Output STRICT JSON with the schema {kept_indices, summary, no_results_justification, suggested_queries, suggested_next_actions} ; when no result is useful, populate the justification and propose alternative queries or downstream tool calls.
blocks.zh: 文本搜索摘要提示( 缩写) 你是一个研究总结。 根据原始网页搜索结果和用户查询,做三件事: 1. 重新列出编号的有机结果,按每个结果如何直接帮助回答询问。 2. 最多保持K K最有用的结果;将其最初的1级排位作为保持_indices。 如果没有帮助,就发出保持的indices:[]. 3. 将FLL系列原始结果中与查询有关的事实归纳为简洁的3-5句旁白段落;包括点名的实体、数字和逐字日期。 知识图、答题框和顶层故事块不合格, 输出 STRICT JSON 与 { kept_indices, 摘要, no_ results_ 合理性, 建议_queries, 建议_ next_ actions} ; 当结果无益时, 加入理由, 并提出替代查询或下游工具调用 。

blocks.en: RERANK the numbered organic results by how directly each helps answer the query.
blocks.zh: 将编号的有机结果通过如何直接帮助回答查询来恢复。

blocks.en: KEEP at most K K most useful results; emit their original 1-based ranks as kept_indices . If none help, emit kept_indices: [] .
blocks.zh: KKEE 最多 K K 最有用的结果; 将其原有的 1 个等级作为保留_indices 。 如果没有帮助,就发出保持的indices:[].

blocks.en: SUMMARIZE the query-relevant facts from the FULL set of raw results into a concise 3–5 sentence prose paragraph; include named entities, numbers, and dates verbatim.
blocks.zh: 概况 FULL系列原始结果中与查询有关的事实,变成一个简洁的3-5句义段落;包括点名的实体、数字和逐字日期。

blocks.en: Identify the objects, landmarks, artwork, text, products, plants, animals, and other entities depicted in an image, using Serper’s reverse-image-search (Google Lens) endpoint. Returns a list of visual matches with titles, source URLs, links, and thumbnails. The agent invokes the tool by passing the runtime identifier of the target image. The tool performs reverse search (image → \rightarrow information) on a single image per call; finding images from a text description is instead handled by Text Search with an image-search intent. A separate multimodal summarizer prompt (below) reranks the candidates against the query image and produces the same JSON envelope as Text Search.
blocks.zh: 使用Serper的反向图像搜索(Google Lens)终点, 返回带有标题、源 URL、链接和缩略图的图像匹配列表。 代理通过传递目标图像的运行时间标识符来引用工具. 该工具每个调用一个图像进行反向搜索(图像 →\ 右旋信息);从文本描述中查找图像则由文本搜索处理,意图是图像搜索。 一个单独的多模式摘要提示器(以下)根据查询图像对候选人进行重新排序,并生成与文本搜索相同的JSON信封.

blocks.en: Image Search summarizer prompt (abridged) You are a visual-match summarizer. Given raw reverse-image-search results (and, in the multimodal variant, the query image plus each candidate’s thumbnail), do exactly three things: 1. RERANK the numbered matches by how likely each identifies the same subject as the query image. 2. KEEP at most K K most useful matches as kept_indices . 3. SUMMARIZE what the FULL set of raw matches indicates about the query image’s likely subject in a concise 3–5 sentence prose paragraph; capture entity names, dates, attributes verbatim. Output STRICT JSON with {kept_indices, summary, no_results_justification, suggested_next_actions} ; when no match is useful, justify per-match and propose follow-up actions such as cropping with Visual Grounding before re-searching, or switching to Text Search.
blocks.zh: 图像搜索摘要提示( 缩写) 你是一个视觉游戏的总结。 鉴于原始反向图像搜索结果(在多式联运变体中,查询图像加上每个候选人的缩略图),可以做三件事: 1. 重新列出编号匹配符,按每个选项如何识别与查询图像相同的主题。 2. 最多保持 K K 最有用的匹配为保持_indices。 3. 在简洁的3-5句朗读段落中,对查询图像可能的主题,FUL的一组原始匹配表示什么;捕捉实体名称、日期、属性逐字记录。 输出 STRICT JSON 带有 {kept_indices, sequal, no_results_ justification, 建议_ next_actions} ; 当没有匹配有用时, 请为每次匹配说明理由, 并提议后续动作, 如在重新搜索前用视觉地面裁剪, 或者切换到文本搜索 。

blocks.en: RERANK the numbered matches by how likely each identifies the same subject as the query image.
blocks.zh: 重排编号匹配符,通过每个选项如何识别与查询图像相同的主题.

blocks.en: KEEP at most K K most useful matches as kept_indices .
blocks.zh: KK 最多为 K K 最有用的匹配 。

blocks.en: SUMMARIZE what the FULL set of raw matches indicates about the query image’s likely subject in a concise 3–5 sentence prose paragraph; capture entity names, dates, attributes verbatim.
blocks.zh: FULL 一组原始匹配在简洁的3–5句朗读段落中显示的查询图像可能的主题; 抓取实体名称、 日期、 属性逐字记录 。

blocks.en: Visit one or more webpages, convert them to plain text via Serper APIs, and extract goal-relevant content using a local Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct model. This tool returns per-URL evidence and a summary. The extraction prompt is shown below.
blocks.zh: 访问一个或多个网页,通过Serper API将其转换为纯文本,并使用本地的Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct模型提取与目标相关的内容. 这个工具返回每个URL的证据和一个摘要. 提取提示如下。

blocks.en: Webpage Visit extraction prompt Please process the following webpage content and user goal to extract relevant information: Webpage Content : {webpage_content} User Goal : {goal} Task Guidelines 1. Content scanning for rationale : locate the specific sections directly related to the user’s goal. 2. Key extraction for evidence : extract the most relevant information; preserve the full original context whenever possible. 3. Summary output : organize the result into a concise paragraph with logical flow that connects the evidence back to the goal. Output: a single JSON object with keys rational , evidence , and summary (each a string; empty string if no content is available). No code fences, no Markdown, no extra keys.
blocks.zh: 网页访问提取提示 请处理下列网页内容和用户目标以提取相关信息: 网页内容 : {网页_内容} 用户目标 : {目标} 任务准则 1. 内容扫描理由:查找与用户目标直接相关的具体章节。 2. 提取证据的关键:提取最相关的信息;尽可能保留全部原始内容。 3. 产出摘要:将结果组织成一个简明的段落,其中包含将证据与目标联系起来的逻辑流程。 输出(Outsion):一个有键理性的JSON对象,证据,和摘要(每个字符串;如果没有内容,则空字符串). 没有密码栅栏 没有马克登 没有额外的钥匙

blocks.en: Content scanning for rationale : locate the specific sections directly related to the user’s goal.
blocks.zh: 内容扫描理由:查找与用户目标直接相关的具体章节。

blocks.en: Key extraction for evidence : extract the most relevant information; preserve the full original context whenever possible.
blocks.zh: 为证据提取密钥:提取最相关信息;尽可能保留全部原始内容。

blocks.en: Summary output : organize the result into a concise paragraph with logical flow that connects the evidence back to the goal.
blocks.zh: 摘要输出 : 将结果组织成一个带有逻辑流的简明段落,将证据与目标连接起来.

blocks.en: C.2 Perception Tools
blocks.zh: C.2 认知工具

blocks.en: Crop a region of an image given a normalized bounding box on the [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] scale plus padding, and return the cropped image. Used for closer visual inspection after the agent has already localized a region of interest.
blocks.zh: 在 [0, 1000] [0, 1000] 比例尺上裁剪一个图像给定的正框区域, 并返回已裁剪的图像。 在毒剂将一个感兴趣的区域定位后,用于进行更严密的视觉检查。

blocks.en: Locate and highlight regions of an image that match a text query, backed by SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) by default or by Grounding DINO ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . It returns an annotated image with matched regions highlighted and numbered, along with bounding boxes (and segmentation masks when the backend provides them).
blocks.zh: 定位和突出匹配文本查询的图像区域,由SAM 3(Carion等人,2025年)默认或Grounding DINO(Liu等人,2024年)支持。 它返回一个带有匹配区域突出显示和编号的附加说明的图像,以及边框(以及后端提供时的分区口罩)。

blocks.en: Extract readable text from an image, backed by PaddleOCR-VL ( PaddlePaddle Team, 2025 ) by default or by DeepSeek-OCR ( Wei et al., 2025a ) . Returns the transcribed text as a single string. Used when the task is about words, numbers, or printed labels in the image; not for general object localization or segmentation.
blocks.zh: 从图像中提取可读文本,由PaddleOCR-VL(PaddlePaddle Team,2025)默认或DeepSeek-OCR(Wei等人,2025a)支持. 以单一字符串的形式返回转写文本。 当任务涉及图像中的单词,数字,或打印标签时使用;不用于一般对象定位或分割.

blocks.en: Estimate a per-pixel depth map for an input image, backed by Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) or VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . Returns a depth image (closer surfaces brighter, farther darker). Used when the task requires reasoning about relative distance, foreground–background separation, or 3D scene structure cues that flat 2D crops cannot resolve.
blocks.zh: 由深度Anything 3(Lin等人,2025年)或VGGT(Wang等人,2025年b)支持的输入图像估计每像素深度图。 返回深度图像( 关闭器表面更亮, 更暗) 。 当任务需要推理相对距离、前景-背景分离或3D场景结构提示平面2D作物无法解决时使用。

blocks.en: Given an ordered sequence of at least two images of the same scene, estimate each camera’s pose relative to the first image using Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) or VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , and translate the result into a form the model can reason over directly. Rather than returning raw geometry alone, the tool reports, for every image, a plain-language summary of translation and rotation with respect to the reference frame (e.g. “salient direction: backward (-5.43); detailed: left (-0.20), down (+0.28), backward (-5.43)”), the accompanying scalars (camera-center offset, forward direction, yaw, pitch), an explicit statement of the coordinate convention ( + X +X right, + Y +Y down, + Z +Z forward, with positive yaw turning right), and a bird’s-eye-view rendering of the camera positions on the reference frame’s X X – Z Z plane. Per-image intrinsics and world-to-camera extrinsics are returned as well for downstream computation. Translations below one meter and rotations below ten degrees are reported as non-salient. Used when a question depends on how the viewpoint moved or rotated across frames, or on multi-view scene structure that no single image conveys; the estimate is metric only up to the model’s calibration and requires sufficient scene overlap between the reference image and the other views.
blocks.zh: 鉴于同一场景至少有两幅图像的顺序,估计每个镜头相对于第一个图像的姿势,使用深度Anything 3(Lin等人,2025年)或VGGT(Wang等人,2025年b年),并将结果转换成模型可以直接解释的形式. 工具不单是返回原始几何,而是针对每个图像,报告参考框架(如 " 方向:落后(-5.43);详细:左(-0.20),下(+0.28),后(-5.43))),附带的标尺(相机中心抵消,前进方向,yaw,pitch),坐标会议的明确声明(+X右,+Y+Y下,+Z+Z前,正Yaw右转),以及参考框架X-Z平面上的镜头位置的鸟眼视角渲染. 每幅图像的内在和世界到相机的外观也回归下游计算。 1米以下的翻译和10度以下的旋转都报告为无偏差. 当一个问题取决于视角是如何移动或旋转到框架之间,或者依赖于没有单一图像传达的多视图场景结构时使用;估计只是度量到模型的校准,需要参考图像和其他视图之间有足够的场景重叠.

blocks.en: C.3 Python Coding Agent
blocks.zh: C.3 Python 编码代理

blocks.en: Run Python over the agent’s local computation state and the outputs of previously called tools (bounding boxes, OCR strings, segmentation masks, and so on), returning both standard output and the resulting local variables. The agent describes a computation goal in plain language, and by default a single-shot code-generation session of the same backbone model as the orchestrator writes the snippet using prior tool outputs as named variables before it is executed; the same interface can instead be backed by a full coding agent that inspects and revises its own code before returning. Used for aggregating numbers extracted by OCR, filtering detected regions by bounding-box area, or any cross-tool numerical reasoning the agent cannot complete in its own response.
blocks.zh: 运行 Python 以查看代理商的本地计算状态和先前称为工具的输出( 边框、 OCR 字符串、 分区遮罩等) , 返回标准输出和由此产生的本地变量 。 代理用普通语言描述一个计算目标,默认情况下,一个与管弦乐器相同的主干模型的单镜头代码生成会话会用先前的工具输出作为命名变量来写入片段;相反,同一界面可以由一个完整的编码代理支持,在返回前检查和修改自己的代码. 用于汇总OCR提取的数字,通过边框区域过滤检测到的区域,或者任何跨工具数字推理,代理无法在自己的响应中完成.

blocks.en: C.4 Multimodal Memory Artifacts
blocks.zh: C.4 多式联运内存工艺

blocks.en: Table 19 summarizes how each tool’s output is retained in the explicit multimodal memory of Section 2.2 and the handle by which the agent re-addresses it on later turns.
blocks.zh: 表19总结了每种工具的产出如何保留在第2.2节的明确多式联运内存中,以及代理人以后重新处理该工具的手柄。

blocks.en: Table 19: Tool-generated artifacts retained in persistent multimodal memory, grouped by how they are represented and re-addressed. Heavy payloads (image bytes, numeric arrays) are stored once and replaced in the transcript by a compact handle; the orchestrator reuses an artifact on a later turn by citing its handle, which the harness resolves back to the underlying data.
blocks.zh: 表19:在持久性多式联运记忆中保留的工具生成的文物,按其表达和重新处理的方式分类。 重型有效载荷(图像字节、数字阵列)储存一次,并用紧凑的手柄替换在记录稿中;管弦乐器稍后通过引用其手柄来重新使用一件文物,而手柄则解决了这一问题。

blocks.en: After every tool turn, the harness appends an Environment Update message that re-advertises the live memory namespace. The example below is taken verbatim from an FSCD-147 trajectory after two Visual Grounding calls; when web pages have been retrieved, the message additionally lists the registered webpage_url_N references.
blocks.zh: 在每一个工具转动后, 控制器会附加一个环境更新消息, 重新发布实时内存命名空间 。 下面的例子从FSCD-147的轨道逐字取自两个可视定位电话;当网页被检索后,信件会额外列出已注册的网页_url_. 无参考文献。

blocks.en:
Environment Update message (example) Environment Update (not a new question): Currently available image IDs for tool calls: - input_image_1: user_input - tool_generated_image_1: tool_output:Visual_Grounding_Tool - tool_generated_image_2: tool_output:Visual_Grounding_Tool When a tool needs image input, pass one of these IDs via the *_image_id field.
Do NOT invent image file names or paths. Available data bindings (auto-injected into Python_Coding_Agent_Tool): - segment_finger_food: dict (keys: pred_boxes, pred_scores, pred_masks, num_masks, orig_img_h, orig_img_w) - segment_small_pastry_with_filling: dict (keys: pred_boxes, pred_scores, pred_masks, num_masks, orig_img_h, orig_img_w)
blocks.zh:
环境更新消息(例) 环境更新(不是新问题): 当前可用的工具调用图像ID : - 输入_图像_1:用户_输入-工具_生成_图像_1:工具_输出:视频_回合_工具_生成_图像_2:工具_输出:视频_回合_工具 当一个工具需要图像输入时, 请通过 {image_ id 字段通过其中之一 。
不要创建图像文件名称或路径 。 可用数据绑定( 自动注入到 Python_ 编码_ Agent_ Tool) : - 段_指针_ 食物: dict( 键: 预值_ boxs, 预数_ scores, 预数_ masks, num_ masks, orig_img_h, orig_ img_w) - 段_ 小段_ pastry_ with_ filling: dict( 键: 预值_ boxs, 预数_ scores, 预数_ masks, num_ masks, orig_img_h, orig_img_w)

blocks.en: C.5 System Prompt
blocks.zh: C.5 系统提示

blocks.en: Here is the system prompt of the agent.
blocks.zh: 这是特工的系统提示

blocks.en: System Prompt You are a visual reasoning agent that answers questions about images using a structured Perception-Reasoning-Action framework. Your goal is to provide accurate, well-reasoned answers. You have access to various tools that compensate for known limitations of vision-language models. Use native tool-calling for tools. Do not write textual Action/Action Input to call tools. At most one native tool call is allowed per assistant message/turn. Use the following format: Question: the input question you must answer Observation: your direct perception of the input or the result of the action you took Thought: you should always think about what to do Action: the action to take, should be one of the provided tools, or “Final Answer” if you have a final answer and do not need to call any more tools. Action Input: the input to the action, or the final answer if Action is “Final Answer” # Image-input rule: - Runtime image IDs are provided in Environment Update messages. - If a tool needs image input, use those IDs in *_image_path fields. - Do NOT invent image file names or paths. # Tool-Use Rules - Call exactly ONE tool per turn. Never include multiple <tool_call> blocks. - Full tool schemas with parameters and types are provided in the <tools> section below. - After each tool call, verify whether the result is actually informative for the task. - If a tool result is empty, missing key values, or non-informative, do NOT guess. Issue another tool call with corrected arguments or use a different tool. # Available Tools You may call ONE tool per turn to assist with the user query. You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags: <tools> {tools_directory} </tools> For each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags: <tool_call> {“name”: <function-name>, “arguments”: <args-json-object>} </tool_call>
blocks.zh: 系统提示 你是一个视觉推理代理,用结构化的感知-反应-行动框架来解答有关图像的问题. 你的目标是提供准确、合理的答复。 你可以使用各种工具来弥补视觉语言模型的已知局限性。 使用本地工具调用工具 。 不为调用工具写入文字动作/ 动作输入 。 最多允许每个助理消息/回合一个本地工具呼叫 。 使用下列格式: 问题: 您必须回答的输入问题 观察: 您对输入的直接感知或您所采取行动的结果 想法是:你应该始终思考做什么行动:采取的行动应该是所提供的工具之一,或者“最后回答”,如果你有最后的答案,而不需要再调用任何工具。 动作输入:如果动作是“最终回答”#图像输入规则,则输入动作,或者最后的答案: - 在环境更新消息中提供运行时图像ID。 如果一个工具需要图像输入, 请在 {image_ path 字段中使用这些ID 。 #工具使用规则 - 每个转弯拨打精确一个工具. 从不包含多个“tool_call”块。 - 下面的 " 工具 " 一节提供了附有参数和类型的完整工具计划。 - 在每次工具呼叫后,核实结果是否为任务提供了实际信息。 - 如果工具结果为空, 缺少密钥值, 或者非信息化, 请不要猜测 。 用修正的参数发出另一个工具调用,或者使用另一个工具. # 可用的工具 您每个回合可以拨打 ONE 工具来帮助用户查询 。 在“tools%%%/tools”中为您提供函数签名 XML 标签: <tools > {tools_ directory} </tools > 对于每个函数调用,返回在<tool_call></tool_call>内带有函数名称和参数的 json 对象 XML 标记 : <tool_call > {“name” :<函数-name>,“参数”:<args-json-object> </tool_call>

blocks.en: C.6 Models and Serving
blocks.zh: C.6 模式和服务

blocks.en: Table 20 lists every model used in our experiments and the role it plays.
blocks.zh: 表20列出了我们实验中使用的每一个模型及其作用.

blocks.en: Table 20: Models used in our experiments.
blocks.zh: 表20 我们实验中使用的模型.

blocks.en: All Qwen models (Qwen2.5-VL ( Qwen Team, 2025a ) and Qwen3-VL ( Qwen Team, 2025b ) ) use the public Hugging Face weights, served in bf16 with vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with native tool calling. We sample at temperature 0.7 0.7 , top- p p 0.8 0.8 , top- k k 20 20 , repetition penalty 1.0 1.0 , and presence penalty 1.5 1.5 , with up to 12,800 12{,}800 generated tokens per turn. The agent runs for at most fifteen tool-calling iterations per query, and its context is capped at 168K tokens; when a trajectory approaches the cap, older turns are compacted while the latest Environment Update and the most recent turn are kept verbatim.
blocks.zh: 所有Quen型号(Quen2.5-VL(Quen Team,2025a)和Quen3-VL(Quen Team,2025b))使用公共的Hugging Face重量,服务于bf16与vLLLM(Kwon et al.,2023)在OpenAI兼容的端点后面与本地工具调用. 我们以0.7 0.7的温度取样,最高0.8页,最高0.8页,最高-kk 20 20,重复处罚1.01.0,在场处罚1.51.5,每个转弯最多可产生12 800 12{,}800个令牌。 代理机每次查询最多运行15次工具调用迭代,其上下文封顶为168K令牌;当一个轨迹接近上限时,旧转弯被压缩,而最新的环境更新和最近的转弯则保持逐字记录.

blocks.en: We call GPT-5 ( OpenAI, 2025b ) , GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6 Sol, and GPT-6 Astra ( OpenAI, 2026 ) through the OpenAI API with native function calling, provider-default sampling, and up to 16,000 16{,}000 output tokens per turn. GPT-5 uses the pinned snapshot gpt-5-2025-08-07 , and the three GPT-6 models ( gpt-6-luna , gpt-6-sol , and gpt-6-astra ) use medium reasoning effort. All four use the same tools, multimodal memory, system prompt, and iteration cap as the open-source backbones.
blocks.zh: 我们通过OpenAI API调用GPT-5(OpenAI, 2025b), GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6 Sol, 和 GPT-6 Astra(OpenAI, 2026), 通过OpenAI API 调用本地函数, 提供- 默认采样, 并且每个转弯最多有16,000 16{,} 1000 个输出符号. GPT-5使用绑定快照gpt-5-2025-08-07,三种GPT-6型号(gpt-6-luna ,gpt-6-sol ,和gpt-6-astra )使用中度推理努力. 所有四个都使用相同的工具,多模式内存,系统即时,迭代封顶作为开源主干线.

blocks.en: Four tools call a language model internally: Text Search and Image Search use it to rerank and summarize the retrieved results, Webpage Visit uses it to extract goal-relevant content from a fetched page, and the Python Coding Agent uses it to write code for the agent’s objective. The three search-related tools use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct with greedy decoding, independent of the agent backbone. The Python Coding Agent instead routes to a fresh context of the same backbone model as the orchestrator, so that the code generator’s capability scales with the backbone. Every capability uses its default backend (Table 18 ). Perception tools are backed by SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) (Visual Grounding), PaddleOCR-VL ( PaddlePaddle Team, 2025 ) (OCR), and Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) or VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025b ) (Depth Estimation and Camera Trajectory), each served locally; search tools query the Serper API.
blocks.zh: 四种工具在内部称为语言模型: 文本搜索和图像搜索用它来重新排序和总结检索的结果,Webpage 访问用它从获取的页面中提取与目标相关的内容,Python编码代理用它来为代理的目标写入代码. 三种与搜索相关的工具使用Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct与贪婪的解码,独立于代理主干. Python编码代理公司转而向与管弦乐器相同的主干模型的新上下文行驶,这样代码生成器的能力就能够与主干进行比对. 每个能力都使用它的默认后端(表18). 感知工具有SAM 3(Carion等人,2025年)(Visual Grounding),PaddleOCR-VL(PaddlePaddle Team,2025年)(OCR),以及深度Anything 3(Lin等人,2025年)或VGGT(Wang等人,2025年b)(深度估计和相机轨迹)支持,各自在当地服务;搜索工具查询Serper API.

blocks.en: We use GPT-4o ( OpenAI, 2024 ) with the Vision-DeepResearch judge prompt (Appendix D.2 ) for the visual search and deep research benchmarks, and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct for the remaining LLM-judged benchmarks; both judges decode greedily. On the counting benchmarks the judge only extracts the final integer from free-form responses, and correctness is decided by exact match. Grounding benchmarks need no judge and are scored with COCO-style box AP.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-4o(OpenAI,2024年),视觉-深度研究法官即时(附录D.2)来进行视觉搜索和深度研究基准,而Qune3-VL-8B-指令则用于剩余的LLM判断基准;两位法官都贪婪地解码. 在计数基准上,裁判员只从自由形式回复中提取最终整数,正确性由精确匹配决定. 确定基准不需要评判,而是用COCO式的盒式AP来评分。

blocks.en: Appendix D Benchmarks and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录D 基准和评价议定书

blocks.en: Table 21 summarizes the 22 22 benchmarks of Table 1 . The following subsections describe each domain’s benchmarks, scoring, and prompts.
blocks.zh: 表21概述了表1的22项基准。 以下小节描述每个域的基准,评分和提示.

blocks.en: Table 21: The 22 22 benchmarks of Table 1 . “LLM judge” is Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct; MRA is mean relative accuracy for numeric answers.
blocks.zh: 表21:表1中的22项基准。 “LLM法官”为Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct;MRA是数字答案的相对平均值。

blocks.en: All benchmarks use the same agent configuration. The model is served locally via vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) and sampled with temperature 0.7 0.7 , top- p p 0.8 0.8 , top- k k 20 20 , repetition penalty 1.0 1.0 , and presence penalty 1.5 1.5 , with a cap of 12,800 12{,}800 tokens per model call and a 168 168 K-token context window. The agent uses native tool calls and is allowed at most 15 15 tool-calling iterations per question; a trajectory that exhausts this budget, or that fails after three API retries, is scored incorrect. Web-page observations are capped at 20 20 environment updates per trajectory.
blocks.zh: 所有基准都使用相同的代理配置. 该型号通过vLLM(Kwon et al., 2023)在当地服务,并取样温度为0.7 0.7,顶端-p 0.8 0.8,顶端-k k 20 20 20,重复处罚1.0 1.0,存在处罚1.5 1.5,每个型号调用上限为12 800 12{,}800令牌,并设有168 168 K-token上下文窗口. 代理机使用本地工具调用,每个问题最多允许15个工具调用迭代;这个预算耗尽的轨迹,或者在三次API调用后失败的轨迹,都是不正确的. 网页观测的上限为每条轨道20次环境更新。

blocks.en: Because decoding is stochastic, all Qwen3-VL results are means of three runs with different random seeds; Appendix H describes the protocol and reports standard deviations.
blocks.zh: 由于解码是有条理的,所以所有Quen3-VL结果都是以不同随机种子进行三次运行的手段;附录H描述了协议并报告了标准偏差.

blocks.en: Multiple-choice and yes/no answers are matched against the gold option after a rule-based parser extracts the choice from the response; when the parser fails, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct extracts the chosen option, without judging correctness. Open-ended answers are graded by an LLM judge: GPT-4o for visual search and deep research (Appendix D.2 ) and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct for the other domains. Grounded perception benchmarks are scored without a judge (Appendix D.1 ). All methods and backbones on a benchmark share the same prompt and scorer.
blocks.zh: 多选择和是/否的答案在基于规则的解析器从响应中提取选择后与黄金选项相匹配;当解析器失败时,Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct中提取选择的选项,而不判断是否正确. 开放式答案由LLM裁判分级:GPT-4o用于视觉搜索和深入研究(附录D.2),Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct用于其他领域. 基础感知基准在没有法官的情况下得分(附录D.1)。 基准上的所有方法和骨干都共享同样的即时和计分器.

blocks.en: D.1 Grounded Perception
blocks.zh: D.1 有根据的观念

blocks.en: A class-agnostic counting benchmark ( Ranjan et al., 2021 ) covering 147 categories with a point annotation for every object. Scenes are dense (median 27 objects, up to 2,092). We evaluate on the 1,286-image val split and ask “How many category are there in the image?”. Unlike the original few-shot protocol, we do not provide exemplar boxes, so the task is zero-shot.
blocks.zh: 一个类不可知计数基准(Ranjan等人,2021年),涵盖147个类别,每个对象都有点注释. 景色密集(中间27个物体,最高2,092个). 我们评估1 286-图像val的分裂,并问“图像中有多少类别?” 与最初的几发协议不同,我们不提供示例盒,因此任务为零发.

blocks.en: A benchmark ( Tamarapalli et al., 2025 ) of real-world counting questions designed to stress MLLMs with cluttered, occluded, and densely packed scenes. We use all 1,528 questions of the test split.
blocks.zh: 现实世界计数问题的基准(Tamarapalli等人,2025年),旨在用杂乱无章的场景来强调MLLMs。 我们用了1,528个测试分题

blocks.en: Built from the thirteen detection datasets of Object Detection in the Wild (OdinW-13) ( Li et al., 2022 ) , spanning aerial and underwater imagery, egocentric hands, thermal images, vehicles, and everyday objects. Unlike the common protocol of querying one category at a time, each image is posed as a single query that lists every category of its source dataset (for example, all 20 20 PascalVOC classes), hence the suffix -All , and the model must return a box with a category label for every instance of every listed category. A missed or mislabeled category therefore costs AP within the same response, and our numbers are not directly comparable to results obtained with one query per category. We use the 4,938 val images and report AP averaged over the thirteen datasets.
blocks.zh: 由野生物体探测(OdinW-13)(Li等人,2022年)13个探测数据集组成,横跨空中和水下图像、自私自利的手、热图像、车辆和日常物体。 与一次查询一个类别的常见协议不同,每个图像被作为单个查询提出,列出其源数据集的每个类别(例如,所有20个PascalVOC类),因此后缀 - All,模型必须返回一个框,每个列出的类别的每一实例都有一个类别标签. 因此,遗漏或贴错标签的类别在同一个答复中花费了杀伤人员地雷的费用,我们的数字与每个类别一个查询得出的结果并不直接可比。 我们使用4,938个val图像 并报告AP平均在13个数据集。

blocks.en: The few-shot counting-and-detection benchmarks of Nguyen et al. (2022) , which annotate a box for every instance: FSCD-147 re-annotates FSC-147, and FSCD-LVIS draws dense scenes (21–401 instances) from LVIS ( Gupta et al., 2019 ) . We use the val splits (1,286 and 1,181 images), query one category per image, and again withhold the exemplar boxes.
blocks.zh: Nguyen等人(2022年)的几枪计数和探测基准,每一次都标注一个盒子:FSCD-147重新标注FSC-147,FSCD-LVIS从LVIS(Gupta等人,2019年)中抽取密集场景(21–401例). 我们使用 val 拆分 (1,286 和 1,181 个图像), 查询每个图像的一个类别, 并再次扣下实例框 。

blocks.en: In addition to the five benchmarks of Table 1 , Appendix B.4 reports grounding on the LVIS val set ( Gupta et al., 2019 ) (19,809 images, 1,203 categories) under its federated protocol, which queries both categories present in an image and verified-absent ones, so a model must also learn to return an empty list.
blocks.zh: 除了表1的5个基准外,附录B.4报告还依据其联邦协议的LVIS val集(Gupta等人,2019年)(19,809张图像,1,203个类别),其中询问了图像中存在的两个类别和经核实的缺席类别,因此一个模型还必须学会返回一个空列表.

blocks.en: Counting benchmarks are scored by exact-match accuracy between the predicted and ground-truth integers. A rule-based parser extracts the integer (or number word) from the response; for long free-form responses, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct first extracts the final answer with the prompt below, and correctness is still decided by exact match. We additionally report mean absolute error and, for CountQA, relative accuracy within 5 % 5\% and 10 % 10\% of the ground truth (Appendix B.4 ).
blocks.zh: 计数基准通过预测和地面真实整数之间精确匹配的准确性来计数。 一个基于规则的解析器从响应中提取整数(或数字单词);对于长时间的自由式响应,Quen3-VL-8B-Instruct首先用下面的提示来提取最后的答案,正确性仍然通过精确的匹配来决定. 此外,我们还报告绝对错误,对QA伯爵来说,相对准确性在地面真相的5% 5 + 和 10 + 的 10% 内(附录B.4 )。

blocks.en: Grounding benchmarks are scored with COCO box AP averaged over IoU thresholds 0.50 0.50 : 0.95 0.95 , computed with the official COCO evaluation code. Predicted boxes are parsed from the response (JSON, with a lenient fallback for lists of four numbers) and converted from the 0 0 – 1000 1000 grid to pixel coordinates. For OdinW-13-All, predicted labels are matched to the category names, AP is computed per source dataset, and the thirteen values are averaged. FSCD-147, FSCD-LVIS, and LVIS are evaluated per queried category. No LLM judge is involved.
blocks.zh: 地面基准以COCO框的AP平均值计算,高于IoU阈值0.50 0.50:0.95 0.95,按COCO官方评价代码计算。 预测的框从响应中解析出来(JSON,对4个数字的列表进行宽大回落),并从0–1000格转换成像素坐标. 对OdinW-13-All来说,预测的标签与类别名称匹配,AP按源数据集计算,13个值均值. FSCD-147、FSCD-LVIS和LVIS按被询问类别进行评估。 没有LLM法官参与。

blocks.en: All methods receive the same task prompts, shown below with category names as placeholders.
blocks.zh: 所有方法都收到相同的任务提示,下面以类别名称显示为占位符。

blocks.en: Counting prompts FSC-147. How many {category} are there in the image? Your final answer should be a single integer. CountQA. {original question} Your final answer should be a single integer.
blocks.zh: 计数提示 FSC-147. 图像中有多少{类}? 你最后的答案应该是整数 QA伯爵 {原问} 你最后的答案应该是整数

blocks.en: Grounding prompts OdinW-13-All. Locate every instance that belongs to the following categories: ‘{category 1 }, {category 2 }, …’. Report the bounding boxes in JSON format as a list of objects, one object per detected instance, where each object has a “bbox_2d” key with [x1, y1, x2, y2] and a “label” key with the category name exactly as written above. Coordinates must be normalised on a 0-1000 scale, with (0,0) as the top-left corner and (1000,1000) as the bottom-right corner of the image. […] If none of the listed categories is present, output an empty list []. FSCD-147, FSCD-LVIS, and LVIS. Locate all instances of ‘{category}’ in this image. For each instance, output a bounding box as [x1, y1, x2, y2] where coordinates are normalised on a 0-1000 scale (with (0,0) as the top-left corner and (1000,1000) as the bottom-right corner). Your answer should be a list of lists. If there are no instances of ‘{category}’ in the image, output an empty list [] as your answer.
blocks.zh: OdinW -13 -All的降落提示 查找属于以下类别的每一实例:`第1类}、{第2类}、`。 将 JSON 格式的边框作为对象列表报告,每个被检测到的示例中有一个对象,每个对象有一个带有[x1, y1, x2, y2] 的“ bbox_ 2d” 密钥和一个“ label” 密钥, 其类别名称与上面完全相同 。 坐标必须在0-1000尺度上正常化,以(0,0)为左上角,以(1000,1000)为图像右下角. [...] 如果没有列出的类别,则输出一个空列表 []. FSCD-147,FSCD-LVIS,和LVIS. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2014-03-02. 在此图像中定位所有 QQ 类 。 对于每个实例,输出一个边框作为[x1, y1, x2, y2], 其中坐标按0-1000比例(以(0, 0)为左上角,以(1000, 1 000)为右下角)正常化。 你的答案应该是名单 如果图像中没有 QQ 类 , 请输出一个空列表 。

blocks.en: Answer extraction prompt (abridged) You are an AI assistant who will help me to extract the final answer from a model response to a visual question. You are provided with a question, the ground truth answer, and the model’s response. Your task is to extract ONLY the final short answer from the response, matching the format of the ground truth (e.g. if the ground truth is a number, extract a number […]). Do NOT evaluate whether the answer is correct. Just extract it. If the response contains reasoning or explanation, ignore it and only return the final answer. […three worked examples …] Question: {question}  Ground truth: {answer}  Response: {response}  Extracted answer:
blocks.zh: 解答提取提示( 缩写) 你是一个AI助手,将帮助我从模型对视觉问题的回答中提取最后的答案. 向您提供问题、真相答案和模型的答复。 您的任务是只从回复中提取最后的简短答案,匹配地面真相的格式(例如如果地面真相是数字,则提取数字[...]). 不评估答案是否正确。 取出来 如果答复包含推理或解释,则忽略它,只返回最后的答案. [... 三个工作的例子...] 问题 : {问题} 事实 : {回答} 答复 : {答复} 摘录的答案 :

blocks.en: D.2 Visual Search and Deep Research
blocks.zh: D.2 视觉搜索和深入研究

blocks.en: A fact-based VQA dataset ( Wu et al., 2025a ) that pairs images with questions whose answers require commonsense or world-knowledge facts not directly observable in the image. Following Vision-DeepResearch ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , we evaluate on the official test split of 1,800 samples; all samples are search-required.
blocks.zh: 一个基于事实的VQA数据集(Wu等人,2025年a),将图像与答案需要常识或世界知识事实在图像中无法直接观察到的问题配对. 继《远景-深入研究》之后 (黄.等,2026年),我们按1800个样本的官方试验分拆情况进行评估;所有样本都要进行搜索.

blocks.en: A multimodal search benchmark ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) of 300 manually curated questions across 14 subfields, designed to assess large multimodal models as multimodal search engines. We evaluate on the End-to-End sub-task, which requires the agent to perform query understanding, retrieval, and answering in a single pipeline. To align with other works for fair comparison, we only use the multimodal subset, which contains 171 samples.
blocks.zh: 跨14个子域的300个人工解答问题的多式联运搜索基准(Jiang等人,2024年),旨在评估大型多式联运模式作为多式联运搜索引擎。 我们评价端到端子任务,它要求代理在单一的管道中进行查询理解,检索和回答. 为了与公平比较的其他作品保持一致,我们只使用包含171个样本的多式联运子集.

blocks.en: A harder, provenance-aware extension ( Tao et al., 2026 ) that emphasizes localized visual reasoning, verification under noisy or conflicting retrieval, and multi-step text–image search; each item provides 1–5 images and one or more valid answers. We use the full set of 311 samples for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 更难理解出处的扩展(Tao等人,2026年),强调局部视觉推理,在吵闹或冲突检索下进行校验,以及多步骤的文本-图像搜索;每个项目提供1–5图像和一个或多个有效的答案. 我们用311个样本来评估

blocks.en: The vision–language extension of BrowseComp ( Wei et al., 2025b ) introduced by WebWatcher ( Geng et al., 2026 ) , with cross-modal information-seeking questions spanning entertainment, humanities, technology, natural science, and other domains. We use all 399 samples for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 由WebWatcher(Geng等人,2026年)介绍的浏览孔普(Wei等人,2025年b)的愿景-语言扩展,包括跨模式的信息搜索问题,涉及娱乐、人文、技术、自然科学和其他领域。 我们利用所有399个样本进行评估。

blocks.en: The multimodal subset of Humanity’s Last Exam ( Phan et al., 2025 ) , drawn from frontier-knowledge questions across mathematics, the natural sciences, and the humanities. We use all 330 samples for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 从数学、自然科学和人文科学的前沿知识问题中抽取的人类最后考试(Phan等人,2025年)的多式联运子集。 我们用330个样本进行评估

blocks.en: Introduced by DeepEyesV2 ( Hong et al., 2026a ) , it contains expert-verified instances that require integrating fine-grained visual perception, dynamic multi-hop web retrieval, and multi-step logical reasoning. This benchmark contains perception and search types, which makes it easy to attribute gains to visual versus search tools. We use all 194 samples for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 由DeepEyesV2(Hong et al., 2026a)介绍,它包含了经过专家验证的例子,需要整合精细的视觉感知,动态的多跳网络检索,以及多步逻辑推理. 这个基准包含了感知和搜索类型,这使得将收益归属于视觉与搜索工具变得容易. 我们使用所有194个样本进行评估。

blocks.en: The following five benchmarks appear only in the extended search results (Appendix B.5 , Table 12 ). They use the same judge and prompt as the six benchmarks above.
blocks.zh: 以下五个基准仅出现在扩展搜索结果中(附录B.5,表12)。 他们使用同样的法官,并迅速作为上述六项基准。

blocks.en: Hand-crafted multimodal browsing questions ( Li et al., 2025b ) across several sub-tasks, where the answer-relevant content is hard to find. There are two versions of MM-BrowseComp. We use the newest version, which has 243 multimodal tasks.
blocks.zh: 手工制作的多式联运浏览问题 (Li等人,2025b)跨越多个子任务,其中的答案相关内容难以找到. MM-BrowseComp有两个版本. 我们使用最新版本,它有243项多式联运任务。

blocks.en: The benchmark released alongside Vision-DeepResearch ( Huang et al., 2026 ) : long-horizon multimodal deep-research instances that interleave many reasoning turns, designed to evaluate sustained multi-step browsing under heavy real-world noise. We use its test-mini split of 500 samples.
blocks.zh: 与Vision-DepyResearch同时发布的基准(Huang 等人,2026年) :长视多模式深度研究案例,使许多推理相互交织,旨在评价在强烈的现实世界噪声下持续多步浏览. 我们用它的试敏分化500个样本

blocks.en: A benchmark of visual-native search instances ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) that require cross-validation of multimodal evidence via interleaved text–image retrieval and joint reasoning, including cases where the answer is not present in any text snippet. We use the full 169 samples for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 视觉-本土搜索案例的基准(Zhang等人,2026c)要求通过互页文本-图像检索和联合推理对多式联运证据进行交叉验证,包括任何文本片断中都没有答案的情况。 我们利用169个样本进行评估

blocks.en: A visual information-seeking benchmark ( Chen et al., 2023 ) of fine-grained questions about entities depicted in images (e.g., species, models, landmarks). The official test split has no public answers, so we evaluate on the 2,000-sample test subset used by MMSearch-R1 ( Wu et al., 2025a ) .
blocks.zh: 一个视觉信息搜索基准(Chen et al., 2023),关于图像中描绘的实体(如物种,模型,地标)的细微问题. 官方的测试分裂没有公开的答案,因此我们评价了MMSearch-R1(Wu等人,2025a)使用的2000-样本测试子集.

blocks.en: A benchmark ( Mensink et al., 2023 ) of questions about detailed properties of fine-grained categories. We draw a random subset of 2,000 samples from the test split. 40 of its Google Landmarks v2 images are no longer publicly available, which leaves 1,960 samples for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 细纹类详细属性问题的基准(Mensink等人,2023年). 我们从测试中抽取2000个样本 其Google Landmarks v2的40个图像不再公开,留下1,960个样本进行评审.

blocks.en: Across all visual search and deep research benchmarks, we did not observe cases in which the search tools surface the gold answer verbatim from indexed pages. This reduces the likelihood that gains are driven by trivial retrieval of the gold answer.
blocks.zh: 在所有的视觉搜索和深入研究基准中,我们没有看到搜索工具从索引页面中逐字显示黄金答案的情况。 这减少了因小幅检索黄金答案而获得收益的可能性。

blocks.en: To align with recent multimodal deep-research work ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , we adopt the same LLM judge and use GPT-4o as the judge model, applying the prompt below uniformly across all search-related benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 为了配合近期的多式联运深入研究工作(Huang等人,2026年),我们采用了同样的LLM法官,并使用GPT-4o作为法官模式,在所有与搜索有关的基准中统一适用下文的提示。

blocks.en: LLM Judge Prompt You are an impartial judge evaluating whether a deep research report contains the correct answer. [Question] {question} [Correct Answer] {correct_answer} [Deep Research Report] {response} Task: Determine if the deep research report contains the correct answer anywhere in its content. Instructions: 1. Read through the entire research report carefully 2. Look for the correct answer anywhere in the report (it may be embedded in paragraphs, tables, or sections) 3. Check if the information in the report is consistent with the correct answer 4. The answer does NOT need to be in a specific format or labelled as “final answer” 5. Provide your reasoning 6. Answer with “yes” if the report contains the correct answer, “no” if it doesn’t or contradicts it Output format: correct: [yes/no] reasoning: [your explanation]
blocks.zh: LLM 语言 迅速法官 你是一个公正的法官,评估一份深入的调查报告是否包含正确的答案。 [问][问] [校正答 {正确_答 } [深度研究报告]{答复} 任务:确定深入研究报告的内容是否包含正确答案。 说明: 1.认真阅读整份研究报告. 2. 国家 查找报告中任何地方的正确答案(可能包含在段落、表格或章节中) 3. 检查报告中的信息是否与正确答案一致 4. 答复不必采用具体格式或标明为 " 最后答复 " 5. 提供你的推理 6. 如果报告载有正确的答案,用 " 是 " 回答,如果报告没有或与报告相矛盾,用 " 否 " 回答。

blocks.en: Some of our evaluation benchmarks contain queries that reference a real person, such as “who is the person in this photograph,” “what is the affiliation of this researcher”. Proprietary models are increasingly trained to decline such queries under their privacy and identification policies, even when the gold answer is a public-figure fact already widely indexed on the open web. We observe this for the GPT models in our setting, which return a refusal in place of an answer, which the judge counts as incorrect. Therefore, in some of the benchmarks, the GPT performance is affected to some extent.
blocks.zh: 我们的一些评估基准包含一些查询,其中提到一个真实的人,例如“照片中的人是谁”,“这名研究人员的隶属关系是什么”。 专有模式越来越多地受到训练,以根据隐私和身份识别政策拒绝此类查询,即使黄金答案是一个公众人物事实,在公开网上已经广泛索引. 法官认为这是错误的。 因此,在一些基准中,GBT的表现在一定程度上受到影响.

blocks.en: D.3 General VQA and Hallucination
blocks.zh: D.3 普通VQA和幻觉

blocks.en: This domain tests whether tool use helps, or at least does not hurt, on everyday visual questions and on questions designed to provoke hallucination.
blocks.zh: 这个域测试工具的使用在日常视觉问题和旨在引发幻觉的问题上是否有帮助,或者至少没有伤害.

blocks.en: Real-world photographs, many taken from vehicles, with multiple-choice questions about spatial layout and scene understanding ( xAI, 2024 ) ; we use all 765 questions.
blocks.zh: 真实世界照片,许多照片取自车辆,有关于空间布局和场景理解的多重选择问题(xAI,2024);我们使用所有765个问题.

blocks.en: A factuality benchmark ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) of short, knowledge-bound questions about images. We use all 2,025 questions and grade answers as correct or incorrect with an LLM judge.
blocks.zh: 关于图像的短期、知识问题的事实基准(Cheng等人,2025年)。 我们用所有的2 025个问题和分级答案 与LLM法官的正确或不正确。

blocks.en: Yes/no questions built from paired original and edited images and charts to expose language hallucination and visual illusion ( Guan et al., 2024 ) . Of the 1,129 1{,}129 questions in the released set, we evaluate the 951 951 that are grounded in an image. Free-form responses are first mapped to yes/no by an LLM extraction pass before scoring. The benchmark defines three accuracies: aAcc , the fraction of individual questions answered correctly; qAcc , the fraction of question groups for which every question is correct; and fAcc , the fraction of figures for which every associated question is correct. The latter two are deliberately strict, since a model that answers from language priors tends to succeed on the original image and fail on its edited counterpart. We report the benchmark’s Overall score, the unweighted mean of the three.
blocks.zh: 是/没有通过对齐的原始和编辑的图像和图表来构建问题,以暴露语言幻觉和视觉幻觉(Guan等人,2024年). 在发行的1,129 1{,}129个问题中,我们评价以图像为基础的951 951个问题。 Free-form响应首先通过 LLM 提取通道在得分前映射为是/否. 基准定义了三个速率: acc,单个问题答错的分数; qAcc,每个问题正确的问题组的分数; fAcc,每个相关问题正确的数字的分数. 后两者刻意严格,因为一个从语言前言中解答的模型往往在原始图像上成功,在经过编辑的对应版本上失败. 我们报告基准的总得分,即三个基准的未加权平均值。

blocks.en: FREAK ( Yin et al., 2026 ) asks about counter-commonsense images, where answering from priors rather than the pixels leads to hallucination, across detection, counting, attribute, position, and OCR questions. It comes in an open-ended format (799 questions, graded by an LLM judge) and a four-option multiple-choice format (994 questions) that includes “the correct answer is not listed”.
blocks.zh: FREAK(Yin et al., 2026)问到反常识的图像,从前传而不是像素的回答导致幻觉,跨越检测,计数,属性,位置,以及OCR问题. 它采用不限名额的形式(799个问题,由LLM法官分级)和四可选的多选择格式(994个问题),其中包括“正确答案没有列出”。

blocks.en: Questions about small attributes and relative positions of objects in high-resolution images ( Wu and Xie, 2024 ) , where the relevant detail is easy to miss at the model’s input resolution; we use all 191 questions.
blocks.zh: 关于物体在高分辨率图像中的小属性和相对位置的问题(Wu and Xie,2024),在模型的输入分辨率上,相关细节很容易错过;我们使用所有191个问题.

blocks.en: D.4 Spatial Reasoning
blocks.zh: D.4 空间原因

blocks.en: The spatial reasoning benchmarks are multiple-choice, and several of them provide multiple views of a scene, which exercises the harness’s handling of several input images. We follow the evaluation split used by the EASI leaderboard ( Cai et al., 2025 ) and use its official implementation in the VLMEvalKit repository ( Duan et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 空间推理基准是多选择的,其中数个提供了对一个场景的多视角,这些场景对几个输入图像的处理进行操控. 我们遵循EASI领导板(Cai等人,2025年)所用的评价划分,并在VLMEvalKit寄存器(Duan等人,2024年)中使用其正式执行.

blocks.en: Multi-image spatial-intelligence questions ( Yang et al., 2025b ) spanning positional relations, attributes, motion, and multi-step reasoning across views; we use the 1,000 questions in the standard (non-circular) setting.
blocks.zh: 多图像空间-智能问题(Yang et al., 2025b) 跨越位置关系,属性,运动,以及跨观点的多步推理;我们在标准(非循环)设置中使用1000个问题.

blocks.en: The embodied reasoning benchmark released with Gemini Robotics ( Team et al., 2025 ) , with 400 multiple-choice questions on spatial reasoning, trajectories, actions, and state estimation, some with several images.
blocks.zh: 与双子机器人公司(Team et al., 2025)一起发布的内含推理基准,包含400个关于空间推理,轨迹,动作和状态估计的多选择问题,有的有多个图像.

blocks.en: Spatial-relation questions posed from an egocentric viewpoint in embodied 3D scenes ( Du et al., 2024 ) ; we use all 3,640 questions.
blocks.zh: 从3D场景中以自我为中心的视角提出的空间关系问题(Du等人,2024年);我们使用所有3,640个问题。

blocks.en: Spatial perception and reasoning tasks over single and multiple views ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . We use the tiny split: 20 20 tasks × \times 50 50 questions = 1,000 =1{,}000 questions. Tasks are scored by type. Eleven multiple-choice tasks (spatial relations, spatial imagination, position matching, camera-motion inference) are scored by option-match accuracy. Eight numeric tasks (depth and distance prediction, object-centric and object-to-object, single- and multi-view) are scored by mean relative accuracy (MRA), which averages the indicator that the relative error falls below a threshold, sweeping the threshold from 0.5 0.5 to 0.95 0.95 in steps of 0.05 0.05 , so partially accurate magnitude estimates receive partial credit. One task, view-change inference, uses the benchmark’s own view-change metric. We report the Overall score: the unweighted mean of the 20 20 per-task metrics, so each task contributes equally regardless of its scoring type and regardless of the differing scales of accuracy and MRA.
blocks.zh: 空间感知和推理任务凌驾于单一和多种观点之上(张等,2026a). 我们使用微小的分割: 20 20 个任务\ tims 50 个问题= 1000 = 1{,} 000 个问题。 任务按类型打分. 11项多选择任务(空间关系,空间想象,位置匹配,相机动作推论)通过选项匹配的精度来打分. 8个数值任务(深度和距离预测,以对象为中心以及对象对对象,单视和多视)按平均相对精确度(MRA)打分,平均指标为相对误差低于阈值,将阈值从0.05 0.05步的0.5至0.95 0.95横扫,因此部分准确的量级估计得到部分信用. 一项任务,即改变观点的推论,使用基准本身的改变观点的衡量标准。 我们报告总体得分:20个任务衡量标准中未加权的平均值,因此,每项任务无论评分类型如何,也不论准确度和相互承认的分数大小如何,都作出同样的贡献。

blocks.en: Questions that require building a mental model of a scene from a few partial views, covering “among”, “around”, and rotation settings ( Wang et al., 2025c ) ; we use the 1,040-question MindCube-Tiny split.
blocks.zh: 需要从少数部分观点建立场景心理模型的问题,包括“相互之间”、“相互之间”和旋转环境(Wang等人,2025年c);我们使用1 040个问题MindCube-Tiny拆分。

blocks.en: Appendix E Failure Analysis and Harness Optimization Details
blocks.zh: 附录E 故障分析和优化

blocks.en: This appendix describes how failure diagnosis guides specialization of OpenVLHarness on a user’s data. We detail the critique protocol, the mapping from diagnoses to remedy channels, and the two workflows that modify harness text or add task-specific tools without updating model weights. We then provide examples of the resulting edits and tools.
blocks.zh: 本附录描述了失败诊断如何指导OpenVLHarness在用户数据上的专业化. 我们详细介绍了批评协议、从诊断到补救渠道的绘图以及两个工作流程,这两个工作流程在不更新模型权重的情况下修改了文本或添加特定任务工具。 然后,我们提供由此产生的编辑和工具的例子。

blocks.en: E.1 Critique Protocol
blocks.zh: E.1 标准议定书

blocks.en: We use Kimi K3 to critique failures of the unoptimized OpenVLHarness with Qwen3-VL-8B, obtaining 9,893 9{,}893 completed critiques across 22 benchmarks. Failures follow each benchmark’s judge verdict. For OdinW-13-All, FSCD-147, and FSCD-LVIS, which report box AP without per-image verdicts, we select images whose predicted boxes have F1 below 0.5 0.5 at IoU 0.5 0.5 . Table 23 reports the completed coverage.
blocks.zh: 我们用Kimi K3来批评未优化的OpenVLHarness的失败, 失败要遵循每个基准法官的裁决。 OdinW-13-All、FSCD-147和FSCD-LVIS报告AP的框,没有逐个图像判断,我们选择其预测框在IoU 0.5下F1的图像。 表23报告已完成的覆盖率。

blocks.en: Each critique includes the question, reference and predicted answers, full trajectory, input and tool-generated images, and toolbox from the run’s configuration. Tool descriptions and argument schemas are supplied with called tools marked, so the critic can assess omissions against the capabilities actually available. For each call, it labels information usefulness ( yes , partial , or no ) and correctness ( correct , wrong , or unverifiable ). It also returns one primary failure cause, a proposed fix type and sketch, supporting transcript excerpts, and confidence, all in a structured JSON record. Each critique uses approximately 3 3 k prompt tokens and 0.7 0.7 – 2 2 k completion tokens.
blocks.zh: 每次批评都包括问题、参考和预测答案、完整轨迹、输入和工具生成的图像以及运行配置的工具箱。 工具描述和论证计划提供名为标记的工具,因此评论家可以根据实际可用的能力来评估遗漏. 对于每一次通话,它都标注信息有用性(是,部分,或否)和正确性(正确,错误,或无法核实). 它还返回一个主要故障原因,一个拟议的固定类型和草图,支持记录誊本节录,以及信心,全部在结构化的JSON记录中. 每次批评都使用大约3 3 k 的速记符号和 0. 0. 7 – 2 k 的完成符号.

blocks.en: The critic separately identifies where the trajectory failed and what change could address it (Table 22 ). A build-tool fix requires a new callable, including wrappers that verify, filter, or translate outputs and compositions of existing capabilities. A text-only fix changes instructions for using existing tools. These labels are subsequently combined into remedy channels; they do not directly determine which workflow to use.
blocks.zh: 评论家分别指出轨迹失败之处和可以解决的改变(表22)。 搭建工具的固定需要一个新的可调用设备,包括可核查、过滤或翻译现有能力的输出和构成的包装。 使用现有工具的文本固定更改指令。 这些标签随后被合并为补救渠道;它们没有直接决定使用哪个工作流程.

blocks.en: Table 22: Critique taxonomy. Each failure receives one primary cause and one proposed fix type. Unusable and ignored outputs remain separate during critique and are combined for reporting in Fig. 4 and Table 23 .
blocks.zh: 表22:批判分类学. 每一次失败都有一个主要原因和一个拟议的固定类型。 在批评期间,无法使用和被忽视的产出仍然分开,并合并到图4和表23中供报告。

blocks.en: Human annotators independently labeled 100 randomly sampled critiqued failures, with an average agreement of 92 % 92\% with the critic. The abridged prompt below specifies the evidence requirements and fixed labels.
blocks.zh: 人类的注释者独立地标注了100个随机抽样的批评失败,平均92%的92QQ与批评者一致. 下文缩短的提示具体说明了证据要求和固定标签。

blocks.en: Critic prompt (abridged) You are a strict, evidence-driven critic of a vision-language tool-using agent. You are shown ONE trajectory where the agent answered a visual question wrongly, together with the correct answer and the catalog of tools the agent could call. […] The single question your critique must answer cleanly is: does fixing this family of failures require NEW TOOL CODE the agent can call, or only a TEXT change? […] How to judge each tool call. For every tool the agent called, decide info_useful (did the returned information bear on answering this question?) and info_correct (was that information actually right, judged against the image content, the question, and the correct answer?). If a grounding tool reports 3 boxes but the correct answer implies 5 objects, that output is wrong. If you cannot tell, say unverifiable; do not guess. Root cause. Choose exactly one of tool_not_called , tool_output_wrong , tool_output_unusable_form , tool_output_ignored , reasoning_error , label_or_question_issue . tool_not_called must name a tool from the agent’s toolbox that would have supplied the missing evidence; if no listed tool could have, describe the missing capability in the fix sketch instead. […] Rules. Ground every claim in the transcript: quote the tool output or the agent’s text. Never assume a tool was right just because the agent believed it. Do not propose memorizing answers or matching question wording; a fix sketch must describe a general capability or change. Set confidence low when the evidence is thin. Return ONLY a JSON object.
blocks.zh: 批评提示( 简略) 你是一个严格,证据驱动的批评 一个视觉语言工具使用剂。 向您显示 ONE 轨迹, 即代理人错误地回答一个视觉问题, 以及正确答案和代理人可以调用的工具目录 。 [...] 您的批评必须明确回答的唯一问题是: 修复这个失败的家庭需要代理商可以调用的New TOOL CODE, 还是只有TEXT更改? [...] 如何判断每个工具呼叫。 对于代理所拨打的每一个工具,决定信息是否有用(返回的信息是否对回答这个问题有用? )和信息是否正确(信息是否确实正确,根据图像内容、问题和正确的答案判断?) 如果一个定位工具报告3个框,但正确的答案意味着5个对象,那么输出就是错误的. 如果你无法判断,请说不可核实;不要猜测。 根因缘. 精确选择工具_ not_ calls, 工具_ 输出_ 错误 , 工具_ 输出_ 无法使用_ 格式, 工具_ 输出_ 忽略 , 推理_ error, 标签_ 或_ 问题_ issue_ issues 。 工具_ not_ calls必须从代理工具箱中指定一个可以提供缺失证据的工具; 如果没有列出的工具, 请在固定草图中描述缺失的能力 。 [...] 规则 在笔录中为每一项索赔提供依据:引用工具输出或代理文本。 从不认为工具是正确的 只是因为经纪人相信它。 不要提出回忆答案或匹配问题措辞;固定草图必须描述一般能力或变化. 当证据稀薄时将信心降低. 只归还一个JSON物体。

blocks.en: E.2 Remedy Channels and Per-Dataset Results
blocks.zh: E.2 补救渠道和每个数据集的结果

blocks.en: Each failed trajectory receives two labels from the critic: a root cause , describing where it failed, and a fix type , indicating whether the proposed remedy requires new tool code, a text change, or neither. We determine its remedy channel jointly from this pair, using the tool-call assessments where needed. For example, an omitted call paired with a build-tool fix maps to tool composition (C), whereas the same cause paired with a text-only fix maps to harness text (Y).
blocks.zh: 每个失败的轨迹都从评论家那里得到两个标签:一个根因,描述它失败的地方,以及一个固定型号,说明拟议补救是否需要新的工具代码,文本更改,或者两者都不要求. 我们从这两个方面共同决定其补救渠道,必要时利用工具召唤评估。 例如,一个省略的调用组合与一个构建工具的固定地图配对到工具组成(C),而同一原因则与一个仅使用文本的固定地图配对,以利用文本(Y).

blocks.en: The channels distinguish adding task-specific tools (A+B+C) from refining harness text (Y). New tools can make evidence interpretation explicit, refine outputs, or compose existing capabilities. Harness text comprises the system prompt, tool descriptions, and evidence-rendering templates; editing it guides when existing tools are called and how their results are used. We first assign cases with fix type none or a question/reference-answer issue to Z, then map the remaining cause–fix pairs as follows: • A: evidence interpretation tools. An ignored-output or reasoning-error cause paired with a build-tool fix. We also include text-only fixes for ignored outputs, or for reasoning errors when at least one call returned correct, at least partially useful evidence. These tools turn available evidence into explicit task-level conclusions that the model can more readily use. • B: output verification and refinement tools. A wrong- or unusable-output cause paired with a build-tool fix, motivating systematic verification, filtering, or translation. • C: tool composition. An omitted-call cause paired with a build-tool fix, motivating a task-specific callable that combines existing capabilities into the required operation. • Y: harness text for tool-use guidance. The remaining causes paired with a text-only fix. • Z: no proposed remedy. Cases excluded above because no fix is proposed or the question/reference answer is problematic. The motivation for A is that correct, useful evidence may still require interpretation before it supports an answer. A reasoning error despite such evidence can therefore indicate difficulty interpreting or incorporating it, as can an ignored output. We include these cases even when the critic proposes a text change, to test whether a tool that makes the relevant conclusion explicit can address the difficulty. This motivates a candidate remedy rather than establishing that interpretation caused every such failure.
blocks.zh: 通道区分了添加任务特定工具(A+B+C)和精炼带带文本(Y). 新的工具可以使证据解释明确、改进产出或构成现有能力。 使用性文本包括系统即时、工具说明和提交证据模板;编辑文本指导现有工具何时被调用以及如何使用其成果。 我们首先给Z分配一个没有固定类型或问答问题的案件,然后将剩余的原因-固定对图绘制如下: • A:证据解释工具. 被忽略的输出或推理错误原因与建材工具固定对齐. 我们还包括只针对被忽略输出的文本修正,或者至少一次回电正确时的推理错误,至少部分有用的证据. 这些工具将现有证据转化为明确的任务级结论,即该模型可以更方便地使用。 • B:产出核查和完善工具。 错误的或无法使用的输出原因与建材工具的固定配对,激励系统核查、过滤或翻译。 • C:工具构成。 一个省略的调用原因与一个建材工具的固定配对,激发了将现有能力与所需操作相结合的任务特定调用能力. • Y:利用文本提供工具使用指导。 其余的起因与仅限文本的修补对齐. • Z:无拟议补救办法。 将上述情形排除在外,因为没有提出解决办法,或者问题/参考答案有问题。 A的动机是,在它支持一个答案之前,可能需要对正确、有用的证据作出解释。 因此,尽管存在这种证据,推理错误仍可能表明解释或纳入这种错误有困难,被忽略的产出也是如此。 即使批评者提议修改案文,我们也把这些案件包括在内,以检验明确作出相关结论的工具是否能够解决困难。 这激发了一种备选补救办法,而不是确定这种解释造成这种失败。

blocks.en: A: evidence interpretation tools. An ignored-output or reasoning-error cause paired with a build-tool fix. We also include text-only fixes for ignored outputs, or for reasoning errors when at least one call returned correct, at least partially useful evidence. These tools turn available evidence into explicit task-level conclusions that the model can more readily use.
blocks.zh: A:证据解释工具。 被忽略的输出或推理错误原因与建材工具固定对齐. 我们还包括只针对被忽略输出的文本修正,或者至少一次回电正确时的推理错误,至少部分有用的证据. 这些工具将现有证据转化为明确的任务级结论,即该模型可以更方便地使用。

blocks.en: B: output verification and refinement tools. A wrong- or unusable-output cause paired with a build-tool fix, motivating systematic verification, filtering, or translation.
blocks.zh: B:产出核查和完善工具。 错误的或无法使用的输出原因与建材工具的固定配对,激励系统核查、过滤或翻译。

blocks.en: C: tool composition. An omitted-call cause paired with a build-tool fix, motivating a task-specific callable that combines existing capabilities into the required operation.
blocks.zh: C:工具组成。 一个省略的调用原因与一个建材工具的固定配对,激发了将现有能力与所需操作相结合的任务特定调用能力.

blocks.en: Y: harness text for tool-use guidance. The remaining causes paired with a text-only fix.
blocks.zh: Y:将文本用于工具使用指导。 其余的起因与仅限文本的修补对齐.

blocks.en: Z: no proposed remedy. Cases excluded above because no fix is proposed or the question/reference answer is problematic.
blocks.zh: Z:没有拟议补救办法。 将上述情形排除在外,因为没有提出解决办法,或者问题/参考答案有问题。

blocks.en: Table 23 reports the channel shares among critiqued failures. The final column illustrates why an omitted call alone does not identify the remedy: the critic proposes new tool code for 70 % 70\% of such failures on SparBench, but only 11 % 11\% on ERQA. The four datasets in Sec. 3.6 span contrasting profiles: Y accounts for 71 % 71\% of ERQA and 56 % 56\% of RealWorldQA failures, while A+B+C account for 75 % 75\% of SparBench and 62 % 62\% of FREAK-VQA failures. These shares guide the choice of workflow; they do not predict accuracy gains. Critiques of failures alone cannot establish whether an edit harms previously correct answers or whether the orchestrator will use a generated tool.
blocks.zh: 表23报告频道在受到批评的故障中的份额。 最后一栏说明了为什么一个省略的调用不能识别补救办法:评论家在Spar Bench上为70%的这种故障提出了新的工具代码,但在ERQA上只有11%的11\%. Sec.3.6中的四个数据集横跨对比剖面: Y占ERQA的71% 71% 和RealWorldQA的56% 56% 失败,而A+B+C占Spar Bench的75% 75% 和FREAK-VQA的62% 62% 失败. 这些股份指导工作流程的选择;它们不预测准确收益. 仅是失败的批评因素无法确定编辑是否伤害了先前正确的答案,或者管弦乐手是否会使用生成的工具.

blocks.en: E.3 Optimization Algorithms
blocks.zh: E.3 优化算法

blocks.en: Both workflows use a coding agent (Codex with GPT-5.5) to inspect trajectories and modify a scratch copy of the harness. Candidates are evaluated by running the Qwen3-VL-8B orchestrator and applying the benchmark judge. Harness search changes instructions and evidence presentation; tool generation adds callable operations built from existing capabilities. Both keep model weights fixed.
blocks.zh: 两个工作流程都使用一个编码代理(Codex with GPT-5.5)来检查轨迹,并修改一个抓痕拷贝的吊带. 通过运行Qwen3-VL-8B管弦乐团和运用基准裁判来评价候选人. 机理搜索修改指令和证据演示;工具生成增加了从现有能力中构建的可调用操作. 两者都保持模型重量固定.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 maintains a pool of harness states represented as file overlays on the base repository. The editable components are the system prompt and tool-use policy, tool descriptions, and model-facing output templates. For each parent state, an analysis agent inspects failed trajectories and may test hypotheses on up to 20 tasks with five trials each. A proposer then produces M M distinct patches without instance-specific rules. Candidates include individual patches and compatible combinations of up to K K patches. Each candidate is evaluated with S S samples per instance using paired sampling seeds. The top N N parents and children by mean search accuracy survive, with older states winning exact ties. A campaign runbook records proposals and scores for subsequent rounds.
blocks.zh: 算法 1 维持着一个以文件覆盖为代表的带状状态集合在基础寄存器上. 可编辑的组件是系统即时和工具使用政策,工具描述和模型化输出模板. 对于每个母国家,一个分析代理人检查故障的轨迹,并可以测试最多20项任务的假设,每个任务有5次试验. 然后,提议者在没有具体实例规则的情况下生产M M 特性补丁。 考生包括个人补丁和最多K K补丁的兼容组合. 每个候选人都使用SS样本使用配对的取样种子进行抽样评估。 N级顶级父母和子女通过平均搜索精度存活下来,年长的州赢得了确切的联系. 一份竞选记录记录了以后各轮的提议和得分.

blocks.en: We use N = 4 N{=}4 , M = 4 M{=}4 , K = 4 K{=}4 , S = 3 S{=}3 , and three rounds. ERQA uses 100 samples and is evaluated on a disjoint 300-sample validation split for assessing leading candidates. Similarly, RealWorldQA uses 100 samples and is reported on the disjoint 665 validation split. The first-round analysis can optionally use an earlier critique report, provided its claims are checked against the current trajectories. Thus, failure diagnosis can guide the choice of workflow without being a required input to the search algorithm.
blocks.zh: 使用N=4N{=}4,M=4M{=}4,K=4K{=}4,S=3S{=}3,共三轮. ERQA使用100个样本,并被评估为主要候选人的300个样本分解脱节验证。 同样,现实世界 QA使用100个样本,并报告断开的665验证分裂. 第一轮分析可以选择性地使用早先的批评报告,只要对照目前的轨迹检查其说法。 因此,失败诊断可以指导工作流程的选择,而不成为搜索算法的必备输入.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Harness search
blocks.zh: 算法 1 策略搜索

blocks.en: Algorithm 2 groups source failures into at most D D candidate tool directions, each describing a reusable operation and the failures it should address. Supporting examples are divided equally into tuning and held-out subsets. A tool-writing agent implements each candidate by composing existing capabilities; it may invoke tools, execute code, and query the base model. For up to T T rounds, the candidate is registered in the scratch harness and evaluated on the tuning subset. A separate diagnosis agent classifies its use as not called, execution failed, evidence inadequate, evidence misinterpreted, or used correctly, and the tool-writing agent revises the implementation accordingly. Dataset- or instance-specific answer rules and lookup tables are prohibited.
blocks.zh: 算法 2 组将失败源源到最多 D D D 候选工具方向,每组描述一个可重复使用的操作以及它应该处理的失败. 支持性实例平等分为调和和搁置子集。 一个工具写作代理通过编组现有能力来执行每个候选;它可以引用工具,执行代码,并查询基础模型. 最多T T 轮,候选人在刮毛带注册,并在调音子集上进行评估。 单独的诊断剂将其使用分类为不调用,执行失败,证据不足,证据被误解或使用正确,工具写作剂相应修改执行. 数据集或实例特定答案规则和查询表被禁止.

blocks.en: The final gate requires complete scoring, at least two recovered failures and positive net lift across all supporting examples, and at least one recovered failure with positive net lift on the held-out half, whose trajectories were not shown to the tool-writing agent. Because these examples are selected from baseline failures, this gate measures recovery rather than regressions on initially correct answers. Accepted tools are collected into a bank and evaluated together with the original harness on the target dataset. We use D ≤ 5 D{\leq}5 , T = 5 T{=}5 , and 50 examples per direction on SparBench and 30 on FREAK-VQA. For both SparBench and FREAK-VQA, we generate tools on data disjoint from the standard evaluation splits and evaluate the resulting harness on the same splits used in our main experiments.
blocks.zh: 最终的闸门需要完整的打分,至少两个恢复的故障和正净升力跨越所有佐证实例,以及至少一个恢复的故障,在被扣掉的半个部分有正净升力,其轨迹没有向工具写作代理显示. 由于这些例子是从基线故障中选取的,所以这个闸门测量的是恢复,而不是在最初正确的答案上的回归. 接受的工具被收集到一个银行,并与目标数据集上的原始工具一起进行评估。 我们在Spar Bench和FREAK-VQA的每个方向上使用D~ 5 D{\leq}5,T=5 T{=}5,以及50个例子. 对Spar Bench和FREAK-VQA来说,我们生成了与标准评价拆分脱节的数据工具,并用我们主要实验中使用的相同拆分来评价由此产生的利用。

blocks.en: Algorithm 2 Tool generation
blocks.zh: 算法 2 工具生成

blocks.en: E.4 Optimized Harnesses and Generated Tools
blocks.zh: E.4 优化利用和生成工具

blocks.en: The RealWorldQA example below combines edits from three search rounds: five system-prompt additions and one addition to the Visual Grounding output template. They guide the orchestrator to inspect small road-scene details, verify counts, and match its visual conclusion to the answer options. The output-template edit illustrates how evidence rendering supports adaptation: it prompts verification of grounded candidates before they are used as counts or relation evidence.
blocks.zh: 现实世界 以下QA实例结合了从三个搜索回合中编辑的内容:5个系统即时添加和1个Visual Grounding输出模板. 它们引导管弦乐手检查小路面细节,核实计数,并将其视觉结论与答案选项匹配. 产出模式编辑说明了证据的提供如何支持适应性:它促使在被调查候选人用作计数或关系证据之前对其进行核查。

blocks.en: Edits in a top-scoring RealWorldQA harness (additions only) System prompt, when to use visual tools. For road-scene details such as traffic lights, traffic signs, arrows, lane markings, and whether a driver must stop, use visual tools before answering unless the relevant mark or signal is unmistakably large and clear. Before answering that such a detail is absent, not visible, or has a particular color/direction, ground the likely object or region and inspect the original pixels with zoom if the region is small or distant. System prompt, using tool results. For count questions with numeric options, compare the filtered candidate count with the option values. If the count is outside the listed values or directly adjacent to a listed value, do one missed-object check using a broader/simple phrase or one targeted zoom of the most uncertain region, then choose the listed option best supported by all evidence. For counts of printed letters, digits, or symbols, use OCR or a text-focused zoom when available before deciding the count. Unless the question explicitly says “standalone”, count occurrences inside longer strings as well as isolated characters. System prompt, final answer. For multiple-choice questions, before writing <answer> , explicitly bind your visual conclusion to the option table. The option letter and option text you output must match each other and match the conclusion in your thinking; if your conclusion is not one of the options, re-check the evidence instead of choosing a nearby option. If the listed options do not include a none/unknown/cannot-determine choice, never use an unlisted absence answer such as “none of the above”, “not visible”, or “cannot tell”. If your draft conclusion is that the needed cue is absent, do one targeted visual check when a tool can resolve it, then answer with the listed option best supported by the evidence. Visual Grounding output template (appended after the list of boxes). Treat these as candidate regions, not a verified final count. Before answering count, presence, or relation questions, compare each candidate with the original image and remove duplicates, mirror/reflection copies, partial regions, off-target detections, and objects that fail the question’s location or context constraint.
blocks.zh: 在一个得分最高的 RealWorldQA 控制器中编辑(仅添加) 系统即时,何时使用视觉工具. 对于交通信号灯,交通标志,箭头,车道标志等道路景色细节,以及驾驶员是否必须停车,在回答前使用视觉工具,除非相关标志或信号明显大而清晰. 在回答这样的细节不存在,不可见,或有特定的颜色/方向之前,先对可能的对象或区域进行测地,如果区域小或遥远,则用缩放检查原始像素. 系统即时,使用工具结果. 对于带有数字选项的计数问题,将过滤后的候选人计数与选项值进行比较. 如果计数不在列表值之外或直接与列表值相邻,则使用一个更广泛的/简单的短语或一个最不确定区域的定向缩放来进行一个缺失对象检查,然后选择所有证据最支持的列表选项. 对于打印字母、数字或符号的计数,在决定计数之前,在可用时使用OCR或文字聚焦的缩放。 除非问题明确地说“独立”,否则,在较长的字符串和孤立字符中,就会出现数字。 系统快速,最后答案。 对于多个选择问题,在写入 < answer > 之前,明确将您的视觉结论绑定在选项表上。 您输出的选项字母和选项文本必须相互匹配并匹配思维中的结论; 如果您的结论不是选项之一, 请重新检查证据而不是选择附近的选项 。 如果所列选项不包括一个无/未知/无法确定的选择,就永远不要使用“上述任何一种”、“看不见”或“无法知道”等未列出的答案。 如果您的结论草案中缺少所需的提示, 在工具能够解决时进行一次目标明确的视觉检查, 然后用最有证据支持的所列选项回答 。 Visual Grounding 输出模板(在框列表之后应用). 将这些区域视为候选区域,而不是经过核实的最后点数。 在回答计数,存在,或关系问题之前,将每个候选对象与原始图像进行比较,并删除复制,镜像/反射复制,部分区域,非目标检测,以及没有问题位置或上下文约束的对象.

blocks.en: Table 24 lists the five accepted tools: two from SparBench failures and three from FREAK-MCQ failures. A fourth FREAK direction, localized text and symbol reading, encountered an execution error before completing the gate. The SparBench tools package depth, camera intrinsics, and cross-view geometry into metric 3D operations, addressing the composition needs of channel C. In the diagnosed SparBench failures, the critic judged 87 % 87\% of Python Coding Agent calls incorrect, motivating reusable implementations of these computations. The FREAK tools make visibility, layout, and counting decisions explicit, addressing the evidence-interpretation needs of channel A. The visibility verifier recovered the most gate examples among the three FREAK tools; the table reports generation-stage recovery, not a per-tool benchmark ablation.
blocks.zh: 表24列出了五个被接受的工具:两个来自Spar Bench故障,三个来自FREAK-MCQ故障. 第四个FREAK方向,局部文本和符号读取,在完成闸门前遇到执行错误. Spar Bench工具包的深度,相机内在,以及跨视图几何化成参数的3D操作,解决了C频道的构成需求. 在确诊的Spar Bench故障中,评论家判断了Python编码代理87%的87QQ调用不正确,激发了这些计算可重复使用的执行. FREAK工具明确了决定的能见度、布局和计数,满足了频道A的证据解释需求。 可见度核查员在三个FREAK工具中恢复了最典型的例子;表格报告了生成阶段的恢复,而不是每个工具的基准消耗。

These counts measure recovery on selected failures, not accuracy on the full target benchmark.

blocks.en: Together, these examples illustrate two ways to adapt the same general-purpose harness to custom data: refine the instructions and rendered evidence when existing capabilities suffice, or add reusable operations when failures call for explicit interpretation, output refinement, or tool composition.
blocks.zh: 这些例子共同说明两种方法,使相同的通用利用适应自定义数据:在现有能力足够时,改进说明和提供证据;在失败需要明确解释、产出改进或工具构成时,增加可重复操作。

Each example starts on a new page under a dark title bar and ends with an “End of Example” rule, and every step header names its example. Each example is laid out the same way:

blocks.en: • Overview and step notes. Each example opens with a green overview box that explains in plain words what the task asks, why it is hard without tools, and how the agent solves it. For the proprietary GPT-6 models, each step then opens with a short green “What happens” note that says what the call does and why it matters. We add these notes only for proprietary models, whose reasoning traces we cannot access: the API returns the tool calls and any visible text, but not the model’s reasoning, and GPT-6 often calls a tool without writing any text at all. The open Qwen3-VL models expose their reasoning, which they write in <thinking> tags before each call and which we show verbatim, so their examples have no step notes. The overviews and notes are our descriptions, written to guide the reader; everything else in the trajectory is verbatim. • Inputs, question and results. The input images and the question exactly as sent to the model, then a table comparing the answer with and without the harness against the ground truth. For grounded perception examples, the table also shows what SAM 3, the model behind Visual Grounding, returns when queried alone, where the trajectory makes that measurable. For some Qwen3-VL examples no run of the same model without tools is available, and the table says so. • Without tools. The same model’s full response to the same question with no tools, where such a run exists. • Full trajectory with OpenVLHarness. Every tool call in order. Each step shows the tool, colour-coded by family ( perception , search , computation ); the complete arguments the model sent; the text the model wrote alongside the call, when there is any; the tool’s output, including the complete code the coding agent wrote and its execution output; and every image the tool returned, which the model sees in its next turn. For grounding examples, whose final answer is a list of coordinates, we add a panel drawing the final boxes on the input image, marked as ours. • Harness messages. On a cream background : the environment updates through which the multimodal memory tells the model what it currently holds (Appendix C.4 ), including the data bindings that pass tool results to the coding agent. • What to notice. A closing note on how the harness contributed.

blocks.en: Example 1  Dataset: FSC-147   Model: GPT-6 Sol
blocks.zh: 例1 数据集:FSC-147 模型:GPT-6 Sol

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. Count the pills in a photograph of about 140 pills of many colours and two shapes, oblong capsules and small round tablets, scattered on a dark surface. Why it is hard. There are too many to count reliably by eye, and a single detector query does not reliably find both shapes. How the agent solves it. It runs two grounding queries, one general and one for round pills, then asks the coding agent to merge the two sets of detections without counting any pill twice. The first merge fails silently; the agent notices the impossible result and rewrites the merge, which then finds the five pills the first query missed.
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 将药丸数在一张相片中,大约140片多色的药丸和2个形状,圆形胶囊和小圆形的药丸,散落在暗处. 为甚么难. 有太多的可以可靠地用眼睛计算,一个单一的探测器查询无法可靠地找到两种形状. 代理人如何解脱. 它运行两个地面查询,一个是普通的,一个是圆药,然后请编码剂将两组检测器合并,不计算任何药片两次. 第一次合并无声失败;代理机注意到不可能的结果,并重写合并,然后发现第一个查询错过的五丸.

blocks.en: WHAT HAPPENS The agent asks the coding agent to merge the two sets. Both sets are available to the code as data bindings ( segment_pill and segment_round_pill ), so no coordinates need to be copied by hand. The run completes but reports zero matches and a union of zero, which cannot be right, since both queries detect the same pills.

blocks.en: WHAT HAPPENS The agent restates the objective more narrowly: compare boxes only, by overlap or centre distance, and do not decode masks. This time the code finds five round detections that match nothing in the first set.

max(x1_1, x1_2)) y_int = max(0, min(y2_1, y2_2) - max(y1_1, y1_2)) intersection = x_int * y_int # Compute union area1 = (x2_1 - x1_1) * (y2_1 - y1_1) area2 = (x2_2 - x1_2) * (y2_2 - y1_2) union = area1 + area2 - intersection if union == 0: return 0.0 return intersection / union # Helper function to compute center proximity (Euclidean distance between centers) def center_proximity(box1, box2): x1_1, y1_1, x2_1, y2_1 = box1 x1_2, y1_2, x2_2, y2_2 = box2 center1_x, center1_y = (x1_1 + x2_1) / 2, (y1_1 + y2_1) / 2 center2_x, center2_y = (x1_2 + x2_2) / 2, (y1_2 + y2_2) / 2 return np.sqrt((center1_x - center2_x)**2 + (center1_y - center2_y)**2) # Threshold for matching: IoU >= 0.45 OR center proximity <= 10 pixels (arbitrary, but reasonable for visual matching) MATCH_THRESHOLD_IOU = 0.45 MATCH_THRESHOLD_CENTER = 10.0 # Initialize lists to track matches and unmatched detections matched_round_indices = set() matched_original_indices = set() unmatched_round_indices = [] unmatched_original_indices = [] # For each round pill detection, try to match with original pill detections for round_idx, round_box in enumerate(round_boxes): matched = False for orig_idx, orig_box in enumerate(original_boxes): iou_val = iou(round_box, orig_box) center_dist = center_proximity(round_box, orig_box) if iou_val >= MATCH_THRESHOLD_IOU or center_dist <= MATCH_THRESHOLD_CENTER: # Found a match matched = True matched_round_indices.add(round_idx) matched_original_indices.add(orig_idx) break if not matched: unmatched_round_indices.append(round_idx) # Find original detections that have major overlaps (duplicates) - i.e., matched with multiple round pills duplicate_original_indices = [] for orig_idx in matched_original_indices: count = 0 for round_idx in range(len(round_boxes)): if round_idx not in matched_round_indices: continue iou_val = iou(original_boxes[orig_idx], round_boxes[round_idx]) center_dist = center_proximity(original_boxes[orig_idx], round_boxes[round_idx]) if iou_val >= MATCH_THRESHOLD_IOU or center_dist <= MATCH_THRESHOLD_CENTER: count += 1 if count > 1: duplicate_original_indices.append(orig_idx) # Output results print("Round detections missing from original:", unmatched_round_indices) print("Original detections with major overlaps (duplicates):", duplicate_original_indices) ``` Execution output: Round detections missing from original: [23, 25, 26, 40, 41] Original detections with major overlaps (duplicates): []

blocks.en: WHAT HAPPENS The agent adds the five missing pills to the 134 from Step 1 and answers 139, the exact count.
blocks.zh: 发生了什么事 药剂师在步骤1的134个药丸中添加了5个缺失的药丸,并回答139,准确的计数.

blocks.en: MODEL
blocks.zh: 民主运动

blocks.en: <answer>139</answer>

What to notice. SAM 3 finds 134 pills with the query “pill” and 72 with “round pill”; the two sets overlap, and neither is the answer. The model asks the coding agent to merge them. The first run reports zero matches and a union of zero (Step 3), which cannot be right, since both queries find the same pills. The model rewrites the objective: match by box overlap or centre distance only, with no mask decoding. The second run (Step 4) finds five round pills missing from the first set, and the model answers 134 + 5 = 139 134+5=139 , the exact count. Without tools the model says 137. The detections reach the code as data bindings held in memory, so the model can recover from a bad run by restating the objective instead of re-detecting.
blocks.zh: 何以觉悟. SAM 3发现134个药丸,询问“溢出”,72个药丸“圆片”;两套药丸重叠,答案也不相同。 模型要求编码代理将其合并. 第一次运行报告为0匹配和0结合(步骤3),这不可能是正确的,因为两个查询都发现了相同的药丸. 模型重写目标:仅通过框重叠或中心距离匹配,没有面具解码. 第二轮(第4步)发现第1集中缺少5个圆形药丸,模型答案为134+5=139 134+5=139,准确计数. 没有工具,模型说137。 探测器以内存中持有的数据绑定方式到达代码,因此模型可以通过重载目标而不是重新探测来从糟糕运行中恢复.

blocks.en: Example 2  Dataset: OdinW-13-All (PascalVOC subset)   Model: GPT-6 Sol
blocks.zh: 例2 数据集: OdinW- 13- All( PascalVOC 子集) 型号: GPT-6 Sol

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. Detect every object of the twenty PascalVOC categories in a photograph of fourteen men posing around a dinner table, and return labelled boxes. Why it is hard. The people overlap heavily, some are visible only as a face between two others, and the table is covered with bottles and plates. How the agent solves it. After a first pass over the four categories present, it zooms on the crowded table and issues narrower queries, ending with a referring expression for one partly hidden man. The final answer matches 22 of the 23 ground-truth objects.
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 在一张14个人在餐桌周围摆姿势的照片中,检测20个PascalVOC类别的物品,并归还贴有标签的盒子。 为甚么难. 人多重叠,有的只作为另外两张相貌可见,桌子上覆盖着瓶子和盘子. 代理人如何解脱. 在第一次越过在场的四类之后,它放大了拥挤的桌子,并发出较窄的询问,最后用一个部分隐蔽的人的参考表达. 最后的答案符合23个地面真人物体中的22个.

blocks.en: WHAT HAPPENS The agent answers with 23 labelled boxes; the evaluator matches 22 of them to ground truth, with one false positive and one miss.
blocks.zh: 发生了什么事 特工用23个贴有标签的盒子回答问题;评估人员将其中22个与事实相符,其中1个是假阳性,1个是错的。

blocks.en: MODEL
blocks.zh: 民主运动

blocks.en: NOTE Panel drawn by us from the final answer: the 23 predicted boxes on the input image, coloured by label.
blocks.zh: 说明 我们从最后的答案中抽取的面板:输入图像上的23个预测框,用标签涂色.

blocks.en: What to notice. After grounding the four categories present, the model zooms on the crowded table and issues narrower queries for what the first pass missed: “table”, “man”, “person in dark shirt”, and finally “man behind the man in white shirt” for a partly hidden person. The last query is a referring expression, not a category name; SAM 3 can resolve it, and the harness lets the model use that ability. The final answer matches 22 of the 23 ground-truth objects with one false positive.
blocks.zh: 何以觉悟. 在将在场的四类人打下基础后,模型放大了拥挤的桌子,并对第一个通行证错过的是什么提出更狭隘的询问: " 表 " 、 " 人 " 、 " 穿深色衬衫的人 " ,最后是 " 穿白衬衫的人后面的人 " ,作为部分隐藏的人。 最后一个查询是一个引用表达式,而不是一个类别名称;SAM 3可以解决它,而控制器让模型使用这种能力. 最终答案与23个地面真人物体中的22个匹配,1个是假阳性。
