blocks.en: Example 3  Dataset: FSCD-147   Model: GPT-6 Sol
blocks.zh: 例3 数据集:FSCD-147 模型:GPT-6 Sol

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. Box every “package of fresh cut fruit” on a supermarket shelf that holds 53 plastic fruit cups in rows. Why it is hard. The category name as given is unusual; a detector queried with it finds only part of the shelf. How the agent solves it. It rephrases the category as “fruit cup”, which finds every cup, checks two regions with zooms, and returns 53 boxes that all match. Note that the no-tool answer scores zero only because it used pixel coordinates instead of the requested 0–1000 scale (see the note under the results).
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 将每件“新鲜切果包”装入连续存放53个塑料水果杯的超市货架。 为甚么难. 所给出的类别名称是不寻常的;被询问的检测器只找到部分架子. 代理人如何解脱. 它将这一类别重新定义为“水果杯”,它发现每个杯,检查两个区域并缩放,返回53个全部匹配的框。 注意,无工具的答案只因为使用了像素坐标而不是所要求的0–1000比例(见结果下的注)而得零分.

For each instance, output a bounding box as [x1, y1, x2, y2] where coordinates are normalised on a 0-1000 scale (with (0,0) as the top-left corner and (1000,1000) as the bottom-right corner). Your answer should be a list of lists. If there are no instances of 'package of fresh cut fruit' in the image, output an empty list [] as your answer.
blocks.zh: 问题: 将所有“ 新鲜切果包” 实例放入此图像 。 对于每个实例,输出一个边框作为[x1, y1, x2, y2], 其中坐标按0-1000比例(以(0, 0)为左上角,以(1000, 1 000)为右下角)正常化。 你的答案应该是名单 如果图像中没有“ 新鲜切果包” 实例, 请输出一个空列表 。

blocks.en: Example 4  Dataset: MMSearch-Plus   Model: GPT-6 Luna
blocks.zh: 例4 数据集: MMSearch-Plus 模型: GBT-6 Luna

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. A street photograph from Paris Fashion Week shows a woman in a beige jacket and an orange scarf (faces are blurred in the benchmark image). Which brand’s show was she attending, and which event and year was it? Why it is hard. Nothing in the image names the show; without tools the model guesses a Miu Miu show in 2024. How the agent solves it. A reverse image search finds no match, so the agent turns the photo into a text description and runs an image search with it. The top result is a street-style gallery titled “What they wore to Hermès” at Paris Fashion Week Fall/Winter 2025, and a page visit confirms the event and season. Caveat. The perception step contributes nothing: the agent zooms on what it takes for a shopping bag, but the OCR reads a Paris litter-bag slogan (“Ensemble rendons Paris propre”). The answer comes from search alone.
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 巴黎时装周的街道照片显示一名身穿美眉外套和橙色围巾(在基准图像中面部模糊)的妇女. 她参加了哪个品牌的节目,以及哪些活动和年份? 为甚么难. 图像中没有任何名称显示;没有工具,模型猜测2024年的Miu Miu显示. 代理人如何解脱. 反向图像搜索找不到匹配,所以代理将照片转换成文字描述,并与之一起运行图像搜索. 巴黎时装周周秋季/2025年冬季, 卡维特 感知步骤无济于事:代理人放大了购物袋所需的东西,但OCR读到了一个巴黎垃圾袋口号(“巴黎预告”)。 答案仅来自搜索。

blocks.en: Example 5  Dataset: MMSearch-Plus   Model: Qwen3-VL-32B
blocks.zh: 例5 数据集: MMSearch-Plus 模型: Qune3-VL-32B

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. The question, in Chinese, asks: how many years apart are the famous Great-Depression-era event commemorated in the first image and the event shown in the second? The first image is a rusted steel monument in a park; the second is a black-and-white photograph of a fight. How the agent solves it. It identifies each image with reverse image search and dates each event from the web: the Ford Hunger March of 7 March 1932, and the Ford Strikers Riot of 3 April 1941. One page visit fails with a server error, and the agent recovers with a text search. It answers 9 years. The model reasons in Chinese throughout.
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 问题在中文中问:第一幅画面中纪念的著名大萧条时代事件与第二幅画面中显示的事件间隔了多少年?. 第一幅图像是一座公园中生锈的钢制纪念碑;第二幅是一张打斗的黑白照片. 代理人如何解脱. 它用反向图像搜索确定每个图像,并从网络上确定每个事件的日期:1932年3月7日的福特饥饿游行,1941年4月3日的福特冲锋暴动. 一页访问因服务器错误而失败,代理通过文本搜索恢复. 答九经. 整个汉语的模型原因.

blocks.en: Example 5 · Final answer
blocks.zh: 例5——最后答案

blocks.en: MODEL
blocks.zh: 民主运动

blocks.en:
<thinking>现在我已经知道： - 图1中的事件是**福特饥饿游行（Ford Hunger March）**，发生在 **1932年3月7日**。
- 图2中的事件是**福特罢工者骚乱（Ford Strikers Riot）**，发生在 **1941年4月3日**。 因此，这两个事件之间的年份差可以通过简单的减法计算得出：1941 - 1932 = 9年。 所以，图1和图2中的事件相隔9年。
</thinking> <answer>9年</answer>

What to notice. Each image is identified by its own reverse image search, and each event is dated from a web page, so the answer needs two independent chains of evidence and one subtraction. When a page fetch fails with a server error (Step 4), the harness reports the failure and suggests alternatives, and the model recovers with a text search instead of guessing the date.
blocks.zh: 何以觉悟. 每个图像都是通过自己的反向图像搜索来识别的,每个事件都从网页上注明日期,所以答案需要两个独立的证据链和一个减法. 当一个页面获取失败的服务器错误(Step 4)时,控制器会报告失败并提出替代方案,模型通过文本搜索而不是猜测日期来恢复.

blocks.zh: 例6 数据集: RealX-Bench 模型: GPT-6 卢纳

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. A photograph shows a crowded skincare shelf. Which brand does the item at the far right of the top row belong to? The item is a tall white spray can whose label is far too small to read. Why it is hard. Nothing legible identifies the product; without tools the model guesses AHC. How the agent solves it. Zooms and OCR on the top shelf return only book spines and dates, and a reverse search of the whole shelf returns generic “shelfie” boards. The agent goes back to the image: it zooms on the bottles again, grounds them to see where each one sits, crops tightly, and reverse-searches the crop, which matches Miyuequan (Miyue Spring) hydrating spray.
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 照片显示一个拥挤的护肤架. 上排最右边的物品属于哪个品牌? 该物品是一个高大的白色喷雾罐,其标签太小,无法读取. 为甚么难. 无法识别产品;没有工具,模型猜测为AHC. 代理人如何解脱. 顶架上的缩放和OCR只返回书的脊椎和日期,而对整个书架的反向搜索则返回一般的“shelfie”板。 药剂回到画面上:它再次放大瓶子上,让他们看到每个瓶子都坐在哪里,庄稼紧紧地,反向搜索作物,这与米尤泉(英语:Miyue Spring)的水化喷雾相匹配.

blocks.en: What to notice. When the whole-image search fails, the agent does not keep searching blindly: it returns to the image, uses grounding to isolate the target among similar bottles, and turns a tight crop into the search query. Perception and search alternate several times, and the product is identified only once the crop is tight enough for the reverse search to match it.
blocks.zh: 何以觉悟. 当全图像搜索失败时,代理商不会继续盲目搜索:它返回图像,使用地面将目标隔离在相似的瓶子中,将紧凑的作物变成搜索查询. 感知和搜索多次交替进行,产品只有在作物足够紧,反向搜索才能匹配时才能被识别出来.

blocks.en: Example 7  Dataset: RealX-Bench   Model: GPT-6 Sol
blocks.zh: 例7 数据集: RealX- Bench 模型: GPT-6 Sol

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. A makeup organizer holds brushes and cosmetics. Which brand is the liquid foundation at the far right? Its label is unreadable; its most distinctive feature is a crystal-faceted cap. Why it is hard. Without tools the model guesses Dior. How the agent solves it. OCR reads nothing, and reverse-searching a crop of the bottle finds no match. The agent then searches by description (“faceted crystal cap”), tries a Jill Stuart hypothesis and drops it, and reverse-searches a tighter crop. That search’s summary names the bottle as KATOKATO, and a targeted image search returns a KATO-KATO foundation whose cap matches the crop. Caveat. The brand name first appears in the reverse-search tool’s own summary of the crop, so the decisive step is partly inside the tool.
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 化妆品组织者持有刷子和化妆品. 哪一个牌子是 液体基础在远右? 其标签不可读;其最显著的特点是晶面盖. 为甚么难. 没有工具 模型猜测Dior。 代理人如何解脱. OCR读不出来,逆向搜索瓶的一粒庄稼则找不到匹配. 毒剂然后通过描述进行搜索(“面部晶盖”),尝试吉尔·斯图亚特假说并放弃它,反向搜索更紧的作物. 以KATOKATO命名的瓶子, 卡维特 品牌名称最早出现在逆向搜索工具本身对作物的总结中,因此决定性的步骤部分在工具内.

blocks.en: What to notice. With no readable text, the agent searches by what it can see (the faceted cap), states and rejects a brand hypothesis, and returns to reverse image search on its own crop. The final targeted search lets it check the candidate brand against the cap it saw, rather than accept the name on trust.
blocks.zh: 何以觉悟. 在没有可读文本的情况下,代理通过能看见的东西(面盖)进行搜索,声明和拒绝一个品牌假说,并返回在自己的裁剪上反转图像搜索. 最终的定向搜索使得它能够对照它看到的盖子检查候选品牌,而不是接受信任上的名字.

blocks.en: Example 8  Dataset: FVQA   Model: Qwen3-VL-32B
blocks.zh: 例8 数据集:FVQA模型: Quen3-VL-32B

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. A photograph shows two hikers resting with their backpacks. What awards has this product won? Why it is hard. The product is not named anywhere, and the logos on the backpacks are too small to read. How the agent solves it. It grounds the two backpacks, tries to read each with zoom and OCR, and, when that fails, reverse-searches the crop of the green backpack, which identifies it as a Deuter Speed Lite Pro. A product page mentions no award, so it searches for awards and verifies the result on the manufacturer’s press release: the ISPO Award 2024. Nine calls use six different tools.
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 照片显示两名徒步者背负着背包休息. 这个产品赢得了什么奖项? 为甚么难. 产品在任何地方都没有命名,背包上的标志太小,无法阅读. 代理人如何解脱. 它将两个背包打下方,试图用缩放和OCR来读每个背包,当它失败时,反向搜索绿色背包的作物,这个背包将它识别为Deuter速度Lite Pro. 一个产品页没有提及奖项,因此它寻找奖项,并在制造商的新闻稿:ISPO奖2024上核实结果. 九召使用六种不同工具.

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. A photograph shows the leaves and catkins of a flowering tree. From a riddle-like description (a common name that resembles an animal feature, a family that also contains a common Northern-Hemisphere genus, endemic to several provinces of southwestern China), name the regions of China where it is native. How the agent approaches it. A reverse image search fails, so the agent hypothesizes a species, Castanopsis argentea , tests it with a text search and a Wikipedia visit, finds that the species is native to Java and Sumatra rather than China, rejects it, and searches again at the level of the genus. Caveat. The species is never identified. The four provinces in the final answer first appear in the model’s own reasoning, before any search supports them, and the searches only confirm that the genus is diverse in Yunnan. The answer matches the ground truth, but it is not fully grounded in the retrieved evidence.
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 照片显示一棵开花树的叶子和猫皮. 从类似谜语的描述(一个类似动物特征的常见名称,一个也包含一个常见的北-海米斯环系的家族,流行于中国西南部的几个省份),命名为中国本土地区. 代理人如何接近它。 反向图像搜索失败,因此代理商对一个物种Castanopsis argentea进行假设,通过文本搜索和维基百科访问进行测试,发现该物种是爪哇和苏门答腊的原生而非中国,拒绝它,再次进行基因级搜索. 卡维特 该物种从未被识别. 最终答案中的四省首先出现在模型自己的推理中,在任何搜索都支持之前,搜索只证实了云南的流派多样性. 答案与地面真相相符,但并非完全基于所获取的证据。

blocks.en: <thinking>The image shows a plant with green leaves and catkin-like structures, which resemble the common name ”hazel” or ”beech,” possibly referring to a plant like *Corylus* (hazelnut) or another member of the Betulaceae family. However, the question specifically mentions a plant endemic to southwestern China, with a common name resembling a distinctive animal feature—this strongly suggests *Castanopsis*, commonly called ”chestnut” or sometimes ”horse chestnut” (though horse chestnut is typically *Aesculus*). But more likely, given the habitat and region, it could refer to *Castanopsis argentea* or similar species, which are part of the Fagaceae family (which also includes oaks and beeches). To identify the exact species and confirm its native regions in China, I need to perform a reverse image search to determine the precise plant species.</thinking>
blocks.zh: < 思考> 图像显示一种具有绿叶和猫皮状结构的植物,类似俗称的"Hazel"或"Beech",可能是指类似*Corylus*(Hazelnut)或Betulaceae家族另一成员的一种植物. 然而,这个问题特别提到了中国西南部特有的一种植物,其共同名称类似于一种独特的动物特征——这强烈表明*Castanopsis*,通常称为“栗子”或有时称为“马栗子”(虽然马栗子一般是*Aesculus*)。 但更可能的是,鉴于栖息地和区域,它可以指: *Castanopsis argentea* 或类似的物种,它们属于法加塞亚家族(其中也包括橡树和蜜蜂). 为了确定确切的物种,确认其在中国的原生地区,我需要进行反向图像搜索,以确定确切的植物物种. </thinking>

blocks.en:
<thinking>The search results confirm that the genus *Castanopsis* includes many species endemic to southwestern China, particularly Yunnan province, which has 38 species of *Castanopsis*, including 11 that are endemic. The common name ”chinquapin” or ”chinkapin” resembles an animal feature (possibly ”chipmunk” or ”chinchilla”), fitting the description in the question. Additionally, the plant belongs to the Fagaceae family, which includes oaks and beeches—common in temperate regions of the Northern Hemisphere. Therefore, the plant in the image is likely a species of *Castanopsis*, and it is native to southwestern China, primarily Yunnan, but also potentially extending to neighboring provinces like Guizhou, Sichuan, and Guangxi, as suggested by the earlier search results. I am now confident in providing the answer.</thinking>

blocks.en: What to notice. The most useful part of this trajectory is the self-correction in Steps 3 and 4: the model states a specific hypothesis, looks it up, finds that the species is native to Java and Sumatra rather than China, and discards it. The weakness is the ending: the province list it answers with came from its own earlier guess, and the retrieved pages support only part of it.
blocks.zh: 何以觉悟. 这一轨迹中最有用的部分是步骤3和4中的自我校正:模型陈述了一个特定的假说,向上看,发现该物种是爪哇和苏门答腊的原产地,而不是中国,并抛弃了它. 弱点是结局:它用它来回答的省份列表来自它自己早先的猜测,被检索的页面只支持其中的一部分.

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. In a photograph taken from a car at a city intersection, are there any cars closer to the camera than the nearest crosswalk? Why it is hard. Judging relative distance along a street from one image is error-prone; without tools the same model answers “yes”, pointing at a silver minivan. How the agent solves it. It estimates metric depth for the whole image, grounds the crosswalk and the cars, and has the coding agent compare the crosswalk’s depth with each car’s. The crosswalk is 17.4 m away and no car is closer.
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 在城市十字路口的一辆车上拍的照片中,是否有比最近的交叉道更靠近摄像机的车? 为甚么难. 判断一条街上与一幅图像的相对距离容易出错;没有工具,同一型号就回答“是”,指向一辆银色小货车。 代理人如何解脱. 它估计了整个图像的度量深度,对横道和汽车进行测距,并有编码代理将横道的深度与每辆车的深度进行比较. 横道距离17.4米,无车更近.

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. Name the church in a photograph of a dark Gothic interior with a large baroque altar. Why it is hard. blocks.en: What to notice. Searching the whole photograph returns look-alike Gothic interiors, and eleven calls of text search, page visits and a wide crop do not narrow them down; the model tries Antwerp, Münster and Eichstätt along the way. Cropping the altarpiece (Step 12) turns the reverse image search into a specific one: its first result is an archive photo of this exact altar painting (Step 13). A text search on that lead then confirms the church (Step 14). Crop, reverse image search and text verification come from different tool families, composed through images and web pages the harness keeps addressable in memory.
blocks.zh: 何以觉悟. 搜索整个照片后,看起来像是哥特式内部,11次查询文本、访问网页和广作物不会缩小;模型沿途尝试安特卫普、明斯特和艾希斯特。 裁剪祭坛(第12步) 将反向图像搜索变成一个特定的:它的第一个结果是这幅准确的祭坛画的存档照片(第13步). 然后对线索进行文字搜索,确认教堂的存在(第14步)。 裁剪、反向图像搜索和文本校验来自不同的工具家族,这些工具是通过图像和网页组成的,这些工具在存储器中保留可地址。

blocks.en: Example 12  Dataset: V*   Model: GPT-6 Sol
blocks.zh: 实例12 数据集:V*型号:GPT-6 Sol

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. In a large landscape photograph of a hilltop town, say whether a woman with a backpack is to the left or right of a person wearing a beanie. Why it is hard. The two people stand near a bus on a road far below the town and are only a few pixels tall; without tools the model answers “right”. How the agent solves it. Grounding on the full image cannot separate the two people, so the agent zooms in three times, each time closer, and grounds both people again inside the final crop, where they are large enough to tell apart.
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 在一座山顶小镇的大型景观照片中,说明背负背包的女性是左侧还是右侧佩戴贝尼帽的人. 为甚么难. 两人站在镇下方很远的一条路上, 代理人如何解脱. 扎根于完整的形象上无法将两人分开,因此物剂放大三次,每次更接近,使两人再次在最后的作物中扎根,在那里它们足够大,可以分辨.

blocks.en: MODEL
blocks.zh: 民主运动

blocks.en: <answer>B. left</answer>
blocks.zh: <answer>B. left </answer> (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: What to notice. The two people are a few pixels tall in the full image. Grounding them there returns almost the same tiny box for both queries (Steps 1 and 2), so it cannot separate them. The model zooms three times, each time closer, and grounds again on the final crop (Steps 6 and 7). There the woman with a backpack gets her own box, and the beanie query returns a second person to her right, so the model answers that she is on the left. The beanie query also returns the woman’s box, so this last step still needs the model’s judgement.
blocks.zh: 何以觉悟. 两人在完整的画面中都是几像素高的. 将它们放置在那里返回几乎相同的小框,用于两个查询(Steps 1和2),因此无法将它们分开. 模型放大3次,每次更接近,并在最终作物上再次搁浅(第6和7步). 在那里,带背包的女人会得到自己的盒子,蜂窝的查询将第二个人返回到她的右边,所以模型解答了她在左边. 蜂蜜质询也返回了女性的盒子,所以这一最后一步仍然需要模型的判断.

blocks.en: Example 13  Dataset: MMSI-Bench   Model: GPT-6 Sol
blocks.zh: 例13 数据集: MMSI- Bench 模型: GPT-6 Sol

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. Seven photographs show one living room from different positions. Of four statements about the room, choose the correct one; two of them give the number of throw pillows, 16 or 12, counting partly covered ones. Why it is hard. The pillows are spread across several views, some appear in more than one view, and some are partly hidden; without tools the model picks 12. How the agent solves it. It grounds “throw pillows” in each of the four views that show seating, zooms on both halves of the main sofa, and chooses the statement with 16 pillows.
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 七张照片显示一个不同位置的客厅. 在关于房间的4个陈述中,选择正确的1个;其中2个给出了投掷枕头的数量,16个或12个,算上部分覆盖的. 为甚么难. 枕头分布在多个视图中,有些出现在多个视图中,有些被部分隐藏;没有工具,模型选择12. 代理人如何解脱. 它把“扔枕头”放在显示座位的四种观点中,放大主沙发的两半,用16个枕头选择语句。

blocks.en: What to notice. Of the four options, two are pillow counts, so the question reduces to counting throw pillows across seven views of one room, including partly covered ones. The model grounds “throw pillows” in the four views that show seating (11, 3, 3 and 1 detections, 18 in total), then zooms on the two halves of the sofa in view 5. It answers 16, which requires recognizing that some pillows appear in more than one view. That cross-view deduplication is implicit: the model does not write it out.

blocks.zh: 例14 数据集: MMSI-Bench 模型:Qune3-VL-32B

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. Two photographs show two rooms of a historic house: a parlour with a piano, and a dining room. Which is longer, the piano or the table under the mirror? Without tools the same model answers D, that the piano is longer. How the agent approaches it. It grounds both objects, estimates metric depth in both photos, and has the coding agent convert each box to a real-world length. Caveat. The answer is correct, but the evidence does not support it. The mirror hangs above the fireplace, so the “table under the mirror” is the mantel shelf. Grounding returns it as object 3, but the agent chooses the round dining table (object 2) instead, and concludes that the table, at 2.77 m, is longer than the piano, at 2.21 m. This example shows the harness’s tool chain, not a sound comparison.
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 两张照片显示一个历史住宅的两个房间:一个带有钢琴的客厅,和一个餐厅. 钢琴还是镜子下的桌子? 没有工具 相同的模型回答D, 钢琴更长。 代理人如何接近它。 它将两个对象都对准,在两个照片中估计度量深度,并让编码代理器将每个框转换成现实世界长度. 卡维特 答案是正确的,但证据并不支持. 镜子挂在壁炉上方,因此“镜下台”是壁炉架。 定位返回为对象3,但代理人选择圆桌(对象2)取而代之,并得出结论,桌子在2.77米处比钢琴长,在2.21米处. 这个例子显示的是绳索的工具链,而不是一个良好的比较。

blocks.en: <thinking>Now I have depth maps for both images. I will use the Python_Coding_Agent_Tool to compute the actual lengths of the piano and the dining table (object 2) by combining their bounding box dimensions with the depth information at their centers. This will allow me to compare their real-world lengths accurately.</thinking>

blocks.en: ARGUMENTS
blocks.zh: 说明

blocks.en: { "objective": "Compute the real-world length of the piano from input_image_1 and the dining table (object 2) from input_image_2 using their bounding boxes and depth values at their centers. The piano's bounding box is [503.72, 477.32, 787.18, 999.63] and the dining table's bounding box is [38.62, 823.36, 556.79, 1000]. Use the depth maps from the Depth_Estimation_Tool to get the depth at the center of each object. Then, calculate the projected length using the formula: real_length = (bbox_width / image_width) * depth * 2 (assuming a rough perspective correction factor). Compare the two lengths and determine which is longer." }
blocks.zh: {"目标": "从输入_image_1和从输入_image_2的餐桌(对象2)使用其中心边框和深度值计算钢琴的真实世界长度. 钢琴的边框为[503.72,477.32,787.18,999.63],餐桌边框为[38.62,823.36,556.79,1000]. 使用深度图_ 估计_ 获取每个物体中心深度的工具。 然后,使用公式计算预测长度: real_wide=(bbox_width / image_width) * 深度 * 2(假设粗略的视角校正系数). 比较两个长度,确定哪个更长". {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}你觉得呢?

blocks.en: Example 15  Dataset: SparBench   Model: GPT-6 Sol
blocks.zh: 例15 数据集: Spar Bench 模型: GPT-6 Sol

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. Three photographs of a library are taken from nearby positions. A red point marks a bookshelf in the first photo and a blue point marks another bookshelf in the third. Give the 3D distance between them in metres. Why it is hard. The two points never appear in the same photo, so the distance cannot be judged from any single view; without tools the model answers 4.0 m. How the agent solves it. It recovers where each photo was taken from, measures metric depth at each point, and has the coding agent place both points in one 3D frame and measure between them: 2.0 m, against a ground truth of 1.9 m.
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 一个图书馆的三张照片来自附近的阵地。 红点在第一张照片中标志着书架,蓝点在第三张照片中标志着另一个书架. 给它们之间的3D距离以米计. 为甚么难. 这两个点从未出现在同一个照片中,因此距离不能从任何单一的视角判断;没有工具,模型回答4.0 m. 代理人如何解脱. 它能恢复每张照片的拍摄地点,测量每个点的度量深度,并有编码代理将两个点放在一个3D框中,并在它们之间测量:2.0米,与1.9米的地面真理相对.

What to notice. The two points are never visible in the same image, so the distance cannot be read off any one view. The harness supplies the three pieces a metric answer needs: camera poses relating the views (Step 1), metric depth in each view (Steps 2 and 3), and code that back-projects both points into a shared frame (Step 4). The model’s own contribution is to locate the two markers in pixels and to state the computation. Tool results pass to the coding agent as named variables held in memory, such as camera_trajectory_result and depth_result_2 , not as text the model must copy.
blocks.zh: 何以觉悟. 这两个点从未在同一图像中可见,因此距离不能从任何一个视图读取. 控制装置为三部分提供了一个需要的计量答案:相机显示的视图(第1步)、每个视图的计量深度(第2和第3步),以及后置投影两端都指向一个共享框架的编码(第4步)。 模型自身的贡献是用像素定位两个标记,并声明计算结果. 工具结果传递给编码代理作为存储器中持有的命名变量,例如相机_弹射器_结果和深度_结果_2,而不是模型必须复制的文本.

blocks.en: Example 16  Dataset: SparBench   Model: GPT-6 Luna
blocks.zh: 例16 数据集: Spar Bench 模型: GBT-6 Luna

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. Three photographs of a basement storage area are taken from nearby positions; the first is the observer’s view. A red point marks a cabinet, visible only in the third photo. Give the distance from the observer to the cabinet in metres. Why it is hard. The cabinet is seen from a different position than the one the question asks about, so its depth in the third photo is not the answer; without tools the model answers 2.0 m. How the agent solves it. It recovers the camera positions, reads the cabinet’s depth in the third photo, and has the coding agent move that point into the observer’s frame: 2.40 m, exactly the ground truth.
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 从附近的阵地拍摄了三张地下室储藏区的照片;第一张是观察员的视野。 一个红点标志着一个柜子,只在第三张照片中可见. 将观察者的距离用米表示给内阁. 为甚么难. 柜子从与问题所问位置不同的位置来看,因此它在第三张照片中的深度不是答案;没有工具模型回答2.0米. 代理人如何解脱. 它恢复了摄像头的位置,在第三张照片中读取了柜子的深度,并让编码代理将那个点移动到观察者的框架:2.40米,正是地面真相.

What to notice. The question asks for the distance from the observer of the first view, but the cabinet is marked only in the third view, taken about 0.7 m behind and 0.5 m to the left (Step 1). blocks.en: Example 17  Dataset: SparBench   Model: Qwen3-VL-32B
blocks.zh: 例17 数据集: Spar Bench 模型: Quen3-VL-32B

blocks.en: Overview (our summary) Task. Three photographs of an office corner are taken from nearby positions. A red point marks a window in the first photo and a blue point marks a cabinet in the third. Give the 3D distance between them in metres. Without tools the same model answers 1.7 m. How the agent approaches it. It chains four kinds of tool: camera trajectory to relate the views, depth in all three views, grounding to locate the window and the cabinet, and the coding agent to back-project both points into one frame and measure between them. Caveat. The pipeline is the right one, but its last step does not use the marked points. The generated code reads each box as position plus width and height, although the boxes are corner coordinates, and it takes the first “cabinet” box, an upper wall cabinet at the top edge of the photo, instead of the lower cabinet with the blue point. The answer, 1.20 m against a ground truth of 1.1 m, is therefore close partly by coincidence.
blocks.zh: 概览(我们的总结) 任务 从附近的阵地拍摄了三张办公室角落的照片。 一个红色点在第一张照片中标记一个窗口,一个蓝色点在第三张照片中标记一个柜子. 给它们之间的3D距离以米计. 没有工具,同样的模型回答1.7米. 代理人如何接近它。 它将四种工具连在一起:相机轨迹以连接到视图,深度在所有三种视图中,地面定位窗口和柜子,编码代理器将两个点都放入一个框,并在它们之间测量. 卡维特 管道是正确的,但其最后一步没有使用标记点. 生成的代码将每个盒子读作位置加宽度和高度,虽然盒子是角坐标,它需要第一个"内阁"盒子,即照片顶端的上壁柜,而不是带有蓝色点的下壁柜. 因此,1.20米的答案与1.1米的地面真理相对应,部分由于巧合而接近。

blocks.en: What to notice. The tool chain is the one a metric cross-view distance needs: camera poses, depth in each view, grounding to find the objects, and code to combine them, and the model plans it in its own words before the first call. The weak link is the last step: the generated code misreads the box format and measures from the wrong cabinet, so the close agreement with the ground truth should not be read as a successful measurement.
blocks.zh: 何以觉悟. 工具链是衡量交叉视距需要的一条:相机姿势,每个视距的深度,地面以找到对象,以及将对象组合起来的代码,模型在第一次呼叫前用自己的单词来规划. 薄弱环节是最后一步:生成的代码错误地从错误的柜中读取了框格式和度量衡,因此与地面真理的密切一致不应被解读为成功的度量.

blocks.en: Appendix G Baseline Reproduction
blocks.zh: 附录G 基线 复制

blocks.en: We re-run every baseline ourselves on our benchmark suite using each method’s official implementation (Table 25 ). All baselines receive exactly the same question text as OpenVLHarness, including each dataset’s answer-format instruction (e.g., “a single integer”, or a JSON list of boxes on a 0 0 – 1000 1000 scale for grounding); the only addition is a short answer-format instruction that Codex appends for Qwen3-VL backbones (Appendix G.1 ). Their predictions are scored with the same evaluation pipeline and judges. Boxes that a baseline returns in a different coordinate frame, such as pixel coordinates of the model’s resized input, are converted to our normalized format before scoring. Every baseline is evaluated on the full evaluation split. On Qwen3-VL, OctoTools and Visual Sketchpad follow the same three-run protocol as OpenVLHarness (Appendix H ); runs with proprietary backbones and the training-based baselines are single runs. A request that fails or times out counts as incorrect.
blocks.zh: 我们利用每种方法的正式实施,重新运行我们基准套件上的每一个基线(表25)。 所有基线都收到与OpenVLHarness完全相同的问题文本,包括每个数据集的答案格式指令(例如, " 单一整数 " ,或一个0-10001000比例尺的JSON框列表,用于搁浅);唯一添加的是一个简短的答案格式指令,由Codex附加到Qune3-VL主干线(附录G.1 ). 他们的预测得到同样的评价管道和法官的评分。 框显示,在不同的坐标框中返回基线,如模型调整大小的像素坐标,在打分前将转换成我们正常的格式。 每个基线都按全部评价分开来评价。 在Quen3-VL上,OctoTools和Visual Sketchpad遵循与OpenVLHarness(附录H)相同的三运行协议;运行时使用专有骨干,基于训练的基线为单运行. 失败或超时的请求算作不正确 。

blocks.en: Table 25: Configurations of the reproduced baselines. Search marks access to a web-search tool. All baselines except Codex decode greedily; Codex uses its own request settings.
blocks.zh: 表25:所转载基线的配置。 搜索标记访问网络搜索工具. 除Codex贪婪地解码外,所有基准;Codex使用自己的请求设置.

blocks.en: G.1 Training-Free Harnesses
blocks.zh: G.1 免费培训

blocks.en: The training-free harnesses run on the same model endpoints as OpenVLHarness, so any difference reflects the harness rather than the model.
blocks.zh: 无训练的吊带运行在与OpenVLHarness相同的模型端点上,因此任何区别都反映了吊带而不是模型.

blocks.en: OctoTools ( Lu et al., 2025 ) is a planner–executor framework in which a planner analyzes the query and proposes the next step, an executor turns it into a tool command, and a verifier decides whether to stop. We use the official implementation and route every language-model role, including the planner, executor, verifier, and the Generalist Solution Generator tool, to the Qwen3-VL backbone. We use its base toolset, the Generalist Solution Generator, with a budget of ten steps and greedy decoding. Because OctoTools accepts a single image per query, multi-image inputs are tiled into one composite with labeled panels (“Image 1”, “Image 2”, …). The final answer is taken from its direct-output mode.
blocks.zh: OctoTools(Lu et al., 2025)是一个规划者-执行者框架,其中规划者分析查询并提出下一步,执行者将其转化为工具命令,核查者决定是否停止. 我们使用正式执行,并将每个语言模型角色,包括规划员、执行员、核查员和通用解决方案生成工具,通向Qune3-VL主干线。 我们使用它的基础工具,通用式解决方案生成器, 预算有十步,并有贪婪的解码。 由于OctoTools每个查询接受一个单一的图像,多图像输入被加贴面板(“图像1”,“图像2”,......)。 最后的答案取自其直接输出模式.

blocks.en: Visual Sketchpad ( Hu et al., 2024 ) prompts the model to write Python that calls vision tools and draws on the image, in a ReAct-style loop. We use the official implementation with the Qwen3-VL backbone as its single planning agent and its vision-task toolset: open-vocabulary detection with Grounding DINO ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , sliding-window detection, Set-of-Mark segmentation ( Yang et al., 2023a ) , depth estimation with Depth Anything ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , zoom-in, and image overlay, all served with the original expert models. The agent may take up to ten replies with greedy decoding, receives multiple images as separate inputs, and ends with an ANSWER: line from which we read the prediction. For grounding tasks, it is instructed to convert its detector’s boxes to our output format.
blocks.zh: Visual Sketchpad (Hu et al., 2024) 提示模型编写 Python,它召唤视觉工具并借鉴图像,在一个ReAct风格的循环中. 我们使用Qwen3-VL主干线作为它的单一规划代理及其愿景-任务工具箱:使用Grounding DINO(Liu等人,2024年)进行开放式伏波探测,滑窗探测,Set-Mark分割(Yang等人,2023年a年),用Depth Anything(Yang等人,2024年)进行深度估计,放大,以及图像覆盖,都服务于最初的专家模型. 代理人可能用贪婪的解码来接受多达10个回复,接收多个图像作为单独的输入,最后用一个 RESWER:从中读取预测的行. 对于定位任务,指示它将其探测器的框转换成输出格式。

blocks.en:
Codex ( OpenAI, 2025a ) (v0.155.1) is OpenAI’s general-purpose coding agent. We run it non-interactively ( codex exec ) in code mode, with a fresh, ephemeral session for every question, the question’s images attached as inputs, and its final agent message taken as the prediction. Web search, browser use, apps, plugins, image generation, and sub-agents are disabled, and model-written code runs in a read-only sandbox. With GPT-6 Luna, Codex calls the OpenAI Responses API at medium reasoning effort and receives the question text unchanged. Codex’s default sandbox cannot start shell processes on our evaluation host. For the GPT-6 Luna runs, we therefore enforce the same read-only policy with Linux Landlock and seccomp, under which model-written code executes (Table 15 reports how often); the Qwen3-VL runs used the default sandbox and could evaluate only simple expressions (Appendix B.7 ). With Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3-VL-32B, it calls the same vLLM endpoints as OpenVLHarness through a small proxy that exposes Codex’s code tool as a standard function tool, which our vLLM server otherwise fails to stream, and each response is capped at 2,048 2{,}048 tokens. For the Qwen3-VL runs, Codex also appends a short instruction to the question: answer directly, give the option letter for multiple-choice questions, and use the image as evidence.
A question whose request fails or exceeds the time limit counts as incorrect; the limit is 300 300 seconds with Qwen3-VL and 1,800 1{,}800 seconds with GPT-6 Luna. With Qwen3-VL, LLM-judged benchmarks, including the search benchmarks, are scored with the Qwen3-VL-8B judge; with GPT-6 Luna, scoring follows Table 1 , so the search benchmarks are scored with the GPT-4o judge.
blocks.zh:
Codex(OpenAI,2025a)(v0.155.1)是OpenAI的通用编码代理. 我们以代码模式进行非交互操作( codex exec ) , 每个问题都有一个新鲜的瞬间会话, 将问题图像作为输入, 并将最终代理信息作为预测。 网页搜索,浏览器使用,应用,插件,图像生成,以及子代理被禁用,模型写代码运行在一个只读的沙盒中. 与GPT-6 Luna一起,Codex在中度推理努力中调用OpenAI Response API,并收到问题文本不变. Codex 默认的沙盒无法在我们的评价主机上启动 shell 进程 。 对于GPT-6 Luna运行,我们因此与Linux Landlock和seccomp执行同样的只读政策,在其中模式写代码执行(表15报告频率);Quen3-VL运行使用默认的沙盒,只能评价简单的表达式(Appendix B.7 ). 通过Qune3-VL-8B和Qune3-VL-32B,它通过一个小的代理将Codex的代码工具暴露为标准功能工具,调用与OpenVLHarness相同的vLLM端点,否则我们的vLLM服务器无法流出,每个响应的上限为2,048 2{,}048令牌. 对于Quen3-VL运行,Codex也给问题附加了一个简短的指令:直接回答,给多个选择题的选项字母,并以图像作为证据.
一个请求失败或超过时限的问题算作不正确;限制为300300秒的Qune3-VL和1800 1{,}800秒的GPT-6 Luna. 使用Qune3-VL,LLM判断的基准,包括搜索基准,与Qune3-VL-8B判断者得分;使用GPT-6 Luna,得分跟随表1,因此搜索基准与GPT-4o判断者得分.

blocks.en: G.2 Training-Based Harnesses
blocks.zh: G.2 基于培训的办法

blocks.en: For the training-based baselines, the tool-use behavior lives in the fine-tuned weights, so we evaluate each method’s released checkpoint inside its authors’ inference loop rather than re-training it. We followed a two-stage reproduction procedure. First, we executed each repository’s own reproduction workflow—including its released environment, model checkpoint, prompt and image preprocessing, tool implementations, and agent loop—until the baseline ran correctly on its documented benchmarks. Second, we added a lightweight HTTP serving layer around that verified path. The serving layer standardizes request transport, process lifecycle, and input normalization, while the model-specific reasoning logic remains in the released implementation. Each service accepts a question and one or more ordered images, returns a final prediction and an agent trajectory, and keeps the model and tool processes resident across examples.
blocks.zh: 对于基于训练的基线来说,工具使用行为生活在微调的权重中,所以我们评价了每种方法在作者推论圈内释放的检查点,而不是再训练它. 我们遵循了两个阶段的复制程序。 首先,我们执行了每个储存库自己的复制工作流程——包括其释放的环境、模型检查点、即时和图像预处理、工具执行和代理循环——直到基准正确运行于记录的基准。 第二,我们增加了一个轻量级的HTTP服务层 围绕经过验证的路径。 服务层实现标准化,请求运输,流程生命周期,以及输入正常化,而模型特定推理逻辑则留在发布的执行中. 每个服务接受一个问题和一个或一个以上命令的图像,返回一个最终的预测和代理轨迹,并保持模型和工具处理在各种实例中常态化.

blocks.en: All hosted baselines are evaluated through a shared external harness. For each benchmark example, the harness invokes the dataset’s prompt builder, converts the resulting text and ordered images into a common request, and records the returned prediction. The harness controls outer concurrency and, after inference, writes the prediction file expected by the benchmark evaluator and invokes the dataset’s native evaluate method using the same configured language-model judge where required. Crucially, scoring is performed entirely outside the baseline services: no service inspects ground truth, selects an evaluator, or computes accuracy. This separation ensures that all baselines are scored through a single consistent protocol. We compare them against OpenVLHarness on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, the base model all three were fine-tuned from (Table 9 ).
blocks.zh: 所有托管基线都通过共享的外部利用加以评估。 对于每个基准例子,这个控制器会引用数据集的即时构建器,将生成的文本转换成命令图像为共同请求,并记录返回的预测. 并引用数据集的本土评价方法, 关键的是,评分完全在基线服务之外进行:没有任何服务检查地面真相,挑选一名评价员,或计算准确性。 这种分离确保所有基线都通过单一一致的协议来打分。 我们将它们与Quen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct上的OpenVLHarness进行比较,这三种基本模型都进行了微调(表9)。

blocks.en: AdaReasoner ( Song et al., 2026 ) trains the model to adaptively compose tools. We use the AdaReasoner-7B checkpoint and the authors’ BaseToolInferencer , which exposes pointing (backed by Molmo ( Deitke et al., 2025 ) ), OCR, cropping, and drawing and path-planning tools through <tool_call> blocks, for up to six rounds. AdaReasoner is the only baseline requiring two Conda environments: the model/vLLM stack and the GPU PaddleOCR tool workers have incompatible tested dependencies. The launcher starts a tool controller and dedicated Point, OCR, and Crop workers alongside the model server.
blocks.zh: AdaReasoner (Song et al., 2026)训练该模型以适应性地作曲工具. 我们使用AdaReasoner-7B检查点和作者的BaseTools推断器,这些检查点暴露在(由Molmo(Deitke等人,2025年)),OCR,裁剪,以及绘图和路径规划工具通过“tool_call”块,最多6发子弹. AdaReasoner是唯一需要两个康达环境的基准:模型/vLLM堆栈和GPU PadleOCR工具工人具有不兼容的测试依赖性. 发射装置启动一个工具控制器和专用点,OCR,和Crop工人与模型服务器并列.

blocks.en: PixelReasoner ( Wang et al., 2025a ) is trained to reason in pixel space. We use the PixelReasoner-RL-v1 checkpoint and initialize the released Ray/vLLM engines, multimodal processor, and function-call prompt once at startup. The service retains the released tool parser and pixel-space operations (normalized cropping and frame selection). Inference proceeds at the granularity of model/tool rounds: ready requests are batched across vLLM engines, generated tool calls are executed, resulting crops or selected frames are appended to the conversation, and unfinished requests are requeued. The final answer is read from \boxed{} . The documented image-resolution budgets ( MIN_PIXELS =401408, MAX_PIXELS =4014080) are preserved as they affect how much visual information reaches the model.
blocks.zh: 像素反应器 (Wang等人,2025a)在像素空间中接受理性训练. 我们使用 PixelReasoner-RL-v1 检查点,并初始化已发布的 Ray/vLLM 引擎,多式联运处理器,以及启动时的函数调用提示器. 该服务保留了发布的工具解析器和像素空间操作(规范的裁剪和帧选择). 模型/工具回合的颗粒性推论所得: 已准备好的请求通过vLLM引擎进行批量,生成的工具呼叫执行,生成的作物或选定的帧附加在对话中,未完成的请求重新排队. 最后的答案是读自\boxed\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\。 所记录的图像分辨率预算(MIN_PIXELS = 401408,MAX_PIXELS = 4014080)由于影响到模型的视觉信息量而得以保留.

blocks.en: DeepEyesV2 ( Hong et al., 2026a ) is trained for agentic multimodal reasoning with code execution. We use the released DeepEyesV2-7B checkpoint with the agent mode of the authors’ vendored VLMEvalKit VLLMAPIWrapper . A single launcher supervises the text-search adapter, Python code service, one or more OpenAI-compatible vLLM model replicas, and the public inference API. The wrapper controls model calls, Python execution, retrieval turns, stopping rules, and answer extraction. All ordered input images are bound in the Python sandbox as image_1 , image_2 , … so that generated code can address every input.
blocks.zh: DeepEyesV2(Hong et al., 2026a)接受了代号执行的代理式多式联运推理培训. 我们使用释放的DeepEyesV2-7B检查站, 单一发射装置监督文本搜索适配器,Python代码服务,一个或多个OpenAI兼容的vLLM模型复制件,以及公众推论API. 包装器控制模型调用,Python执行,检索转弯,停止规则,以及解答提取. 所有已订购的输入图像被绑定在 Python 沙盒中作为图像_ 1, 图像_ 2, ... 这样生成的代码可以处理每个输入 。

blocks.en: For a defensible comparison, the following are held fixed or explicitly reported across all baselines: dataset version, split, and prompt builder; model checkpoint and quantization; image preprocessing and resolution limits; context window, per-call generation cap, temperature, and maximum agent/tool rounds; enabled tools and external search backend; concurrency and failure-retry policy; judge model, judge prompt, and judge retry count; and whether failures are scored as incorrect or retried.
blocks.zh: 为了进行合理的比较,所有基线都固定或明确报告下列情况:数据集版本、拆分和快速构建器;模型检查点和量化;图像预处理和分辨率限制;上下文窗口、每传一代上限、温度和最大代理/工具回合;启用工具和外部搜索后端;货币和故障重审政策;法官模型、法官即时和法官重审计数;以及失败是否被评为不正确或重审。

blocks.en: Appendix H Run-to-Run Variability
blocks.zh: 附录 H 运行到运行的可变性

blocks.en: Agentic evaluation is stochastic: the backbone samples at a non-zero temperature, the harness makes further model calls inside its tools, and live search results change over time. This section describes how we account for this variability and quantifies it for the Qwen3-VL results in the main paper.
blocks.zh: 物剂评价具有斯图克性:骨干样本在非零温度下,牵引力在其工具内进行进一步的模型调用,现场搜索结果随时间变化. 本节介绍我们如何说明这种变异性,并在主要论文中对Quen3-VL结果进行量化.

blocks.en: Every Qwen3-VL number in the main paper, including the Base, OctoTools, Visual Sketchpad, and OpenVLHarness columns of Table 1 and every entry of Table 3 , is the mean of three independent runs. Each run uses a different random seed, which controls both the backbone’s sampling and every stochastic component of the harness, such as the model calls made inside the Webpage Visit and Python Coding Agent tools. All other factors are held fixed across runs: the benchmark instances, prompts, tool backends, decoding parameters, iteration and context limits, and the scorers. Judges and answer extractors decode greedily, so the variation we measure comes from the agent rather than from scoring. We report all three runs of every configuration; no run is discarded or re-run, and a request that fails after retries is scored as incorrect in the run where it occurs. Search tools query the live web and cannot be seeded, so for search benchmarks the variation also reflects changes in retrieved content between runs. Results with proprietary backbones (GPT-5, GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6 Sol, and GPT-6 Astra) are single runs because of API cost.
blocks.zh: 主纸中的每个Quen3-VL号码,包括Base,OctoTools,Visual Sketchpad,表1的OpenVLHarness列和表3的每个条目,都是三个独立运行的平均值. 每次运行都使用不同的随机种子,这种种子既控制骨干取样,又控制着牵引装置的每个结构构件,如网页访问和Python编码代理工具内部的模型调用. 其他所有因素均被固定在横行中:基准实例、提示、工具后端、解码参数、迭代和上下文限制以及计分器。 判断和回答提取器 贪婪地解码, 所以,我们测量的变异 来自于代理而不是得分。 我们报告每个配置的所有三个运行; 没有运行被丢弃或重运行, 重复运行后失败的请求会被评为错误 。 搜索工具查询直播网络,无法播种,因此对于搜索基准,变量也反映了运行之间检索内容的变化. 拥有专有骨干(GPT-5,GPT-6 Luna,GPT-6 Sol,和GPT-6 Astra)的成绩由于API成本而单行.

blocks.en: Tables 26 and 27 report, for each entry, the standard deviation of the score across the three runs. For averages over datasets, we first compute the average within each run and then take the standard deviation of these three averages; this is smaller than the per-dataset deviations because independent fluctuations partly cancel. With only three runs, each standard deviation is itself a coarse estimate and should be read as indicating the scale of run-to-run variation rather than an exact value.
blocks.zh: 表26和表27报告,每个条目的分数标准偏差贯穿三个运行. 对于数据集上的平均值,我们首先计算每次运行中的平均值,然后采取这三个平均值的标准偏差;这比每个数据集的偏差要小,因为独立波动部分取消. 由于只有3个运行,每个标准偏差本身就是粗略的估计,应当理解为表示运行到运行变化的规模,而不是准确的值.

blocks.en: Table 26: Standard deviations across three runs for the Qwen3-VL Base and OpenVLHarness results in Table 1 . Average is the standard deviation of the per-run 22 22 -dataset average.
blocks.zh: 表26: Qwen3-VL基地的标准偏差和OpenVLHarness在表1中的结果。 平均值为每运行22 22 - 数据集平均值的标准差.

blocks.en: Per-dataset standard deviations are small relative to the differences between methods (Table 26 ). For OpenVLHarness, most are below 2 2 points; the largest occur on search benchmarks with live retrieval, such as MMSearch ( 171 171 questions, where one question is worth 0.58 0.58 points) and FVQA with Qwen3-VL-8B. OpenVLHarness varies somewhat more than Base, as expected for multi-turn trajectories in which an early difference in a tool call can change the rest of the trajectory. The 22 22 -dataset averages are very stable, with standard deviations of at most 0.35 0.35 points. The gain of OpenVLHarness over Base in this average ( + 11.2 +11.2 at 8B and + 12.6 +12.6 at 32B) is therefore about 29 29 and 44 44 times the combined standard deviation of the two averages, so the improvement cannot be attributed to run-to-run variation.
blocks.zh: 每个数据集的标准偏差相对于方法之间的差异来说很小(表26). 对OpenVLHarness来说,大部分在2分以下;最大的出现在有直播检索的搜索基准上,例如MMSearch(171 171个问题,其中1个问题值0.58 0.58分)和带有Qune3-VL-8B的FVQA. OpenVLHarness与Base相比有些不同,如多回合轨道的预期,工具调用中的早期差异可以改变其余的轨道. 22 22 - 数据集平均值非常稳定,标准差最高0.35 0.35点. 因此,OpenVLHarness在这个平均值(8B时为+11.2+11.2,32B时为+12.6+12.6)中的增益大约是两个平均值的合并标准偏差的29倍和44倍,因此改善不能归因于运行中的变化.

blocks.en: Table 27: Standard deviations across three runs for the ablation in Table 3 . Domain and overall columns are standard deviations of the per-run averages.
blocks.zh: 表27:表3所列三者的标准偏差。 域和总列为每运行平均值的标准差.

blocks.en: The overall averages in Table 3 have standard deviations between 0.2 0.2 and 0.35 0.35 points for every variant and backbone (Table 27 ). Adding tools, the capability layer, and multimodal memory each changes the overall average by several points, far beyond this variation. The textual-memory step ( + 0.7 +0.7 at 8B and + 0.3 +0.3 at 32B) is comparable to run-to-run variation, which is consistent with our conclusion that text descriptions of images are a weak substitute for retaining the images themselves.
blocks.zh: 表3中的总平均值标准差为0.2至0.350.35分,每种变体和主干体(表27)。 添加工具、能力层和多式联运内存,每个都使总体平均值改变若干点,远远超过这一变化。 文字-记忆步骤(8B时+0.7+0.7,32B时+0.3+0.3)与运行中的变异相当,这与我们的结论一致,即图像的文字描述是保留图像本身的弱替代.

blocks.en: Proprietary backbones are evaluated once, so their per-dataset numbers carry run-to-run variation of the scale measured above. Their conclusions, however, rest on large differences: OpenVLHarness improves the 22 22 -dataset average by + 10.8 +10.8 points with GPT-6 Luna, + 11.6 +11.6 with GPT-6 Sol, and + 9.9 +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra, more than twenty-five times the largest average-level standard deviation we observe with Qwen3-VL.
blocks.zh: 专有骨干经过一次评价,所以其每个数据集的数字带有上面测量尺度的运行到运行的变化. 然而,它们的结论基于巨大的分歧: OpenVLHarness改进了22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位33位1位1位,GPT-6 Sol+11.6位11位11位16位,GPT-6 Astra+9.9位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位22位24位24位24位24位24位24位24位24位24位24位24位24位24位24位24位24位24位24位24位40位24位24位24位24位48位48位40位48位45位48位40位24位40位24位24位24位24位24位24位48位24位48位48位48位33位24位45位33位33位45位33位48位33位33位48位33位33位48位33

blocks.en: Appendix I Additional Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录一 其他相关工作

blocks.en: Our work targets multimodal search, where a query is resolved by orchestrating reasoning, perception, and live web retrieval across many turns. A growing collection of benchmarks frames this task: MMSearch ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) couples a multimodal query with a curated search engine; MMSearch-Plus ( Tao et al., 2026 ) adds provenance-aware verification; BrowseComp-VL ( Geng et al., 2026 ) and MM-BrowseComp ( Li et al., 2025b ) raise cross-modal information-seeking difficulty; VisBrowse-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) targets visual-native search; and RealX-Bench ( Hong et al., 2026a ) couples fine-grained perception with multi-hop retrieval. Beyond pure search, the landscape extends to embodied tasks that integrate web information with physical action ( Hong et al., 2025 ) . Recent browsing agents tackle these benchmarks via hand-engineered tool inventories ( Geng et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2025a ; Narayan et al., 2025 ) , supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning that teaches tool use, or memory learned over a fixed inventory ( Xiao et al., 2025 ; Hasegawa et al., 2025 ) . Our contribution is orthogonal: rather than freeze the inventory, we generate it.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作目标是多模式搜索,通过协调各种推理、感知和现场网络检索解决查询。 越来越多的基准汇编规定了这一任务:MMSearch(Jiang等人,2024年)与一个多模式查询搭配了经过曲解的搜索引擎;MMSearch-Plus(Tao等人,2026年)增加了对出处的识别;浏览Comp-VL(Geng等人,2026年)和MM-BrowseComp(Li等人,2025年b)提高了跨模式信息搜索难度;VisBrowse-Bench(Zhang等人,2026年c年)的目标是视觉-本土搜索;RealX-Bench(Hong等人,2026年a年)对夫妇进行了多平台检索。 除了纯搜索之外,该景观还延伸到将网络信息与物理动作相结合的包含的任务(Hong等人,2025年). 近期浏览剂通过手动工具盘点处理这些基准(Geng等人,2026年;Huang等人,2026年;Yao等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年;Wu等人,2025年a年;Narayan等人,2025年),监督微调或强化学习,传授工具的使用,或从固定盘点中吸取的记忆(Xiao等人,2025年;Hasegawa等人,2025年)。 我们的贡献是正统的:我们不是冻结库存,而是生成库存。

blocks.en: Class-agnostic counting was popularized by FSC-147 ( Ranjan et al., 2021 ) , which asks for the number of objects of an arbitrary category; specialized counters such as CounTR ( Liu et al., 2022 ) , LOCA ( Djukic et al., 2023 ) , and CountGD ( Amini-Naieni et al., 2024 ) regress density maps or detections, and FSCD ( Nguyen et al., 2022 ) extends the task to predicting a box for every instance. Open-vocabulary detectors and segmenters, including GLIP ( Li et al., 2022 ) , Grounding DINO ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , and SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) , localize arbitrary text-specified categories, and MLLMs have begun to count by pointing ( Deitke et al., 2025 ) . Nevertheless, MLLMs remain unreliable once scenes contain more than a handful of objects ( Paiss et al., 2023 ; Tamarapalli et al., 2025 ) . Tool-use systems such as ViperGPT ( Surís et al., 2023 ) , VisProg ( Gupta and Kembhavi, 2023 ) , and Visual Sketchpad ( Hu et al., 2024 ) let a language model call detectors and count their outputs programmatically. OpenVLHarness follows this direction but keeps grounding outputs as persistent evidence: boxes, masks, and scores are stored as typed bindings that the Python Coding Agent can filter, deduplicate, and aggregate across turns, instead of a count that is read once from text.
blocks.zh: FSC-147(Ranjan等人,2021年)普及了阶级不可知性计数,要求任意类对象的数量;专门计数器如CounTR(Liu等人,2022年),LOCA(Djukic等人,2023年),和ColengGD(Amini-Naieni等人,2024年)递归密度图或检测,FSCD(Nguyen等人,2022年)将任务延伸为每例预测一个框. 露天探测器和分路装置,包括GLIP(Li等人,2022年),地面 DINO(Liu等人,2024年)和SAM 3(Carion等人,2025年)将任意文本指定类别本地化,MLLMs开始通过指针计算(Deitke等人,2025年). 然而,一旦场景包含的物体超过少数,MLLMs仍然不可靠(Paiss等人,2023年;Tamarapalli等人,2025年)。 毒蛇GPT等工具使用系统 (Surís等人,2023年),VisProg(Gupta和Kembhavi,2023年),和Visual Sketchpad(Hu等人,2024年)让一个语言模型调用探测器并按程序计算其输出. OpenVLHarness遵循这个方向,但依然将输出作为持续的证据进行定位: 盒,口罩,和分数作为键盘绑定物存储,Python编码代理可以过滤,复制,并跨转弯聚合,而不是从文本中读取一次的计数.

blocks.en: Spatial reasoning benchmarks test models beyond static single-image relations. EmbSpatial-Bench ( Du et al., 2024 ) and ERQA ( Team et al., 2025 ) target spatial and embodied reasoning in simulated and real-world scenes; SparBench ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) covers diverse single- and multi-view spatial tasks; and MindCube ( Wang et al., 2025c ) and MMSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2025b ) emphasize reasoning across multiple or limited views. In parallel, VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025b ) and subsequent VGGT-style geometric foundation models ( Hu et al., 2026 ) recover explicit scene geometry, including depth, camera pose, point maps, and tracks from visual observations. OpenVLHarness treats such geometric models as callable capabilities rather than requiring the MLLM itself to internalize 3D reconstruction, allowing their outputs to be composed with grounding and other persistent evidence during reasoning.
blocks.zh: 空间推理基准测试模型超越静态单像关系. EmbSpatial-Bench(Du等人,2024年)和ERQA(Team等人,2025年)在模拟和现实世界场景中瞄准空间和体现的推理;SparBench(Zhang等人,2026a年)涵盖多种单视和多视空间任务;MindCube(Wang等人,2025c年)和MMSI-Bench(Yang等人,2025b年)强调多重或有限观点的推理. 同时,VGGT(Wang et al.,2025b)和后续的VGGT风格几何基模型(Hu et al.,2026)从视觉观测中恢复清晰的场景几何,包括深度,相机姿势,点图,以及轨迹. OpenVLHarness将这种几何模型视为可调性能力,而不是要求MLLM本身将3D重建内部化,允许其输出在推理时以地基和其他持久证据组成.

blocks.en: Learning from past experience has a long history in reinforcement learning, exemplified by Hindsight Experience Replay ( Andrychowicz et al., 2017 ) , which relabels failed rollouts as successes, STaR ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ) , which bootstraps a reasoner on its own correct rationales, and ARMAP ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , which learns a reward model from an agent’s own trajectories to guide its planning. A newer line treats memory as a learning signal, distilling reusable knowledge from cross-sample working memory, though these methods often require additional training or model-weight updates ( Packer et al., 2023 ; Yan et al., 2025b ; Zhou et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2025a ; Ren et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Hong et al., 2026b ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) . A third line instead optimizes prompts and harnesses without any model-weight updates, using LLM- and coding-agent-driven optimizers that rewrite prompts, pipelines, and harness code from observed failures ( Khattab et al., 2024 ; Yuksekgonul et al., 2024 ; Agrawal and others, 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Yuksekgonul et al., 2026 ; Sharma, 2025 ) , but to date this is done purely in the text-only prompt and harness domain.
blocks.zh: 从过去的经验中吸取教训在强化学习方面有着悠久的历史,例如Hindsight Investment Replay(Andrychowicz 等人,2017年)将失败的推出重新标注为成功,STar(Zelikman 等人,2022年)则根据自己的正确理由将一个理由夹住,ARMAP(Chen等人,2025b年)则从代理商自己的轨迹中学习到一个奖励模型来指导其规划. 较新的一行将记忆视为学习信号,从交叉抽样工作记忆中提炼可重复使用的知识,尽管这些方法往往需要额外的培训或模型重量更新(Packer等人,2023年); Yan等人,2025年b;Zhou等人,2025年b;Wang等人,2024年b;Yang等人,2025年a;Oyang等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2025年;Yan等人,2025年a;Ren等人,2026年;Shi等人,2026年b;Hong等人,2026年b;Jiang等人,2026年b). 相反,第三行使用LLM和编码剂驱动的优化器,在没有任何模型重量更新的情况下优化提示和利用,这些优化器改写了所观察到的故障的提示、管道和利用码(Khattab等人,2024年;Yuksekgonul等人,2024年;Agrawal等人,2025年;Lee等人,2026年;Yuksekgonul等人,2026年;Sharma,2025年),但迄今为止,这完全是在文本的即时和利用域内进行的。
